title: Software Engineer - Integration Specialist
description:
Are you passionate about building secure, scalable integrations that power the future of digital banking? Emergifi is seeking a talented Software Engineer – Integration Specialist to join our team.


In this role, you’ll design and develop API-based connections between core banking systems, digital platforms, and fintech partners—driving real-time data exchange for payments, analytics, and operational workflows. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact in financial services through innovative engineering, we’d love to hear from you.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful services, webhooks, and batch ETL jobs that connect core banking platforms (e.g., Symitar, Fiserv DNA, Corelation Keystone, Sharetec, CU*BASE) with digital banking platforms (e.g., Q2, Alkami, Lumin Digital, Bankjoy).
  • Implement integrations using internal microservices and/or middleware (e.g., PortX, Kinective) to ensure scalability, reuse, and centralized monitoring.
  • Build and manage data models, mappings, and transformations for loans, shares/deposits, transactions, payments (ACH, wires, RTP), and treasury services.
  • Establish and operate secure authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, mTLS, signed webhooks); manage secrets, keys, and certificates.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and observability (logging/metrics/tracing) to ensure integration reliability, performance, and recoverability.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, vendors, and security/compliance to refine requirements and deliver integration features.
  • Create and maintain documentation (API specs, data dictionaries, sequence/flow diagrams) and deliver knowledge transfer to operations teams.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents; perform root cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required.

title: Software Quality Engineer I - III (DOE)
description:
Software Quality Engineer I – III (DOE)

Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Burlington, Renton, Spokane, Vancouver, Portland, Medford, Salt Lake City, Boise, Lewiston, or Fargo offices.

Candidates must reside within commutable distance of that location or be willing to relocate.

Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For:

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Software Quality Engineers are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Software Quality Engineering team, our Software Quality Engineers are responsible for assuring the delivery of high quality products and software services. The Software Quality Engineer I works with teammates to prevent and detect defects throughout the product lifecycle, evaluate the appropriateness of software solutions for customers and the enterprise, and enable delivery team productivity. The Software Quality Engineer II applies a wide variety for testing and quality assurance techniques to complex software projects often requiring coordination with multiple software delivery teams. The Software Quality Engineer III is a senior level engineer that applies extensive technical knowledge and experience to develop and deliver solutions for software projects.

Do you thrive as a part of a collaborative, caring team? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

What You Bring to Cambia:

Qualifications:

The Software Quality Engineer I would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and relevant experience in one programming language, such as Java, Ruby, Python or C# or equivalent combination of education and experience.

The Software Quality Engineer II would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and 3 years of experience performing software quality and testing throughout product development, deployment and maintenance and 1 year of experience writing, running and automating tests; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

The Software Quality Engineer III would have a BA/BS degree in computer science or related field and 6 years of experience performing software quality and testing throughout product development, deployment and maintenance, including 3 years of experience writing, running and automating tests; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Skills and Attributes:

  • Demonstrated proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Ruby, Python or C#.

  • Ability to react quickly and remain productive in a fast-paced work environment.

  • Ability to learn, apply and follow company best practices.

  • Ability to work independently, raise issues and take corrective action.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical project team members.

  • Demonstrated experience with web, mobile and database application technologies, automated testing and tools.

  • Demonstrated experience with one or more: software reliability, automated test maintenance, static analysis, or code coverage.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply appropriate industry-standard processes and practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated ability to utilize metrics and understand processes related to effective quality assurance and testing progress.

  • Extensive experience with web, mobile and database application technologies, automated testing, frameworks and tools.

  • Demonstrated experience with TDD/ATDD, Continuous Integration, Design for Testability, and Software Stability.

  • Demonstrated ability to select appropriate industry-standard processes and practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated ability to work across project teams to leverage existing knowledge, technologies and solutions.

What You Will Do at Cambia:

  • Participate on project scrum team and defect triage team while managing personal work backlog using agile practices

  • Review user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, software designs, code and tests to ensure quality standards

  • Develop, automate and execute unit, component and system-level tests using industry-standard methods; write automated and manual test cases while collaborating with peers to ensure adequate coverage

  • Report test results, submit defects, verify fixes, and assess impact of requirements/design/code changes to recommend test updates and regression testing

  • Ensure software testability, test coverage and maintainability meet project requirements; mentor team members on achieving required coverage and improving automated test stability

  • Collaborate with Development to define requirements, design and implementation ensuring testability, scalability, maintainability, and reliability Develop technical solutions to meet project quality, cost and schedule requirements while mitigating risks and ensuring executable quality and test plans

  • Use metrics to drive process effectiveness, monitor testing progress and product quality, and lead assigned process improvement efforts

  • Collaborate on integration and system-level tests; escalate issues to Software Quality Lead as needed

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

Software Quality Engineer I:

  • Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $72,000 - $90,000, the full salary range is $72,000- $117,000, and the bonus target is 10%.

  • North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $60,000 - $77,000, and the full salary range is $60,000 - $95,000.

Software Quality Engineer II:

  • Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $79,000 - $99,000, the full salary range is $79,000- $129,000, and the bonus target is 10%.

  • North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $66,000 - $86,000, and the full salary range is $66,000 - $106,000.

Software Quality Engineer III:

  • Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $87,000 - $109,000, the full salary range is $878,000- $142,000, and the bonus target is 15%.

  • North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $80,000 - $106,000, and the full salary range is $80,000 - $133,000.

About Cambia


Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.


Why Join the Cambia Team?


At Cambia, you can:

  • Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.

  • You work closely with Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Project Managers, and Agile teams to configure boards, sprints, workflows, and reporting aligned with Scrum and Kanban practices.
  • You support and maintain integrations with external development tools, particularly Azure DevOps, including Boards, Repos, Pipelines, commits, branches, pull requests, builds, and releases linked to Jira issues.

  • You stay current with Atlassian product roadmaps, new features, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements.

  • You have strong, demonstrable hands-on experience administering the Atlassian Cloud ecosystem, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Guard.
  • You have strong experience designing and maintaining Jira workflows, schemes, custom fields, screens, permissions, notifications, and issue type configurations.

  • You have experience integrating Azure DevOps with Jira to support end-to-end development workflows and traceability across the SDLC.
  • You have experience configuring and maintaining Power BI connectors for Jira, or similar BI/reporting add-ons.
  • You have a solid understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We also believe you have

title: Transformation & Delivery Specialist (Delivery & Performance Specialist)
description:
Kia ora!

Help shape the future of how Air New Zealand delivers for our customers, our people and Aotearoa. This is your opportunity to turn strategy into meaningful outcomes, influence enterprise-wide transformation, and build the capability that keeps one of New Zealand's most iconic organisations moving forward. Whether your experience comes from digital, operations, or large-scale transformation, we value fresh perspectives and the ability to create lasting impact.

As part of our Transformation team, you'll help embed modern ways of working that improve customer, operational and commercial outcomes. Working alongside leaders, Product Owners, Delivery Owners and multidisciplinary teams, you'll play a hands-on role in turning operating model ambitions into practical, measurable results.

About the role

As a Transformation & Delivery Specialist (Delivery & Performance Specialist), you will:

  • Drive the adoption and continuous improvement of Air New Zealand's operating model, translating strategy into practical ways of working that improve enterprise outcomes.
  • Partner with leaders, Product Owners and Delivery Owners to define outcomes, prioritise value and turn strategic intent into executable delivery plans.
  • Build high-performing delivery environments by strengthening accountability, decision making, collaboration and delivery rhythms.
  • Identify and resolve system-wide delivery challenges, improving flow, reducing friction and enabling better outcomes across teams and operational environments.
  • Lead planning, prioritisation and delivery governance, ensuring risks, dependencies, investment and progress remain visible and actionable.
  • Step into complex or ambiguous situations to unblock delivery, create momentum and build lasting capability through practical coaching and leadership.
  • Integrate stakeholder feedback and adoption insights to ensure new ways of working become embedded and sustainable.

Success in this role will be measured by stronger delivery predictability, improved organisational flow, increased adoption of modern ways of working, and measurable customer, operational and commercial outcomes.

What we're looking for

  • Ideally 6+ years' experience in a large digital and/or operational organisation, including at least 3 years in enterprise coaching, transformation, complex delivery or operating model roles.
  • Experience working within complex, highly operational and unionised environments, with an understanding of frontline operations and workforce dynamics.
  • Proven ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through planning, mobilisation, execution and sustained adoption.
  • Strong transformation and delivery expertise, with the judgement to coach, facilitate, lead or step in directly to achieve outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success improving operating models, delivery performance, accountability and customer or operational outcomes.
  • Practical knowledge of agile, lean, flow and continuous improvement, with the ability to adapt approaches to different contexts.
  • Strong capability in planning, prioritisation, governance, risk management, vendor engagement and commercial decision making.
  • Confidence using delivery metrics and team health indicators to improve forecasting and guide continuous improvement.
  • Exceptional facilitation, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with relevant agile, coaching, delivery or change certifications considered an advantage.

If you meet the majority of the criteria and are excited by the opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Why join Air New Zealand?

We want our people to live their best lives and access great benefits that support their lives outside work.

  • Generous staff travel benefits for you, your friends and your whānau.
  • FlexiLeave, giving you the option to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave each year.
  • A learning culture with on-the-job development, career growth opportunities and experiences that help you reach your full potential and more!

Ready for take-off?

If you're passionate about enterprise transformation and enjoy turning complexity into practical outcomes, we'd love to hear from you. Join Air New Zealand and help shape the future of how we deliver for our customers, our people and New Zealand.

Applications close 9 September 2026.

Our people are our greatest asset – because while everything else we do in our operation can be replicated by our competitors, it is our people that truly set us apart. We are firm believers in celebrating the differences and diversity of thought our people bring to their roles. We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with a disability, additional health and mental health needs, and/or are neurodiverse to apply for our roles.

Bij ons is diversiteit geen trend, maar iets wat al meer dan 40 jaar de basis vormt van onze organisatie. Vanzelfsprekend zijn sollicitaties van iedereen welkom. Onze bedrijfscultuur is net zo uniek als ons shopconcept en onze medewerkers maken het verschil. TK Maxx is betrokken, uniek, stijlvol en een tikkeltje eigenzinnig. title: Seal Repair Technician
description:
Under general supervision, the Seal Repair Technician is responsible for all processes related to disassembly and assembly of rotating equipment. The Seal Repair Technician follows instruction from a Repair job packet and router to perform DCI (Dismantle Clean and Inspect) and gives a written description of the wear and condition of critical components seal.

This position completes all inspection forms taking pictures of all critical components, and uses inspection equipment for proper documentation of the assembly. With assistance identifies, inspects and evaluates material returned, determines repair operations, performs simple shop operations, verify specifications, initiate work and purchase orders.

Receives John Crane parts and materials returned by customers and branch offices. Evaluates from a condition of material, checks current drawing revisions and general product knowledge whether material is repairable or non-repairable.

  • Performs the assembly of the seal once the repair has been released to the shop and all components have been replaced or reconditioned and marked ready for assembly.
  • Under close supervision, repairs returned seals and seal parts.
  • May perform price of repair, ensures assembly is structured correctly.
  • Determines necessary repair operations, ensures BOM (bill of materials) / drawings / repair parts match.

description:
We are looking for a highly technical, strategic, and outcome-oriented Staff Technical Product Manager to establish and scale AI Evaluation as a core engineering capability across the DT organization. The Eval Technical Product Manager will lead this transformation by making trusted Evals the evidence layer for AI.

This is a dual-role position with responsibility for both:

  1. Platform Eval Strategy & Adoption
    Partner closely with Servicenow AI platform and product teams to understand, implement, validate, and drive adoption of out-of-the-box Evals, while influencing the platform roadmap based on enterprise needs.

  1. Enterprise Eval Innovation
    Identify gaps in platform evaluation capabilities and drive the definition and development of custom Evals, metrics, rubrics, datasets, and evaluation strategies for enterprise-specific AI applications and agentic workflows. The role will establish Eval-Driven Development as a standard engineering practice—moving AI quality from point-in-time testing to continuous measurement throughout the AI lifecycle

  1. Custom Eval Innovation

  • Identify gaps where OOTB Evals don't adequately measure enterprise AI quality.

  • Define and drive custom metrics, rubrics, datasets and evaluation strategies.

  • Develop reusable Evals for domain-specific behaviors and business outcomes.

  • Establish evaluation approaches for AI agents, task completion, tool usage and multi-step workflows.

  1. Eval-Driven Development

  • Embed Evals into the full AI lifecycle: Define → Measure → Build → Evaluate → Improve → Release → Monitor

  • Require AI teams to define expected behavior and measurable quality criteria.

  • Establish evaluation coverage and quality thresholds.

  • Integrate trusted Evals into development, regression and release workflows.

  • Establish Eval-based quality gates for appropriate AI applications.

  • Enable continuous evaluation in production.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • A technically strong Product Manager who combines: AI/LLM expertise + Evaluation Science + Quality Engineering + Product Management + Platform Strategy with the ability to influence AI Specialists, engineers and platform teams without direct authority.

title: Senior Manager - Data Analytics & Insight
description:

Description:

Growth Ops Leader (GOL) – US Growth Operations (Grade E)

We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh's US Growth Operations team as a Growth Ops Leader (GOL). This role will be based in Gurugram (Gurgaon), India. This is a hybrid role, that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

US Growth Operations supports Marsh's growth agenda by enabling pipeline execution, improving data quality and sales discipline, delivering insights and reporting, and coordinating key cadences and communications across stakeholders. The team partners closely with Zone Leaders, Office Leaders, Market/Industry Leaders, Sales Leaders, Client Executives, and growth enablement stakeholders to drive adoption of standard processes, governance, and tools across the US.

This role is responsible for supporting US growth strategy execution through pipeline operations, client experience measurement (CEM) support, financial analysis & reporting, meeting/cadence management, CRM support, and marketing enablement —requiring strong analytical capability, operational rigor, stakeholder management, and comfort working across US time zones.

We will count on you for:

  • Growth Team (GT) Strategy & Planning – Support bottom-up GT performance analysis and planning cycles, including projections, targets, and tracking of strategic actions.
  • Pipeline execution & growth opportunity management – Enable disciplined pipeline operations and opportunity progression, including month-end hygiene, CEM-enabled follow-ups, and support to forecasting/account planning cadences.
  • Financial analysis & reporting – Translate financial and CRM data into actionable insights through recurring reporting, scorecards, and executive-ready narratives.
  • GT meetings & cadence management – Plan and run key GT cadences by coordinating agendas, materials, minutes, action tracking, and content archiving.
  • CRM support – Provide operational support for opportunity and contact hygiene, user enablement, and follow-ups to improve timeliness and accuracy of CRM data.
  • Marketing enablement support – Coordinate growth communications, event logistics, outreach execution, and lead capture/routing support aligned to agreed SLAs.
  • Colleague-related support – Support colleague engagement initiatives and office/leader events through planning, coordination, communications, and follow-through.

What you need to have:

  • Post Graduate degree in business, finance, economics, statistics, commerce, engineering, or similar discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in sales operations, growth operations, commercial analytics, reporting/insights, or a similar role in a large professional services organization.
  • Strong experience supporting pipeline operations / CRM (Microsoft Dynamics or similar) and driving data quality.
  • Excellent command of English (written and spoken), with confidence interacting with senior US stakeholders.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office Suit (Excel, PowerPoint etc.); ability to convert data into clear executive-ready narratives.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and comfort working with financial and CRM datasets.
  • Ability to work under limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, and deliver reliably in a fast-changing environment.
  • Willingness and ability to support US time zones (partial overlap required) and collaborate across geographies.

What makes you stand out:

  • Strong stakeholder management: able to influence without authority and drive follow-through.
  • Experience with dashboarding and data visualization tools.
  • Familiarity with client experience programs (e.g., CEM/NPS) and using insights to drive action.
  • Process improvement mindset; comfort leveraging AI/automation tools for efficiency and quality.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to anticipate needs before being asked.

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact on colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

What else is cooking?

Permanent

Introduction

Are you a solution architect who enjoys turning complex business needs into practical, scalable technology solutions? This is an opportunity to shape enterprise-wide technology decisions, influence strategy and work across a varied technology landscape while helping AQA deliver services that support learners and education.

As a Solution Architect, you'll play a key role within the Enterprise Architecture team, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to design solutions that deliver real business value. You'll provide architectural leadership across enterprise technologies, guide solution delivery and help ensure technology investments align with long-term strategic goals. You'll also contribute to the evolution of AQA's technology landscape by balancing innovation, governance and practical delivery.

In this role, you'll be responsible for:

  • Designing and guiding technology solutions that meet business requirements while aligning with architectural standards, strategic objectives and delivery priorities.

What's in it for you?

You'll have the opportunity to influence technology decisions at an enterprise level while continuing to develop your expertise across a broad and evolving technology environment.

title: 1822-Pretrial Specialist II
description:
Under direction, The Pretrial Specialist II is a journey‑level position that performs a full range of pretrial assessment, supervision, and case management duties with moderate independence. Employees in this role evaluate individuals referred for pretrial release consideration, verify background information, administer validated risk assessment tools, and prepare written reports and recommendations to support judicial decision‑making.

Pretrial Specialist II monitors compliance with court‑ordered conditions, maintain accurate case documentation, and communicate regularly with clients, court personnel, attorneys, and partner agencies. The Pretrial Specialist II handles more complex or sensitive cases than entry‑level staff, applies sound judgment in interpreting pretrial policies and requirements, and may provide guidance or informal mentoring to lower‑level personnel. Work is performed in a fast‑paced justice system environment that requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and the capacity to interact professionally with diverse populations.

  • The 1822 Pretrial Monitoring Specialist II is responsible for overseeing the ongoing supervision and compliance monitoring of individuals released under pretrial conditions. Employees in this classification perform moderately complex case management duties requiring sound judgment, knowledge of supervision practices, and the ability to interpret and apply court‑ordered release conditions.

The Pretrial Monitoring Specialist II monitors client compliance through regular check‑ins, electronic monitoring systems, drug testing coordination, and engagement with community resources. Incumbents review alerts, document compliance activity, address violations within established guidelines, and communicate significant updates to the court and supervising officers. Staff at this level work with increasing independence, manage a full caseload, and may provide informal guidance to lower‑level staff or new team members. Work includes frequent interaction with clients, court personnel, law enforcement agencies, and service providers to support safe and effective pretrial supervision.

  • The 1822 Pretrial Assessment Specialist II is responsible for Leading the administration of the PSA, conducting comprehensive pretrial risk assessments, gathering and verifying defendant information, and preparing reports to assist the court in making informed release decisions. Employees in this classification perform moderately complex analytical and administrative duties requiring sound judgment, knowledge of pretrial procedures, and the ability to interpret court orders and legal information.

The Pretrial Monitoring Specialist II works with moderate independence, handles more complex cases than entry‑level staff, and may provide guidance to lower‑level assistants or specialists. Work includes interviewing defendants, reviewing criminal history and background information, completing validated risk assessment tools, documenting findings, and ensuring all information is accurately recorded in the case management system. Incumbents interact routinely with courts, law enforcement, attorneys, and pretrial clients to support fair, consistent, and timely pretrial decision‑making.

Various Shifts:

  • 7am-4pm
  • 3pm-11pm
  • On-Call 11pm-7am

SUPERVISION EXERCISED

Depending on assignment, may serve as lead worker to clerical, technical and/or subordinate professional staff.

EXAMPLES OF IMPORTANT AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES

According to Civil Service Commission Rule 109, the duties specified below are representative of the range of duties assigned to this job code/class and are not intended to be an inclusive list.

1. Performs research, compiles and analyzes information/data regarding a variety of administrative, management, fiscal and organizational issues: identifies issues and determines analytical standards in consultation with supervisor, manager, departmental personnel and other individuals/experts; gathers relevant data, information and/or documentation from a variety of sources; analyzes information and documentation to develop tentative findings; discusses and/or coordinates analysis and tentative findings with supervisor, management staff and/or other appropriate individuals; develops or assists in developing recommendations and/or course of action; gathers additional information and/or revises methodology as needed.

2. Prepares or assists in the preparation of a variety of management reports: compiles and evaluates information in preparation for writing report; presents background information and description of analytical standards; outlines findings and recommendations and prepares logical supporting documentation; writes or assists in writing final reports and documentation for evaluation by administrative and/or management staff; presents reports, including formal presentations to groups.

3. Performs analysis for new and existing administrative, management, program and organizational policies and procedures: consults with managers, administrators and other staff to determine parameters for analysis and other background information; analyzes the effect of proposed and existing legislation, regulations and law on organizational policies and procedures; compiles information and documentation in preparation for producing reports and/or drafts reports for management/administration.

4. Performs analysis for budget development and resource planning: performs or assists in needs analysis and trend analysis based on research and consultation with managers and administrative staff; consults with managers and assists in resource planning and development of annual budget estimates; reviews and analyzes budget requests from administrators; compiles information and documentation in preparation for producing reports and/or drafts reports related to budget and resource planning issues.

5. Performs analysis for budget administration and/or fiscal/financial reporting: monitors and analyzes expenditures and accounts to ensure compliance with budget parameters; gathers information and prepares documentation related to fiscal/financial reporting; performs and/or assists in fiscal/financial analysis; compiles information and documentation in preparation for producing and/or drafting fiscal/financial reports.

6. Performs analysis for development and administration of competitive bid processes and contractual agreements: identifies and analyzes needs, goals, available funding and other criteria; develops or assists in development of contract/lease specifications; prepares requests for proposals and bid solicitation; performs or assists in analysis of bid information provided by contractors; assists in establishment/maintenance of contractual relationships; performs or assists in analysis for monitoring and enforcement of legal agreements to ensure compliance.

7. Performs analysis for monitoring of grants received by department; writes or assists in writing grant proposals; analyzes funding parameters and other requirements specified by grantor; monitors departmental expenditures to ensure funding parameters are met; analyzes other criteria to ensure compliance with standards required by grantor.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

Knowledge of: the principles, procedures and legal standards required to provide professional-level analytical assistance to administrative staff in such areas as: budget development and monitoring; financial/fiscal analysis and reporting; development of management/administrative policies and procedures; analysis of existing and proposed legislation, legal standards and regulatory mandates; development and administration of contractual agreements; and/or grant monitoring and administration.

Ability or Skill to: identify, research and gather relevant information from a variety of sources; read and interpret complex written materials; analyze and evaluate quantitative and qualitative data, procedures, interrelated processes and other information; formulate conclusions and/or alternatives and develop effective recommendations; use work-related computer applications, including e-mail, word processing, spreadsheets, databases and the internet; prepare well-organized and accurate documents such as reports, memos, and correspondence; synthesize ideas and factual information into clear and logical written statements; speak clearly and concisely in order to express ideas and communicate work-related information to a variety of individuals and groups; listen, ask appropriate questions and effectively elicit information; establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, officials and the general public.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university, and one (1) year full-time equivalent experience performing professional-level analytical work.

Experience:

Qualifying professional-level analytical work includes analysis, development, administration, and reporting in major programs and functions of an organization in areas such as budgets, contracts, grants, policy, or other functional areas related to the duties of positions in the 182X Class series.

Substitution:

Possession of a graduate degree (Master's degree or higher) from an accredited college or university with major coursework in specialized subject matter areas such as public or business administration, management, business law, contract law, public policy, urban studies, economics, statistical analysis, finance, accounting or other fields of study closely related to the essential functions of positions in the Class series may be substituted for the required one (1) year of experience.

Additional experience as described above may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for-year basis (up to a maximum of 2 years). Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units equal one year.

The City and County of San Francisco encourages women, minorities and persons with disabilities to apply. Applicants will be considered regardless of their sex, race, age, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition (associated with cancer, a history of cancer, or genetic characteristics), HIV/AIDS status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, military and veteran status, or other protected category under the law.

title: Graduate Physiotherapist
description:
Your Role as a Physiotherapy Grad

Ready to help children move, play and participate in life with confidence?

As a Physiotherapy Graduate at Early Start Australia, you'll work alongside children and families to help achieve meaningful milestones every day. Whether it's supporting a child to take their first independent steps, improve their balance and coordination, or participate more confidently in sport and play, you'll be there to celebrate every achievement along the way.

About Our Grads

We're looking for future Physiotherapists who are passionate about helping children and families, eager to learn and excited to bring fresh ideas to our team.

You might be the perfect fit if you:

  • Have a degree in Physiotherapy
  • Are eligible for AHPRA registration upon graduation
  • Have recently graduated or will graduate in early 2026
  • Hold a current driver's licence and have access to a vehicle with third-party insurance
  • Have (or are willing to obtain) a Working with Children Check
  • Have (or are willing to obtain) a National Police Check
  • Have (or are willing to obtain) NDIS Worker Screening Clearance
  • Have (or are willing to obtain) First Aid and CPR certification
  • Bring great communication skills, strong organisation and a positive attitude

Why You'll Love It Here

You'll be supported from day one with dedicated mentoring, structured learning, an awesome graduate network and a team that genuinely wants to see you succeed.

At Early Start Australia, we believe therapy should be meaningful, collaborative and fun, and we think your graduate experience should be too.

If you're ready to launch your career, learn from some of Australia's leading clinicians and help children build the confidence to move, play and thrive, we'd love to meet you!

The Marketing Analytics team works with the business and marketing stakeholders to analyze and measure the impact marketing has on our business objectives.

The Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics, will be responsible for gathering, structuring and analyzing data to derive compelling insights that drive the strategy & optimization of our marketing initiatives. This includes the design and management of data collection and analytics solutions, analysis of the performance of marketing initiatives and their effect on acquisition, retention, engagement, and conversion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Understand the business objective and marketing initiatives to then identify the key success metrics that help evaluate the performance towards the objectives
    • Analyze correlations between business outcomes and marketing initiatives.
    • Establish a benchmarking methodology and set targets for the key metrics identified.
    • Measure and communicate to stakeholders the results.
  • Be a thought leader and spearhead data driven decision making amongst stakeholders.
    • Translate the business questions and challenges from the stakeholders into analytics projects.
    • Deliver a cross-channel, brand level view of performance, insights, and recommendations.
    • Convey the finding on campaign performance and drive strategy and optimization change with stakeholders.
    • Provide data analysis and reporting to identify trends and opportunities across channels, audience segments, and player segments.
  • Work with marketing teams to ensure marketing efforts are effective and drive incremental acquisition, engagement, and conversion.
    • Develop marketing experiments to understand the business impact of paid media and creator campaigns.
    • Leverage data from Adobe Analytics, Gamesight, Salesforce, Datorama and various other tools and platforms.
    • Develop robust analytic processes to frame campaign expectations, inform decision making, and provide optimization recommendations based on performance data.
    • Work with Data Science to use predictive analytics to analyze data from viewership, website interactions, media campaigns, CRM, and social platforms.
    • Assist with budget planning exercises to determine optimal budget for a given campaign.
    • Develop marketing experiments to understand the business impact of paid media
  • Communicate insights and discuss recommendations with brand teams and cross functional partners.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 4+ years of proven analytical skills; ability to analyze raw data, draw conclusions, and develop actionable insights. 3+ years of that in paid media and marketing analytics.
  • Experience in marketing or performance analytics roles for paid media, content creators.
  • Previous experience in reporting and dashboards, data infrastructure, and queries to track key marketing metrics across multiple data sources leveraging SQL, R/Python, Tableau, and other data/visualization tools; monitor for changes in trends, share insights and make recommendations
  • Familiarity of different paid media measurement options, such as conversion APIs (CAPI), brand lift surveys, conversion lift studies, and audience hold outs.
  • Experience with statistical methods such as regression and hypothesis testing
  • Fluent in French

title: Designer - ASOS Design
description:
THE ROLE

We are looking for a talented Designer who knows how to blend high-end aesthetic value with commercial appeal. You’ll have spent time working in a casual jersey based department or brand, understanding the category and the product from elevated entry price point basics with premium finishing to sweats to graphics and license. Understanding the mix of customer types within the department from feminine to true casual. You will support the design direction for our trend collections translating creative design concepts & runway trends into an accessible, high-quality jersey range that our fashion-obsessed community will love.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Owning the aesthetic: Supporting the Senior Designer and Head of Design with the design process from initial concept, mood boards, and colour palettes to final product sign-off.
  • Elevating our product: Infuse your mid-market luxury expertise into our collections, focusing on premium fabric sourcing, intricate detailing, and superior fit.
  • Chasing trends: Constantly research global street style, runway shows, and cultural shifts to ensure our premium ranges are ahead of the curve.
  • Collaborating across teams: Work hand-in-hand with our Buyers, Merchandisers, and Garment Technologists to bring your vision to life without compromising on quality or pace.
  • Presenting with impact: Pitch your concepts and ranges to senior stakeholders with confidence, clarity, and passion.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced designer: You have a proven track record designing jersey product and understand jersey fabrications.
  • An eye for new and emerging trend: You can spot the latest trends building on casual jersey, from catwalk to social media to high street competitors.
  • Perfect eye for graphics and license: You have experience of building inspirational graphic collections. Desireable if you have had experience within license product development.
  • Fabric and fit obsessed: You have an eye for detail and a deep understanding of jersey garment construction.
  • Commercial yet creative: You know how to balance design aesthetic with the commercial reality of what sells online.
  • A fast-paced thinker: You thrive in an environment that moves quickly and can easily pivot when new trends emerge.
  • A digital native: You are highly proficient in Procreate, Photoshop, and the latest AI Digital Design Tools.

What’s in it for you?

  • Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)
  • ASOS Develops (personal development opportunities across the business)
  • Employee sample sales
  • Access to a huge range of LinkedIn learning materials
  • 25 days paid annual leave + an extra day for your birthday
  • Discretionary performance related bonus scheme
  • Private medical care scheme
  • Flexible benefits allowance - which you can choose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits

title: #EG Senior / AI Native Builders
description:
As a Senior / AI Native Builder in AI Central, you will help build, productise, and deploy AI-powered products, MVPs, reusable assets, and new ventures for regulated and mission-critical sectors. You will work in live client contexts, turning ambiguous business challenges into working solutions that can be tested, adopted, and scaled across Singapore and the wider Asia Pacific region.

AI Central is NCS’s enterprise AI capability spine, responsible for building differentiated AI platforms and reusable assets across sectors such as aviation, land transport, public safety, telecommunications, and government.

What will you do?

AI Product & Solution Delivery

  • Lead the journey from client problem statement to working prototype, MVP, or deployable AI solution.
  • Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear product hypotheses, technical approaches, and execution plans.
  • Build and ship AI-enabled solutions using software engineering, model orchestration, automation, and design tools.
  • Drive fast experiments and iterative delivery cycles to validate desirability, feasibility, and business value.

Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work directly with client technology and business leaders to understand business needs and shape AI-enabled products.
  • Advise senior stakeholders on AI investment priorities, architecture decisions, and build-versus-buy choices.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and help create clarity through practical, outcome-focused execution.

AI Engineering, Quality & Delivery Judgement

  • Make sound trade-offs across speed, quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and business value.
  • Apply modern AI tooling, including LLM application patterns, orchestration frameworks, automation platforms, evaluation approaches, and model limitations.
  • Balance rapid experimentation with strong engineering discipline, especially in enterprise and regulated environments.

Reusable Assets, Methodology & Scaling

  • Own the AI delivery methodology for your assigned sector vertical.
  • Build and maintain reusable patterns, playbooks, and working practices that help NCS scale AI-native delivery across sectors and geographies.
  • Document and abstract solutions from Singapore lighthouse accounts so they can be adapted for regional deployment.

Team Enablement & Capability Building

  • Support the technical onboarding and capability development of engineers joining your team.
  • Share what works across AI Central and contribute to the broader adoption of AI-native delivery practices within NCS.
  • Stay current with emerging AI tools, methods, and frameworks, applying them where they create measurable advantage.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with experience building and integrating production-grade applications.
  • Demonstrated 1-3 years of experience delivering AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions in real-world settings.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI tooling, including LLM application patterns, orchestration frameworks, automation platforms, evaluation approaches, and model limitations.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and deliver outcomes at pace.
  • Strong product instinct, engineering depth, business acumen, critical thinking, and technical judgement.
  • Ability to balance experimentation with security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate business needs into technical execution and advise at executive level.
  • Comfort working with senior stakeholders and challenging assumptions constructively.
  • Fluency in using AI as a practical multiplier across design, code, research, documentation, and delivery.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Good to have

  • Experience in consulting, venture building, startup environments, or innovation teams.
  • Experience deploying AI solutions in enterprise or regulated environments such as aviation, land transport, public safety, telecommunications, or government.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, analytics, and observability.
  • Experience shaping early-stage products with users and iterating based on feedback.
  • Regional exposure, including experience designing or adapting solutions across multiple Asia Pacific markets.

Why Join NCS?

Grow with Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI products that shape the future of technology
  • Collaborate with talented, passionate teams across research, engineering, and design
  • Access continuous learning opportunities and career development pathways

Make an Impact

  • Transform AI research into products that solve real problems for clients and users
  • Drive innovation in a leading Technology Services Firm with regional presence
  • Contribute to building a better future through responsible, human-centred AI

Thrive in Our Culture

  • Experience a human-to-human approach where relationships and collaboration matter
  • Be part of Team NCS, where bold ideas meet practical execution
  • Enjoy a supportive environment that values diversity, inclusion, and respect

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

Job Description:

We are GDIT. We support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the country. At GDIT, cyber security is not just a singular part of our mission—it connects every one of us because it's embedded into every aspect of what we do.

GDIT is your place. You make it your own by bringing your ideas and unique perspective to our culture. By owning your opportunity at GDIT, you are helping us ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Sr. Network Engineer with TS/SCI security clearance and willing to take CI Polygraph in joining our team to support our intelligence customer activities in Springfield, VA or St. Louis, MO.

In this role, a typical day will include:

Support customer's Data Center network, application delivery, and network security environments to include operations and maintenance (O&M), system integration/deployment and solution development/design. Provide tier III SME level support within the incident management process. Work independently with project stakeholders, system owners, project managers, and technical staff to deploy or enhance IT solutions.

◦Coordinate with project staff for solution development and deployment while managing project aspects within applicable technical area of responsibility.

◦Collaborate with system engineers across teams and disciplines to ensure solutions meet established technical goals and are deployed within established timelines.

◦Evaluates new network technologies and makes recommendations to stakeholders regarding the integration of these technologies into the existing network.

◦Develops and implements methodologies for analysis, testing, and support of LAN and WAN networks

◦Diagnose hardware and software problems and replace defective components.

◦Support operations and maintain activities and administer networks including hardware, systems software, applications software, and all configurations.

◦Ensure systems are integrated with existing performance and availability management framework.

◦Schedule and coordinate systems changes within the established change management framework.

◦Evaluate new system hardware and software to ensure optimal integration with existing hardware and compliance with customer standards.

◦Prepare technical proposals for presentation to the engineering review boards for adding new technologies to the network.

◦Perform a full range of upgrades in accordance with existing network architecture.

◦Review user requests for upgrades or additions to the network to assess impact on network performance and provide advice and guidance on the most practical technical approach to meeting user requirements.

◦Perform long term O&M activities to include tier 3 troubleshooting and problem resolution.

◦Interface with external tier 4 support staff and vendor support as required for problem resolution.

◦Utilize complex network analysis tools to identify and correct problems in the network while maintaining logs and records associated with reported problems or situations.

◦Prepare troubleshooting procedures for restoring the network to optimal performance levels.

◦Develop and document standard operating procedures (SOP) for use by technical support staff.

◦Provide fault management for the network and supports performance management functions.

Qualifications

◦SME level understanding and experience with dynamic routing protocols to include OSPF and BGP.

◦Professional or expert level certifications (at a minimum CCNP, F5-CTS or JNCIP) - CCIE/F5-CSE/JNCIE preferred

◦SME level understanding of data center technologies. Familiarity with EVPN, VXLAN, Cisco vPC, ACI, F5 load balancing and RSTP is a plus.

◦Experience with Cisco, F5, Juniper and Palo Alto hardware and operating systems is a plus.

◦Understanding and experience analyzing TCP/UDP application flow using external network analyzers along with built-in network switch/router diagnostic tools.

◦Familiarity with DOD STIGs and SD-WAN.

◦Experience with MS Visio and documenting network architectures and application flows.

◦Strong oral and written communication skills.

◦Effective at communicating technical ideas through presentations, documentation, meetings.

◦Learn and evaluate new technologies.

◦The candidate will be responsible for managing their own projects from start to finish so initiative, time management, and attention to detail are critical traits and skills.

◦10 years of experience preferred with several years focusing specifically on data center networking and technologies

title: RESIDENTIAL TREATMENT-DIRECT CARE-OVERNIGHTS-MASON CITY
description:
When the Rest of the World Is Sleeping, Your Work Still Matters.

The overnight hours may be quieter but they are just as important.

For the children and teens in our care, feeling safe and supported doesn't stop at the end of the day. They need someone they can count on through the night. Someone who provides consistency. Someone who stays calm when a difficult night happens. Someone who makes sure they wake up to a safe, structured environment and are ready for a new day.

As an Overnight Youth Services Worker with Four Oaks' Mason City PMIC program, you will provide overnight care and supervision for boys and girls ages 7–17 receiving residential behavioral health treatment.

If you're dependable, calm under pressure, and looking for meaningful overnight work, this could be the opportunity for you.

What is PMIC?

Our Psychiatric Medical Institution for Children (PMIC) program provides residential treatment and support for children and teens who need a higher level of care.

Our team provides a safe, structured, and therapeutic environment where youth can develop coping skills, build healthier behaviors, strengthen relationships, and work toward their individual treatment goals.

As an Overnight Youth Services Worker, your primary focus is maintaining a safe, secure, and supportive environment throughout the night.

Overnight staff are an important part of our treatment team. You're not simply watching a building overnight—you're helping maintain the stability, safety, and consistency our youth need to be successful.

We also understand that different schedules work for different people, which is why we offer full-time, part-time eligible, and part-time overnight opportunities.

Be the Person Who Keeps the Night Safe and the Next Day Moving Forward!

title: 9772 (TEX) -Quality Assurance Support Specialist
description:
The Early Learning Division administers core department strategies that advance opportunities in support of teacher preparation and compensation, enhance program quality, and improve early care and education affordability and access; and collaborates closely with the other DEC divisions to form a cross-sector approach that ensures universal developmental screening that promotes access to health and mental health services for children and their families; and that families have opportunities for social and professional connections, linkage to resources, and information on parenting and child development.

The Early Learning Division is building a high-quality early care and education system that improves equitable access to high-quality, affordable early care and education for all children from birth to five years of age to provide the best start in life and enter kindergarten ready to succeed and focuses on:

  • Developing and supporting opportunities that achieve continuous eligibility for families and continuity of care for children ages birth to five.
  • Using a racial equity framework that creates the conditions that will ensure school readiness experiences.
  • Ensures that quality and assessment systems are responsive to the diverse needs of ECE programs and the children they serve.
  • Embracing culturally responsive and linguistically appropriate environments across a mixed delivery system.
  • Support policies and strategies that enhance coherence and alignment for Universal PreK (UPK).

Under the supervision of the 9774 Program Quality Assurance Officer, the 9772 Quality Assurance Support Specialist will be responsible for a variety of administrative and programmatic support responsibilities that include and are not limited to:

  • Representing the Department of Early Childhood/Early Learning Division to programs, educators, and funded partners.
  • Managing and supporting communications and relationships with funded programs.
  • Organizing and tracking information in written and electronic formats.
  • Develop correspondence and other key documents for stakeholders.
  • Coordinating intra-office communication and workflows.
  • Managing logistics for community, educational and other DEC sponsored events.
  • Provide technical assistance to project personnel, funded partners, and community.
  • Provide administrative and logistical support to Program Officers who conduct program site visits.
  • Participate in and lead program site visits.
  • Support the development of reports related to Program Quality Assurance.
  • Support tracking and analysis of validation and quality monitoring systems.
  • Support work with Access and Enrollment team ensuring alignment across monitoring systems.
  • Support grant management and assessment.
  • Support the DEC on funding policy and strategy development related to Baby Prop C and other funding sources.
  • Responsible for support and implementation of the DEC Strategic plan with concentration of racial equity strategies and early learning core values.
  • May occasionally work evenings and weekends, and travel regionally and nationally.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

1. Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university AND two (2) years of administrative/professional experience in community development, housing and/or housing development, workforce development, finance, education, social work, children/youth work, criminal justice or elections related work; OR

2. Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university with a major in one of the following fields: public or business administration, urban planning, government, social work, education, finance or criminal justice AND one (1) year of administrative/professional experience in community development, housing and/or housing development, workforce development, finance, education, social work, children/youth work, criminal justice or elections related work; OR

3. Possession of a Master's degree from an accredited college or university in public policy, planning, social work, public administration, finance, education, criminal justice, or business administration; OR

4. Possession of a Ph.D. or Juris Doctor degree from an accredited college or university.

title: Studio Experience Team - The Circle - Long Beach
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

In doing our part to make yoga more accessible to all, we have created a role that will allow us to positively impact the student experience at each of our studios and provide a discount on our studio membership. A CorePower Yoga (CPY) Studio Experience Team (SET) member is an important role to our overall student experience. We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a SET member. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining a clean and hygienic environment for our yoga studio, ensuring that it is always ready for use by our community.

As a SET member you can deepen your connection with the CPY community and strengthen your personal yoga practice by taking advantage of a special discounted yoga membership (prices and max hours vary by market). Additionally, our SET members exhibit the Company’s Core Values of Empower Everyone, Practice Gratitude, Build Community, Grow Forward, & Laugh Together.

If you are passionate about cleanliness and take pride in creating a welcoming and serene environment, we would love to hear from you. This is a part-time position in which our SET members commit to up to six hours of studio shifts per month.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

  • Clean and disinfect all areas of the yoga studio, including floors, walls, mirrors, windows, and surfaces.

  • Maintain the cleanliness of the reception area, changing rooms, and bathrooms.

  • Ensure that yoga props and equipment, such as mats, blocks, and straps, are clean and organized.

  • Restock supplies, such as paper towels, toilet paper, and soap.

  • Take out the trash and recycling ensuring that all waste is properly disposed of.

  • Assist with laundry, including folding towels and other linens.

  • Notify management of any maintenance or repair needs in the studio.

  • Must be able to commit to a schedule and follow the CPY Time and Attendance Policy.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to commit to 6 hours per month (schedule varies based on studio need).

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Knowledge of proper cleaning techniques and disinfectants.

  • Ability to lift and move heavy equipment, such as yoga mats and props.

description:
Job Description:

Primary Responsibility

The adjunct faculty members of Colorado Mountain College are here to assist students in their learning process by utilizing all appropriate staff resources, materials, facilities, and educational technologies available which complement the teaching process. The faculty members needs to be committed to facilitating learning throughout our communities. Although teaching is the most important role of the faculty, the needs of our learners are also served when faculty are engaged in scholarly endeavors as well as service activities.

The college seeks innovative facilitators of learning who are active in the art of teaching and passionate about extending academic opportunities to all students. Colorado Mountain College is an institution offering associate and bachelor’s degrees with a focus on positive classroom experiences and excellent outcomes for all students. CMC does not conduct research but instead focuses on excellence in teaching and learning in diverse classroom settings and programs. Successful candidates will demonstrate a passion for dynamic classroom experiences and excellent academic opportunities and student support.

Pre-requisites for Position (Qualifications Standards)

Qualified candidates must be credentialed to teach in the specific program or eligible to be credentialed. Examples of ideal qualifications include:

A minimum of a master’s degree in a specific degree for the position being recruited or a Master’s Degree with a minimum of 18 graduate credits in a specifically related field. Example for business: (business, finance, management, marketing, or related fields). Minimum of one-year full-time teaching experience, or the equivalent as an adjunct instructor. Higher education teaching experience preferred.

An equivalent/applicable combination of education and experience to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position required.

Special Skills or abilities directly applicable to the position: knowledge with pedagogy, and teaching experience equating to two years. Must possess a strong background in computers and technology, excellent organizational skills, general office skills (filing, typing, answering the phone, customer oriented and attention to detail); excellent communication and interpersonal skills, willingness to learn, ability to research and effectively analyze data, work independently towards established goals and deadlines.

Welcoming. Innovative. Focused on Student Success. These principles reflect the soul of CMC. They guide us in building our teams, cultivating leaders, and expanding our approaches and mindset. They guide us to be an institution of higher education that’s the right fit for every faculty member, staff, student, and community member in its trust. Applicants must demonstrate a commitment to working effectively with students, employees, and community members of all backgrounds.

Each role at Colorado Mountain College contributes to the institution’s sustainability initiatives by fostering environmental stewardship, supporting sustainable practices in daily operations, and advancing a culture of ecological responsibility that aligns with our commitment to balance the needs of current generations not to compromise the needs of future generations.

Bilingual (English/Spanish) or conversational language abilities preferred.

Colorado Mountain College requires that employees perform their assigned duties within the State of Colorado. The College further expects employees to accurately report their work location at all times. Failure to do so impairs the College's ability to ensure compliance with tax, payroll, employment, information security, and operational requirements.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Minimum Qualifications:

Essential Duties

The following responsibilities and activities are listed to maintain consistency in the application of expectations and align job duties with evaluation and promotion procedures.

Teaching responsibilities expected of all faculty include teaching course load as assigned, evaluate courses and assess student learning, meet established course, program and learning outcomes, comply with guidelines and policies, maintain office hours per established standards, develop rapport with students, assist with and participate in advising, orientation and registration activities.

CMC Faculty are expected to engage in scholarly and creative activities that enhance discipline expertise and enhance learning. Service activities such as campus and college committees, participate in relevant projects, mentor peers, participate in and assist with assessment activities, program review, student organization, recruiting and retention.

All faculty acknowledge that final payment of any contract may be withheld until submission of grades is complete.

  • To teach classes as assigned by designated supervisor.

Supervision of the Position

This position will report to the Assistant Dean of Instruction or designee in alignment with discipline deans.

Supervisory Responsibility

The position may supervise student employees. Special Conditions of Employment Successful completion of a background check will be required as well as motor vehicles records report when applicable. Incumbents in this position will adhere to all safety and compliance policies of Colorado Mountain College while performing all duties assigned. May require travel and evening and/or weekend hours.

This position requires constant sitting, occasional walking, standing and driving; occasional handling objects, pushing/pulling; frequent reaching with hands/arms, and use of finger movements; occasional lifting, carrying, pushing or pulling objects up to 50 lbs. Constant written and oral communication and the ability to reason and analyze and perform calculations occasionally. Work is performed using a computer and standard office equipment daily and driving a vehicle occasionally.

title: Product Manager, CJKI
description:
About the Group/Team
Canva’s mission is to empower the world to design. With over 220 million users already on board, we have a bold vision to reach 1 billion users. The CJKI Group is dedicated to this mission, pouring our hearts and souls into driving hyperlocalization. We strive to make Canva feel like a local experience in China, Japan, South Korea, and India, ensuring that our platform resonates deeply with users in these regions.


About the Role/Specialty
This role is for a high-performance, highly efficient Product Manager who thrives without a fixed lane — focusing on high-impact, high-ambiguity initiatives across Canva's core growth entry points and platform-level experiences, and moving across domains and markets as business priorities requires. You will operate in a highly complex organizational environment, driving alignment, making clear trade-offs, and delivering measurable outcomes quickly, in unfamiliar territory, with minimal ramp-up time

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

Big Bets Project Owner (CJKI Scope)

  • Own end-to-end product strategy, execution, and outcomes for major initiatives
  • Translate global product vision into actionable, market-appropriate solutions for CJKI
  • Define MBR metrics (input, output & guardrails) and continuously track impact

Product Strategy & Decision-Making

  • Rapidly build deep understanding of user behavior and pain points in whatever domain or market you’re deployed to
  • Make high-quality decisions under uncertainty, even with incomplete data or insights
  • Balance global consistency vs. regional differentiation, clearly articulating trade-offs

Cross-functional Collaboration & Influence

  • Partner closely with Growth, Subscription, Homepage, Brand, Design, Infra, Data, Marketing, and other teams
  • Quickly building credibility with new partners each time you move onto a new initiative
  • Drive alignment and execution without direct reporting authority
  • Communicate progress, risks, and key decisions clearly to senior stakeholders, including Big Bets leaders

Experimentation & Iteration

  • Reduce uncertainty through A/B testing, phased rollouts, and experimentation frameworks — grounding every experiment in a clearly articulated intent and hypothesis, with input metrics, outcome metrics, and guardrails defined upfront rather than after the fact.
  • Learn quickly, iterate rapidly, and strike the right balance between speed and quality, treating every result — positive or negative — as a source of durable learning rather than a simple ship/no-ship verdict

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • 5–8+ years of Product Management experience, with ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
  • Strong experience in Growth or Monetization, with a demonstrated track record of being able to move across multiple product domains rather than staying only in a single lane — you're energized by picking up new problem spaces quickly, not just going deep in one.
  • Strong structured thinking: breaks down ambiguous problems with rigor, reasons through edge cases and second-order effects before committing to a direction, rather than jumping straight to a solution
  • Clear communicator and documenter: translates that thinking into thorough PRDs, tailors messages to the audience, and stays organized — tracking work in Jira and keeping stakeholders proactively updated
  • Strong data fluency, able to combine data and user insights to drive decisions
  • Deep understanding of at least one CJKI market (China / Japan / Korea/ India), with the ability to scale insights beyond a single market
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders you haven’t worked with before
  • Actively uses AI to amplify their own output and impact — from speeding up research to prototyping and finding new ways AI can extend what one PM can cover across multiple initiatives — rather than treating AI as optional or someone else's job
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working in a global context

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with product growth, ecommerce, or subscription domain
  • Proven success handling regional differentiation and localization in global products
  • Background in B2C or Product-Led Growth (PLG) environments
