title: Community Health Worker
company: Community Action Partnership of Orange County
location: El Modena Family Resource Center - Orange, CA 92869
description:
OUR EXCITING OPPORTUNITY

Community Action Partnership has an exciting opportunity for

Community Health Worker

In this role, the Community Health Worker (CHW) will assist the CalAIM Housing Navigation and/or the Enhanced Care Management programs and Family Resource Centers by providing support to participants. The CHW will act as an intermediary between their participants and healthcare and/or social services providers, playing a critical part in the work and dedication of Community Action Partnership of Orange County’s initiatives. It’s leadership with a cause and the rewards are immeasurable!

Who we are

Born out of the War on Poverty more than 50 years ago, Community Action Partnership Orange County (CAP OC) is a trusted resource for Orange County community members who face obstacles such as food insecurity, unemployment, economic turmoil and more. We walk alongside the people we serve, and we act to meet immediate needs without delay. Our programs help empower people to improve their lives and their communities. We see poverty as an unacceptable reality for our neighbors and rally with key partners to help facilitate change.

CAP OC hires professionals who support and embody the following EPIC values:

Going above and beyond in every interaction and activity we undertake. We strive for EXCELLENCE in service, keeping a pulse on the most up to date innovations within our industry. Together we continually assess and improve the way to work and enhance the strategies we utilize to meet the needs of our community.

Reaching our goals by working collaboratively with each other and our community. We are working to do the things that have not been done: empowering families and individuals to financial independence, breaking the cycle of poverty, creating financial equity, combating food insecurity, and establishing healthy and energy-efficient living conditions for all through social innovation. All of this takes PROACTIVENESS, and an intrinsic motivation that drives us to go above and beyond to create cutting-edge trends and program designs. We have the will and the energy and won't stop until the needs of our underserved community no longer exist.

We are a team of high INNOVATION. We value the work we do; the people we serve; and treat each other with respect and kindness. We also have an environment of engaging in social economic justice by sharing of ideas and not afraid to try new things that increases our educational capacity. We think outside of the box, and challenge prevailing assumptions about issues of poverty.

Reaching our goals by working in partnership with each other and our community. The work we do is deeply rooted in the COLLABORATION we have with our community and its citizens. We care about the legacy of community action partnership and go above and beyond to ensure we support each other in bringing forth the services and resources that will positively change generations forever.

We have remained true to our mission “We seek to end poverty by stabilizing, sustaining and empowering people with the resources they need when they need them. By forging strategic partnerships, we form a powerful force to improve our community.”

values

In addition to our EPIC values our external values are as follows:

Leadership

We are guiding critical shifts in how people think and act to address the root causes of poverty

Collaboration

We bring together all capable partners to achieve transformative results

Trust

For over 50 years, the community has counted on us to empower those in need

Compassion

We treat each person we serve respectfully and with great care

Justice

We are passionate about advocating for those living in poverty and creating equity throughout the region

WHAT YOU WILL ACCOMPLISH IN THIS ROLE

The Community Health Worker will function as an integrated team member by providing support for the Housing Navigation, Enhanced Care Management programs, and Family Resource Centers. The Community Health Worker will provide support to the most vulnerable population, including but not limited to individuals experiencing homelessness, high utilizers, and/or youth involved in child welfare by helping them navigate their health and social needs.

The salary for this position is $23.00 - $24.00 per hour.

Required: Bilingual in English/Spanish, both written and oral forms.

The work schedule for the Community Health Worker does not allow for a remote or hybrid work schedule. Occasional evening and weekend hours may be required.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Engage with the community through various outreach activities and distributions through a screening process to help clients access and connect to case management services.
  • Collaborate with partners providing programs and services for participants of the FRCs and CAP OC.
  • Assist with FRC programs and services including but not limited to front desk and in office coverage, food and diaper distributions, seasonal activities, senior programs, workshops, health education, etc.
  • Play an active role within the Housing Navigation and ECM program by assisting members in completing forms, applications, and or intakes required to receive needed services or community resources. Provide client support in the field as needed. Including client's home, shelter, hospital, and skill nursing facilities, etc.
  • Provide tailored support to help members achieve their goals.
  • Provide and facilitate members with community resources, referrals, or services as needed.
  • Gain familiarity with eligibility requirements for the Medi-Cal and CalFresh programs
  • Assist participants through BenefitsCal.com application process for Medi-Cal and CalFresh
  • Conduct outreach through home visits.
  • Gather clinical information and assist with coordinating post-discharge services, including scheduling provider appointments, ensuring post-discharge referrals are received by the member, transportation to appointments is arranged, and members are aware of follow-care needs
  • Assist members with the coordination and navigation of the health care system and processes.
  • Provide culturally appropriate health education and information to members.
  • Educate members about preventative health measures and healthy lifestyle choices.
  • Assist with conducting member needs and or health assessments.
  • Assist members with move-in tasks such as but not limited to identifying and coordinating the purchase and delivery of housing deposit items.
  • Accompany members to office visits as needed.
  • Visit and monitor members at the hospital/skill nursing facility, etc.
  • Participates in agency team meetings and training as required.
  • Complete and submit program reports on a scheduled basis or as needed.
  • Maintain accurate records of all patient contacts
  • Monitor and upkeep data entry on Apricot software system
  • Participates in community events, health fairs, and or supportive services events
  • Employ motivational interviewing, trauma-informed care, and harm-reduction approaches.
  • Fulfill other duties, as assigned.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE IN

  • Knowledge of homeless and housing services, case management, financial literacy, financial stability and poverty issues.
  • Knowledge of community resources and experience working with a variety of community-based organizations preferred.
  • Planning and organizational techniques to develop and implement action plans.
  • Basic teaching, training skills and techniques, and public speaking skills.
  • Analyzing and interpreting various materials to make recommendations, understand and apply program rules, regulations and procedures.
  • General knowledge of conducting assessments to identify member’s medical, social, and psychological needs and using various assessment tools and methodologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational abilities to manage multiple tasks and assignments.
  • Efficient in prioritizing tasks and ensuring timely service delivery.
  • Capable of identifying issues, developing solutions, and implementing changes to improve member care.
  • Strong critical thinking skills for quick, informed decision-making.
  • Empathetic and skilled in building trusting relationships with members and families.
  • Understanding of member privacy laws, such as HIPAA, to ensure confidentiality.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team

IDEAL CANDIDATE MUST BE

  • Customer service oriented: Establish and maintain effective working relationships with CAP OC’s staff, clients, and representatives of other organizations.
  • Ethically Focused: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the organization.
  • Inclusive: Work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals, resolve problems, and make decisions that enhance organizational and program effectiveness.
  • Leader: Positively influence others to achieve results that are in the best interest of the organization and participants.
  • Work focused: Being detail-oriented while working accurately and efficiently on a consistent basis without assistance. Strong organizational skills.
  • Flexible: Work locations may vary at CAP OC’s other locations such as FRCs, Orangewood office, etc. and working in the community, which can include working outdoors in varying temperatures and weather conditions.
  • May require working weekends/ evenings/ holidays when/if needed to meet client/production demands. Workdays and hours of work are subject to change.
  • Language skilled: Must demonstrate clear, concise, and effective communication skills both orally and in writing in English and Spanish.
  • Effectively create/present information and respond to questions from staff, clients, media groups, and the public
  • Mathematical: Promptly and correctly create, compose, and complete mathematical equations on a computer and/or to complete forms for reports and/or presentations. Compile numbers, statistical data, and obtain other information for forms, reports, and presentations.
  • Computer literate: Competently use the Internet, Web based databases, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Publisher and Access) and other applications. Experience with virtual communication platforms. Use a variety of computer databases to ensure that client records, statistics and reports are completed.

Job Description:

The SCA is responsible for conducting a comprehensive assessment of the management, operational, and technical security controls employed within or inherited by an IS to determine the overall effectiveness of the controls (i.e., the extent to which the controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting the security requirements for the system).

SCAs also provide an assessment of the severity of weaknesses or deficiencies discovered in the IS and its environment of operation and recommend corrective actions to address identified vulnerabilities. Responsibilities will cover Collateral, Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Program (SAP) activities within the customer’s area of responsibility.

  • Perform oversight of the development, implementation and evaluation of IS security program policy; special emphasis placed upon integration of existing SAP network infrastructure.

  • Perform assessment of ISs, based upon the Risk Management Framework (RMF) methodology in accordance with the Joint Special Access Program (SAP) Implementation Guide (JSIG)

  • Advise the Information System Owner (ISO), Information Data Owner (IDO), Program Security Officer (PSO), and the Delegated and/or Authorizing Official (DAO/AO) on any assessment and authorization issues.

  • Evaluate IS threats and vulnerabilities to determine whether additional safeguards are required.

title: Sr. Engineer - Data Security
description:
Role Summary

The Sr. Data Security Engineer is responsible for the technical design and maturity of the controls that enforce Wynn Resorts' data processing policies. The role reports into the Executive Director of GRC, Architecture, and Data Security, takes ownership of the tools that protect data, and operationalizes company policy for the storage, classification, movement, protection, retention, and destruction of sensitive data. The Data Security team is a specialized function within Wynn's established, global Information Security organization; it concentrates on where sensitive data resides, how it moves, how it can be accessed, and ensures it is classified, protected, retained, and defensibly deleted, while partner security teams carry broader responsibility for networks, endpoints, operations, incident response, identity, etc.

The Sr. Data Security Engineer is the senior-most hands-on technical role in the Data Security team, and is an accomplished engineer experienced in technical areas including systems engineering, development, or data management, focused on applying data protection principles using industry standards and frameworks. The ideal candidate brings experience with the platforms where enterprise data lives and grows, and will demonstrate the capability to problem-solve, operate as the top point of technical escalation, and serve as a mentor to the Data Security Engineer and Analyst.

Job Responsibilities

  • Advance and mature the data security tools, developing expertise beyond vendor support across configuration, tuning, integration, and troubleshooting. As a customer to Wynn’s vendor partners, drive the vendor’s product roadmap to better serve Wynn’s security program.
  • Operationalize company policy for the storage, transmission, classification, and destruction of data into working controls, procedures, guidelines, and tooling.
  • Mature sensitivity labeling and DLP enforcement across unstructured and structured data, and restrict the movement of sensitive data within and outside the organization.
  • Identify data repositories with excessive access, inappropriate exposure, or inadequate security controls.
  • Work with data owners to remediate data-security risks.
  • Implement, manage, and advance data protection, retention, and lifecycle controls, including encryption at rest and in transit, obfuscation and masking, and privileged-access restriction, in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
  • Drive and optimize technical remediation efforts to enforce compliance against company security standards (encryption, obfuscation, privileged access) for Wynn-hosted structured data. Identify patterns and root cause for non-compliance, implement technical controls to remove friction while working with other teams to achieve success.
  • Restrict production data strictly to its intended environment, preventing unauthorized access to or replication in non-production areas.
  • Advance the effectiveness and efficiency of the tools used to inventory structured and unstructured data sources for evaluation against Wynn's policies and standards. Improve operational efficiency of driving remediation of gaps in access, storage, encryption, obfuscation, retention, and deletion.
  • Advance the effectiveness of the defensible deletion and data loss prevention (DLP) programs, supporting metrics and KPIs for evaluation by management.
  • Effectively enforce minimal access to sensitive data (permissions, roles, groups, users, and NHI across applications, SaaS, file shares, NTFS, and databases) through technical controls and data-sensitivity lens.
  • Build automations (scripting, workflow, and AI-enabled) that enhance the data security program, uplevel the GRC team's technical effectiveness where the two overlap on permissions, roles, and access, and fold more advanced data governance into the existing GRC program.
  • Develop department metrics and improvement opportunities that feed the KPI model reported to the Executive Director and CISO, covering how much data exists, how it moves, how it is accessed, and how effectively risk is reduced.
  • Support the Data Privacy team on labeling, disposition, and defensible deletion.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of relevant work experience in systems, data, or security. A college diploma or university degree in computer or data science or IT management is preferred but is not a substitute for experience
  • Strength in all of the program's technical areas (systems engineering, development and scripting, or data security) and the capability to focus on data protection, advancing the overall capabilities of the team. Hands-on experience with the platforms where enterprise data resides
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of a tool, develop expertise specific to that tool's capabilities and Wynn's environment, and advance that tool’s effectiveness
  • Hands-on experience with unstructured data storage such as NAS, SMB and CIFS shares, and cloud file-collaboration systems, including volume shadow copies, previous versions, and immutable backups, is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with structured data storage and processing such as on-premises and cloud DBMS (MySQL, MSSQL, OracleDB, and similar), including table relationships and primary and foreign-key handling, is a plus
  • Practical understanding of permissions, roles, groups, users, and Non-Human Identity (NHI) as they relate to authorized and unauthorized access to sensitive data across applications, SaaS, file shares, and databases
  • Demonstrated capability to advance industry-standard tools for DLP, sensitivity labeling, and record identification
  • Working knowledge of, or the ability to grow into, data minimization principles, supporting frameworks and control testing (SOX, Gaming Regulations, PCI-DSS), and data-residency requirements
  • Ability to create, manage, and continuously improve high-quality, accurate documentation
  • Understanding of project-management principles such as problem statements, use cases, and success criteria
  • High level of personal integrity and the judgment and maturity to handle highly sensitive data appropriately
  • A critical thinker and strong problem-solver who is detail-oriented, self-motivated, and disciplined, with excellent time-management skills. Ability to independently troubleshoot and solve technical issues and turn technical problems into proposed solutions
  • Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills for technical and business audiences
  • Poise and the ability to act calmly and competently in high-pressure, high-stress situations

Wynn Resorts is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. Wynn Resorts does not discriminate on the basis of disability, veteran status or any other basis protected under federal, state or local laws.

title: Power Platform Specialist
description:
CompanyOur client is a well-established, customer-focused organisation with a significant distribution network across the UK. Technology plays a central role in its ongoing transformation, supporting operations across retail, logistics, warehousing, merchandising, product, supplier management and finance.Following significant investment in its core business systems, the organisation is building greater internal capability across Microsoft Business Central, Power Apps and the wider Power Platform. This appointment will help the business take greater ownership of its systems, improve integration across its technology estate and identify new opportunities for automation and operational improvement.The successful candidate will join a collaborative IT function with access to experienced business stakeholders, ERP specialists, developers and trusted external technology partners.RoleThe Business Systems Specialist will be responsible for the ongoing development of a business-critical Retail Power App and its integration with Microsoft Business Central and other surrounding platforms.Working across the full delivery lifecycle, you will translate commercial and operational requirements into practical technical solutions. You will contribute to system architecture, deliver application enhancements and help the organisation make better use of its existing Microsoft technology.Key responsibilities will include:
  • Developing and maintaining applications using Microsoft Power Apps and the wider Power Platform
  • Supporting integrations between Power Apps, Business Central and third-party applications and services
  • Designing and delivering APIs, interfaces and system integrations
  • Translating business requirements and scoping documents into technical specifications and development solutions
  • Working with stakeholders to refine requirements, identify risks and recommend appropriate technical approaches
  • Identifying and delivering opportunities for process optimisation, workflow improvement and automation
  • Using configuration wherever possible to protect core application integrity and minimise technical debt
  • Delivering appropriate small and medium-sized technical changes internally
  • Contributing to the longer-term architecture of Business Central and associated business systems
  • Supporting the effective management of production, test and development environments
  • Investigating complex or escalated application issues that require deeper technical expertise
  • Monitoring and improving system performance across Power Apps, Power Platform and Dataverse
  • Maintaining high standards of data integrity, application security and technical documentation
  • Working constructively with external technology partners on larger or more complex solutions
  • Supporting continuous improvement across systems, development practices and delivery processes
This is a hands-on technical role rather than a purely functional or project management position. The successful candidate will be expected to understand what can be achieved through standard configuration, while also possessing the development and integration skills required to deliver changes beyond out-of-the-box functionality.The client is expecting candidates to be on site for a minimum of 3 days per week. Remote working or more flexible working arrangements are not an option.PersonCandidates should have substantial hands-on experience of Microsoft Power Apps and the associated Power Platform services, ideally gained within a complex retail, logistics, distribution or similarly operational environment.Essential requirements include:
  • At least five years’ experience working with Microsoft Power Apps and associated services
  • Strong practical knowledge of Power Platform development
  • Experience supporting business-critical retail and/or logistics applications
  • Demonstrable experience integrating Power Apps with Business Central and third-party systems
  • Good knowledge of APIs, interfaces and system integration principles
  • The technical capability to develop solutions, rather than solely gather requirements or manage external suppliers
  • Experience translating business requirements into clear technical specifications
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to review proposed solutions critically and identify risks, limitations and opportunities for improvement
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain technical subjects in clear business language
  • A customer-focused and commercially aware approach
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment
  • A proactive, self-motivated working style and the confidence to take ownership of delivery
  • The ability to work independently while making a positive contribution to a collaborative team
Experience in the following areas would be advantageous:
  • Microsoft Business Central, including configuration and technical development
  • Dataverse
  • Azure platforms and services
  • Azure integration or API management technologies
  • AL development
  • Application lifecycle management and structured development environments
  • A degree in a development-related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
The role would suit an experienced Power Platform specialist, Business Central technical consultant or business systems developer who wants to take genuine ownership of a strategically important technology environment. It offers the opportunity to improve existing systems, introduce better ways of working and make a visible contribution to a wider digital transformation programme.

title: Quality and Risk Business Partner
description:
Quality and Risk Business Partner
Location: Auckland (preferred), Wellington, Christchurch
Full-time | Fixed-term | Hybrid/Remote

Please note: While this is a primarily remote role, our strong preference is for someone based in Auckland to support occasional on-site collaboration and build strong relationships with key stakeholders. We may also consider candidates based in Christchurch or Wellington (our other main centres).

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Quality and Risk Business Partner to join us on a 12-month fixed-term basis and help strengthen quality, assessment and risk practices across our faculties and campuses.

Working closely with academic and operational leaders, you’ll provide practical advice and guidance across quality assurance, compliance, governance, assessment, moderation and risk. You’ll help identify areas for improvement, develop pragmatic solutions and support teams to embed sustainable quality practices that lead to strong outcomes for ākonga.

A key focus of the role will be providing oversight of assessment and moderation practices, identifying potential gaps or risks, and supporting appropriate improvement and remediation activity. You’ll also contribute to wider quality and risk initiatives, self-assessment activities and projects designed to strengthen organisational performance and capability.

This is a highly collaborative role where you’ll balance assurance and accountability with coaching, influence and practical support.

About You

You’ll bring strong experience within the tertiary education sector and be confident working across quality assurance, assessment, moderation, compliance and risk. You’ll be comfortable building trusted relationships with academic and operational leaders, while also being prepared to challenge practice constructively when improvement is needed.

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

  • Demonstrated experience in the New Zealand tertiary education sector, ideally within a PTE, ITP, wānanga, university or multi-campus provider
  • Strong experience in quality assurance, academic quality, programme management, assessment, moderation or regulatory compliance
  • Practical experience with pre- and post-assessment moderation and reviewing the quality of assessment practice
  • A strong understanding of NZQA requirements and the New Zealand tertiary regulatory environment
  • Experience identifying quality or compliance gaps and developing practical improvement or remediation plans
  • Strong relationship-building, influencing and communication skills
  • Confidence using evidence and data to support sound decision-making
  • A tertiary qualification in any discipline

You’ll also be pragmatic, solutions-focused and highly organised, with the confidence to navigate sensitive or contested matters calmly and objectively. You’ll bring a collaborative and culturally responsive approach, balancing assurance and accountability with support and capability building.

Why work with us?

Yoobee Colleges prides itself on supporting a diverse and inclusive culture - open to inputs from creative people of all genders, ethnicity, identity, thought and experiences. We are fast movers, action orientated, keen innovators, and quick thinkers who enjoy a workplace that is inspiring and fun.

  • Be a driving force for one of NZ’s Largest specialist PTE
  • Rewarding opportunity to support students in their journey pursuing their education
  • Strong commitment to your professional growth & development
  • Amazing work culture that is highly collaborative and supportive

To Apply:

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted as applications are received.

Questions about your identity help us appreciate the diversity of individuals looking to work with us, ensuring we’re attracting applications from people with identities and perspectives that are as diverse as our students.

We are an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to equity, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Team Leader - Water Planning Delivery
description:
He kōrero mō mātou | About Watercare

Ki te ora te wai, ka ora te whenua, ka ora te tangata
When the water is healthy, the land and the people are healthy

Now is an exciting time to join Watercare, we're planning to spend $14 billion over the next 10 years to ensure we can continue to support our growing city in a climate-resilient way. When you average that out, that's an investment of $3.8 million every day!

He whakamārama mō te tūranga mahi | About the role

You'll lead Watercare's Water Planning Delivery function, translating strategic priorities and the Asset Management Plan into a coordinated, investment-ready portfolio of infrastructure initiatives.

You'll provide strategic leadership across business need definition, feasibility and transition into design and delivery, ensuring projects are well defined, appropriately prioritised and positioned for successful downstream delivery. You'll own performance across a portfolio of concurrent and interdependent work, balancing outcomes, affordability, resources, risk and delivery readiness.

You'll work closely with senior leaders, operational teams, Auckland Council, iwi partners, consultants, and community stakeholders to ensure infrastructure decisions are informed, sustainable, and aligned with future growth requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and developing the Water Planning Delivery function and its team of project managers, with clear expectations, consistent disciplines and a strong performance culture.
  • Translating Watercare's strategic objectives, enterprise risks and growth priorities into clear portfolio and investment priorities.
  • Owning the definition, feasibility and transition of water infrastructure projects into design and delivery.
  • Driving robust project definition, option assessment and business cases that improve cost, schedule and risk confidence.
  • Managing portfolio performance across scope, budgets, forecasts, schedules, dependencies, resources and risk.
  • Providing strategic advice on investment choices, trade-offs, delivery implications and emerging portfolio risks.
  • Leading portfolio governance, assurance, change control and consistent project-management disciplines.
  • Directing the effective use of consultants and strategic partners while growing Watercare’s internal capability.
  • Building strong interfaces with technical planning, Programme Delivery, Operations, Consenting and Finance.
  • Influencing senior internal and external stakeholders and communicating complex decisions clearly.
  • Embedding sustainability, whole-of-life value, safety and wellbeing in planning and investment decisions.

Ngā pūkenga e rapu nei mātou | About you

You'll be a strategic infrastructure leader who can move confidently between long-term direction, investment decisions and practical delivery. You'll bring structure and momentum to a complex portfolio, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and build alignment across technical, operational, commercial and stakeholder interests.

You'll bring:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related discipline
  • At least 10 years' experience managing large-scale infrastructure programmes or projects
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience
  • Strong judgement across investment, affordability, risk, delivery trade-offs, commercial management and contract management.
  • Experience improving front-end project definition and successfully transitioning work into design and delivery.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence at senior leadership level
  • Sound knowledge of New Zealand's regulatory environment and infrastructure planning frameworks
  • Experience acting as an informed client and directing multidisciplinary professional-services partners.

Experience in water, wastewater, utilities or related infrastructure sectors will be highly regarded, as will project or programme management certifications such as PMP, PgMP or MSP.

Ngā hua mōu | What's in it for you

We offer a competitive salary and staff benefits package including:
• Training and development opportunities
• Life and income protection insurance plans
• Generous parental leave
• Employee discounts at a range of large retailers

  • Architect and oversee the design and implementation of platform-wide services, frameworks, and standards.

title: Siivooja
description:
Haemme siivoojia Joensuuhun

Oletko kiinnostunut työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ja ihmisläheisessä ympäristössä, jossa arvostus, luottamus ja sitoutuminen näkyvät arjen teoissa ja tarjotaan mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja kasvaa? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.

Työskentelypaikkasi tulee työsuhteen alussa olemaan erilaiset toimitilakohteet, kuten kauppakeskus, tehtaas ja rappukohteet. Töitä tehdään pääsääntöisesti varhais arki aamuisin kello 6.00 alkaen. Tehtävässä vastaat asiakaskohteemme siisteydestä itsenäisesti sekä muista puhtaanapitopalveluihin liittyvistä asiakaspalvelutehtävistä ja toimit tärkeässä roolissa arjen sujuvuuden varmistamisessa. Työskentelet vastuullisesti ja noudatat työssäsi turvallisuus- ja laatukäytäntöjä sekä huolehdit työympäristöstäsi.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muunmuassa

  • Päivittäistä siivous- ja ylläpitotehtäviä

  • Koneelliset peruspesut

  • Vahaukset

  • Ikkunanpesu

  • Työn laadun varmistamisen omassa työssä

  • Työvälineiden ja aineiden asianmukaisen käytön ja niistä huolehtimisen

  • Yhteistyön asiakkaan ja työyhteisön kanssa

  • Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti ja huolellisesti

  • Vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

  • Halu oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista

Odotamme sinulta

  • Työohjeiden ymmärtämistä, kommunikointia työsuhteen hoitamiseksi sekä turvallisen työskentelyn varmistamiseksi suomeksi tai englanniksi. Työ ei siis edellytä sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja englannin kielen taito voi korvata suomen kielen osaamisen. Arvostamme monimuotoista työyhteisöä, jossa eri kieli- ja kulttuuritaustat ovat vahvuus

  • Toimintatapaa, joka tukee turvallista, yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä

  • Mikäli et ole Suomen kansalainen, sinulla tulee olla voimassa oleva työlupa

  • Ajokorttia

  • Eduksi katsotaan seuraavia asioita: alan koulutus, perehtyneisyys työhön, hygieniapassi, työturvallisuuskortti, oman auton käyttömahdoliissuus

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen, 5 tuntia viikossa

  • Aloituksen yhdessä sovittuna ajankohtana

  • Kilpailukykyisen ja työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan 11,33€ - 13,22€/h

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen työn aloitukseen uudistetun Onboarding-polun sekä
    N-Clean Academyn johdolla

  • Työn aloitus yhteisesti sovittuna ajankohtana

  • Mahdollisuuden kehittyä työssä ja edetä sisäisillä urapoluilla

  • Turvallisen ja arvostavan työyhteisön

  • Vastuullisen työnantajan, joka huolehtii reiluista työehdoista, turvallisesta työympäristöstä ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista

  • Ihmisläheisen työpaikan ja ENPS 55


Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus

Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Kohtelemme kaikkia yhdenvertaisesti ja kunnioittavasti taustasta riippumatta. Emme hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa.
Toimimme vastuullisesti ja läpinäkyvästi sekä huolehdimme turvallisesta ja hyvinvoivasta työyhteisöstä.

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin

Meille tärkeintä on, että viihdyt työssäsi ja tunnet tekeväsi merkityksellistä työtä. Panostamme pitkäjänteisesti työntekijäkokemukseen ja arjen sujuvuuteen – ja se näkyy myös tuloksissa: työntekijöidemme eNPS on huipputasolla, 55.

Tämä ei ole vain numero, vaan näkyy konkreettisesti arjessa hyvänä ilmapiirinä, arvostuksena ja yhdessä tekemisenä. Olemme myös saaneet tunnustusta työstämme:

  • Vuonna 2024 meidät valittiin Suomen ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi

  • Vuonna 2025 sijoituimme samassa kategoriassa kolmannelle sijalle

  • Vuonna 2025 saavutimme 3. sijan Suomen ihmisläheisin työelämäteko -kategoriassa

Nämä tulokset perustuvat työntekijöidemme kokemuksiin ja palautteeseen, ja ne ohjaavat jatkuvaa kehittämistämme.

Meillä pääset myös kehittymään työssä ja etenemään uralla. Monet esihenkilöistämme ovat aloittaneet siivoojan tehtävistä ja edenneet vastuullisempiin rooleihin. Tuemme osaamisen kehittämistä ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia lisäkoulutukseen sekä uusiin tehtäviin oman kiinnostuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan. Lue lisää uratarinoista nettisivuillamme ja inspiroidu!

Hae osaksi huippu tiimiä!

title: Sr. Analyst - Data Operations
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

The Data Acquisition Management team is responsible for ensuring the quality, consistency, completeness, and availability of data received from clients and suppliers. The team plays a critical role in supporting TransUnion's data-driven products and analytics by managing data ingestion processes, maintaining reporting standards, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role reports to the Director, Data Science and Analytics.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

  • Analyze existing data ingestion processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data quality, and operational performance.
  • Monitor and validate the successful generation of data loading statistics and key process metrics to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Perform data quality reviews to assess completeness, consistency, and compliance with established reporting standards.
  • Manage data cleansing activities, resolve inconsistencies, and ensure all required reporting variables are accurately populated.
  • Coordinate and communicate changes to data requirements, ensuring alignment across entities, business partners, and stakeholders.
  • Execute testing and validation activities to confirm new solutions, enhancements, and development deliverables meet business requirements.
  • Track project activities, milestones, risks, and deliverables while providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate and current documentation of data ingestion processes, procedures, and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with technology and business teams to design and implement data solutions that improve operational effectiveness and user experience.
  • Monitor supplier and client reporting schedules, provide ongoing support to reporting entities, and develop improvement plans to achieve service-level and quality objectives.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years in an IT Analyst, Data Analyst, or related technical role supporting data management processes.
  • Experience analyzing large datasets, identifying data quality issues, and implementing corrective actions to improve completeness and consistency.
  • Knowledge of KPI development and performance management methodologies to monitor operational effectiveness and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working with cross-functional business and technology teams to gather requirements, conduct testing, and implement process enhancements.

Required Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL skills, including query development, data validation, stored procedures, functions, and database troubleshooting.
  • Experience working with relational databases and data management environments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, and data analysis tools.
  • Experience creating reports, performing data reconciliations, and analyzing operational metrics.
  • Working knowledge of Python or other automation technologies used for data processing and operational efficiency improvements.

We're also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use some brushing up, we're happy to support your career development and growth in:

  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, or data management best practices.
  • Experience supporting external clients, suppliers, or business partners in a data operations environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams.
  • Demonstrated initiative, customer orientation, organizational skills, and commitment to delivering high-quality results.

title: Manufacturing Technician
description:
Tru Vue Inc.

Manufacturing Technician

Tru Vue | Faribault, MN
3rd Shift: Sunday through Thursday, 10:00 PM to 6:30 AM
Starting Pay: $22.50/hour + $1.50/hour 3rd Shift Premium

Join the Tru Vue Team

Tru Vue, part of Apogee Enterprises, manufactures high quality glass and coating products used in framing, museums, displays, and specialty applications.

We are looking for a Manufacturing Technician to join our 3rd shift team. This is a hands on manufacturing role for someone who enjoys working with equipment, troubleshooting problems, using computers, and making sure products meet quality standards.

You do not need to know our specific processes on day one. We will train the right person who has strong mechanical or technical skills and a willingness to learn.

What You'll Do

• Operate and monitor manufacturing and coating equipment
• Adjust equipment and process settings to keep production running smoothly
• Perform quality checks and test materials
• Troubleshoot equipment and help identify the cause of production or quality issues
• Monitor product quality and help reduce scrap and waste
• Record production, quality, and process information accurately
• Follow safety procedures and written work instructions
• Perform routine equipment checks and assist with basic maintenance
• Work with Maintenance, Quality, Supervisors, and other technicians to solve problems
• Participate in problem solving and continuous improvement projects
• Help train and support other team members
• Cross train in different areas of the production process
• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

• Has manufacturing, machine operation, maintenance, technical, or industrial experience
• Enjoys working with equipment and learning how things work
• Has good mechanical and troubleshooting skills
• Is comfortable using a computer and entering information electronically
• Has strong attention to detail and takes pride in quality work
• Has basic math skills and can work with measurements and process information
• Can follow written instructions, procedures, and safety requirements
• Works well with others and is willing to help support teammates
• Is dependable, safety conscious, and willing to learn

A technical degree or experience with process control, vacuum systems, Lean Manufacturing, or Six Sigma is a plus, but not required.

Why Join Tru Vue?

• $22.50/hour starting pay
• +$1.50/hour 3rd Shift Premium
• Full time, consistent Sunday through Thursday schedule
• Hands on training and opportunities to learn new skills
• Opportunity to develop your technical and troubleshooting abilities
• Work with advanced manufacturing equipment and processes
• Opportunity to cross train and grow within the operation
• Team environment focused on safety, quality, and continuous improvement

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This is an active manufacturing environment. You will spend time standing and walking on the production floor and working around operating equipment. The environment can be loud.

The position requires frequent use of your hands, standing, walking, reaching, and working around machinery. You may occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 30 pounds. Good close and color vision is required.

If you enjoy working with equipment, solving problems, and learning new skills, we'd like to hear from you!

Our Benefits

We care about and invest in our employees. We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their well-being and foster professional development. Here is a glimpse of what you can look forward to if you join our team.

title: Claims Representative, Warranty
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Claims Representative is responsible for managing warranty claims from initial intake through final resolution while delivering a premier customer experience. This role requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to balance accuracy, cost efficiency, and customer satisfaction. The Claims Representative serves as a key partner to customers, internal teams, and service providers, ensuring claims are processed effectively, documented thoroughly, and resolved in alignment with company standards.

This is a hybrid role based out of our location in Rocky Mount, VA, or Bryan, TX, Dallas TX, Paris, IL or Toledo, OH, requiring 2 days in the office per week.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Claim Intake & Validation
    • Receive, review, and validate incoming warranty claims to determine accuracy and required information.
    • Initiate clarification calls to customers as needed to complete claim details.
    • Maintain accurate claim documentation and communication updates within Dynamics 365 CRM.
  • Claim Management & Resolution
    • Create detailed work orders for Cornerstone Building Brands (CBB) Technicians and third-party vendors, optimizing cost, efficiency, and service quality.
    • Monitor claim progress and ensure timely, cost-effective resolutions that enhance customer satisfaction.
    • Host product standards and compliance discussions with customers, helping address concerns professionally and clearly.
    • Administer service reimbursements and prepare settlement letters when applicable.
  • Quality Review & Root Cause Analysis
    • Conduct research to identify root causes of product or service issues.
    • Collaborate with plant personnel, sales teams, and other departments to support long-term corrective actions and process improvements.
    • Participate in discussions and initiatives aimed at reducing recurring issues and improving overall product and service quality.
  • Communication & Reporting
    • Prepare clear communications and updates for management regarding claim trends, issues, and opportunities.
    • Ensure documentation and reporting for claims, resolutions, and settlement activities are accurate and complete.
    • Perform additional duties as assigned to support departmental needs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong ability to interpret customer claims and apply relevant warranty coverage.
  • Ability to read and interpret product specifications, drawings, and order confirmations.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and recommend solutions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-centric approach.
  • Ability to manage difficult discussions and mitigate customer dissatisfaction effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently while supporting team and departmental goals.
  • High curiosity, initiative, and willingness to grow in an evolving environment.

    WHAT YOU’LL NEED

    • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree preferred. Professional experience in a claims or service role, preferably within the building materials industry will be considered in lieu of education.

      • Experience in Ordering/Quoting systems is desired (AccuQuote preferred).

title: Facilities & Compliance Coordinator
description:
Facilities & Compliance Coordinator
University of Canterbury Students' Association (UCSA)
Christchurch | Part-Time (0.5 FTE) | Permanent

At the UCSA, we're here for students. Operating cafes, bars, events, student services, early learning centres, offices, commercial venues, and student spaces across campus, we rely on great facilities, strong relationships, and proactive problem-solving to ensure everything runs smoothly.

We're looking for a highly organised and practical Facilities & Compliance Coordinator to become the central hub for facilities-related activity across our organisation. This is a varied role where no two days are the same. One moment you'll be coordinating maintenance works, the next you'll be managing contractors, supporting health and safety activities, tracking assets, overseeing facilities projects, or helping resolve an urgent operational issue.

If you enjoy building relationships, solving problems, and making things happen, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Finance, People & Technology, you'll be responsible for the day-to-day coordination of facilities, maintenance, compliance, contractors, assets, and operational support activities across the UCSA. The role supports all areas of the organisation and works closely with internal and external stakeholders, internal facilities management function, contractors, suppliers, and service providers.

You'll be the go-to person for facilities-related requests, ensuring issues are assessed, prioritised, assigned to the right people, and followed through to completion. The role also maintains oversight of contractor activity, assists in asset tracking systems, compliance requirements, planned maintenance programmes and health and safety support functions.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Acting as the primary point of contact for facilities-related requests from across the UCSA.

  • Coordinating repairs, maintenance, and facilities issues across multiple sites.

  • Working closely with Internal Facilities Management to progress maintenance and property-related matters.

  • Managing contractor relationships, inductions, scheduling, performance, and compliance requirements.

  • Coordinating and overseeing the day-to-day workflow of the Handyman function.

  • Maintaining asset registers, fleet systems, and tracking organisational assets.

  • Supporting planned maintenance programmes and compliance activities.

  • Coordinating day-to-day health and safety administration and facilities-related risk management.

  • Overseeing electrical tag and test programmes and associated records.

  • Supporting operational improvement initiatives, minor works projects, and facilities-related side projects.

  • Building strong relationships across all UCSA departments to ensure issues are resolved quickly and effectively.

What We're Looking For

You'll be someone who enjoys being organised, proactive, and solutions-focused.

Ideally you'll bring:

  • Experience in facilities coordination, property management, building operations, maintenance coordination, or a similar operational role.

  • Experience managing contractors and external service providers.

  • Strong organisational skills and an ability to juggle multiple priorities.

  • Experience maintaining records, asset registers, schedules, databases, or compliance systems.

  • An understanding of health and safety processes within an operational environment.

  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills.

  • Confidence working with a broad range of stakeholders.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to problem-solving.

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Why Join the UCSA?

The UCSA is one of New Zealand's most diverse and unique not-for-profit organisations. We employ over 200 staff and operate a wide range of student services, venues, hospitality outlets, events, commercial activities, and support functions, all focused on helping students succeed and belong.

In return, you'll enjoy:

  • A varied and meaningful role.

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.

  • Opportunities to contribute to projects and organisational improvements.

  • Access to staff benefits and development opportunities.

  • The chance to make a genuine difference to student life at the University of Canterbury.

The role is responsible for:

title: Summer Intern - Evaluating Genetic Sequencing Approaches
description:
LIC’s Research and Development (R&D) group is driving innovation to keep New Zealand farmers and their businesses at the forefront of the global dairy industry. Our world-class team is actively engaged in cutting-edge work across genetics, genomics, reproduction, animal health, statistics, and machine learning.

In partnership with the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, we’re offering summer internships that provide hands-on experience across a diverse range of scientific and technical areas—from genetic analysis to data science and modelling—leveraging both in-house and cloud-based computing platform

Project Details:

Title:

Evaluating different sequencing approaches for structural variant discovery.

Project scope:

Livestock Improvement Corporation (LIC) is undertaking a range of research initiatives aimed at identifying and managing large-effect genetic variants in dairy cattle populations. One important class of these variants is de novo mutations—genetic changes that arise spontaneously in an individual rather than being inherited from its parents. While most de novo mutations have little or no biological impact, some can influence health, fertility, productivity, or other economically important traits. Structural variants—including large insertions, deletions, inversions, and translocations—represent some of the most impactful forms of genetic variation due to their potential to affect large regions of the genome. However, these variants have historically been difficult to detect using traditional short-read sequencing technologies. Recent advances in long-read sequencing provide new opportunities to accurately identify and characterise structural variation and improve our understanding of genomic diversity in dairy cattle. LIC has generated a long-read sequence dataset using both Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) and Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) platforms across multiple biological sample types, including ear tissue, blood, and semen. The successful student will contribute to evaluating the quality and performance of these sequencing approaches and tissue sources for structural variant discovery. The findings will help guide future sequencing strategies and support LIC's ongoing efforts to improve the detection and management of novel genetic variation in New Zealand dairy cattle populations.

Your contribution:

The successful student will contribute to the project by assessing and comparing the quality of long read sequencing data generated using Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) and Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) platforms across multiple sample types, including ear tissue samples, blood, and semen. They will generate and analyse sequencing quality metrics to evaluate the suitability of different sequencing technologies and tissue sources for downstream genomic analyses. In addition, the student will perform structural variant discovery using long-read sequence data and compare the resulting variant calls with those obtained from short-read sequencing data generated from the same animals. They will also investigate the concordance and discrepancies between variants identified through sequencing approaches and those inferred from SNP array data. Through these analyses, the student will gain experience in genomic data analysis while contributing valuable insights into the optimal strategies for structural variant detection in dairy cattle.

Expected Outputs:

The outcomes of this project will directly inform LIC's future strategy for de novo structural variant discovery by identifying the most suitable tissue types and long-read sequencing technologies for generating high-quality genomic data. This will support more cost-effective and targeted investment in future sequencing initiatives. The project will also provide valuable insights into the additional information that long-read sequencing can deliver compared with existing short-read sequencing and SNP-chip approaches, particularly for the detection of structural variants. These findings will help LIC evaluate the value of incorporating long-read sequencing into routine research and development workflows and strengthen our ability to identify and manage novel genetic variation within the NZ dairy cattle population.

Key Skills Required:

  • Undergraduate experience in molecular genetics

  • Command line/HPC experience

  • We particularly encourage genetics or data science students to apply

To be eligible for these internships students must be:

  • Legally permitted to work in New Zealand.

  • Studying, or have studied, an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification at NZQA level 6-10 If study has been completed, the final semester should have ended within the last 12 months.

  • Studying, or have studied, science, technology, engineering, design or business at a New Zealand tertiary education institute.

  • Be able to work on-site at our Head Office in Newstead Hamilton for the duration of the internship

Application information:

If you have worked for LIC before, you can still apply if:

  • your job was part-time or temporary

  • you only held one R&D Experience Grant internship with LIC.

Please attach an up-to-date CV and your academic transcript with your application.

The internship is a paid opportunity offering $29.90 per hour for a period of 10 weeks. You will be required to work a minimum of 30 hours per week, up to a maximum of 400 hours to be completed by 31 March 2027. Participation in the project will be based physically at LIC. At the conclusion of the internship, you will be required to deliver a presentation and submit a report.

Applications close: 13th September 2026 or earlier if the roles are filled.

Job Description:

GDIT is looking for a Cloud Solutions Engineer to join our National Institutes of Health (NIH) CIT Hosting and Storage Services Program.

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused cloud engineer to design and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions for customers whose requirements extend beyond our standard cloud infrastructure and platform offerings. Our ideal candidate combines broad AWS and Azure expertise with an understanding of application architecture, infrastructure, security, networking, identity, automation, and modern DevOps practices.

As a member of our Cloud DevOps team, this engineer will work directly with customers to understand business, application, data, and scientific requirements and translate them into well-designed cloud solutions. They will take ownership of solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering and delivery, leveraging standard platform capabilities where appropriate while developing custom Infrastructure as Code, automation, and integrations where needed. The successful candidate will bring strong technical judgment, consider the downstream impacts and tradeoffs of design decisions, and operate as a trusted technical consultant to customers throughout their cloud journey.

Location: Remote working candidates will be considered; however the preference is for candidates to go onsite to Bethesda, MD 3 days out of the week. If you're within 60 miles of customer site, we would look for you to go onsite, as needed.

This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner directly with customers to discover and document business, application, data, security, and technical requirements and translate them into cloud architectures and actionable engineering plans.

  • Design and implement custom solutions in AWS and Azure for application and data hosting, including scientific and research platforms such as REDCap, Posit, and other specialized workloads that do not align with standard IaaS or PaaS offerings.

  • Engineer end-to-end cloud solutions incorporating compute, storage, databases, networking, identity and access management, security, monitoring, backup/recovery, application architecture, and other required cloud services.

  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules, configuration, scripts, and automation required to provision and manage custom solutions, leveraging standard reusable services and patterns wherever practical.

  • Design and integrate DevOps and CI/CD capabilities that support application deployment, infrastructure delivery, security scanning, testing, monitoring, and ongoing lifecycle management.

  • Apply sound engineering judgment and second-order thinking to evaluate technical alternatives, dependencies, security risks, operational impacts, scalability, maintainability, and long-term consequences when recommending solutions.

  • Independently drive assigned solutions through delivery while collaborating within an Agile Cloud DevOps team, participating in sprint planning, technical design and code reviews, and coordinating with security, infrastructure, application, and other engineering teams as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/BA and 6+ years of relevant IT experience, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong hands-on AWS and Azure experience across compute, storage, databases, networking, identity, security, monitoring, and related cloud services.

  • Experience designing and implementing cloud solutions for applications and data, with knowledge of application architectures, availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, including developing custom modules, leveraging reusable modules, and working within shared Git-based code repositories.

  • Experience with cloud networking, identity and access management, security, and DevOps/CI/CD practices, including automated infrastructure and application deployment, testing, security scanning, and monitoring.

  • Experience independently owning technical solutions from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, troubleshooting, documentation, and transition to operations.

  • Strong consulting, communication, and analytical skills, with experience engaging customers, translating requirements into technical architectures, evaluating tradeoffs and downstream impacts, and delivering solutions within an Agile sprint-based environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience architecting and supporting scientific, research, healthcare, or data-intensive applications in the cloud, including platforms such as REDCap, Posit, or comparable research technologies.

  • Experience with containerized and cloud-native architectures, managed cloud services, application modernization, cloud migrations, and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.

  • Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Terraform, DevOps, or architecture certifications and experience supporting federal government, healthcare, life sciences, or similarly regulated environments.

title: Data Engineer
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

The Argus Data Engineering Team, part of the Global Technology (GT) organization, is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise-grade data pipelines and data products that power critical business functions across the Argus organization. The team plays a key role in enabling data-driven decision making by delivering scalable, reliable, and high-quality data solutions that support teams such as Enterprise Data Management (EDM), Account Performance Management (APM), Data Science, Analytics, and other business stakeholders.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

This role exists to support the growing demand for scalable, secure, and efficient data engineering solutions across the Argus organization. As data continues to be a strategic asset, this position is critical in building and maintaining data platforms and pipelines that enable analytics, reporting, machine learning, and business intelligence initiatives.

Business Outcomes Driven by this Role

  • Deliver reliable and scalable data pipelines that support business-critical reporting, analytics, and data science initiatives.
  • Improve data availability, accuracy, and quality across multiple Argus platforms and products.
  • Enable faster time-to-insight for business and technology stakeholders through efficient data processing and delivery.
  • Support cloud modernization and migration efforts by leveraging AWS and GCP cloud-native technologies.
  • Reduce operational overhead through automation, monitoring, and optimization of data workflows.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines using Python, SQL, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Build and support data engineering solutions for cross-functional teams including EDM, APM, Data Science, and Analytics.
  • Develop scalable ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from multiple internal and external sources.
  • Create and manage workflow orchestration processes using Apache Airflow to ensure reliable and automated data movement.
  • Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement improvements to ensure data integrity and system reliability.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, analysts, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Implement best practices for data governance, security, performance optimization, and operational excellence.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and ongoing support activities for production data platforms.
  • Contribute to cloud-based architecture design and continuous improvement initiatives across AWS and GCP environments.

Support Agile development processes and actively participate in sprint planning, estimation, and delivery activities


Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • 3-4 years of Data Engineering experience building and supporting enterprise-scale data pipelines and data integration solutions.
    • Why it matters: Enables the individual to independently design, implement, and troubleshoot complex data workflows.
  • Strong Python and SQL expertise
    • Why it matters: Python is used for pipeline development, automation, and data transformation, while SQL is essential for data modeling, querying, validation, and optimization.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
    • Why it matters: Airflow is the primary orchestration platform used to schedule, monitor, and manage data workflows across the organization.
  • Multi-cloud experience with AWS (Amazon Web Services) and GCP (Google Cloud Platform)
    • Why it matters: Argus data products are deployed across cloud environments, requiring familiarity with cloud-native services, storage, compute, and data processing technologies.
  • Experience with data warehousing, ETL/ELT frameworks, and large-scale data processing

Why it matters: Ensures efficient data movement, transformation, and delivery for analytical and operational use cases

  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • Why it matters: Provides a strong foundation in software engineering, database concepts, algorithms, and system design.

Required Technical Skills

  • 3-4 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data pipeline development, automation, and transformation.
  • Advanced SQL (Structured Query Language) skills for data extraction, transformation, optimization, and analysis.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration and scheduling.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (Amazon Web Services) and GCP (Google Cloud Platform) cloud-native services.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing concepts, and modern data architecture patterns.
  • Experience working with source control systems (Git) and Agile software development methodologies.

Preferred Skills

While not required, the following skills would accelerate success in the role and provide opportunities for growth:

  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies and data platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud-based analytics, big data, or streaming technologies.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata management practices.
  • Experience supporting Data Science and advanced analytics workloads.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices for data platforms.

This role is ideal for a data engineering professional who enjoys building

scalable data solutions, collaborating across teams, and contributing to the modernization of enterprise data platforms within the Argus organization.

Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (aka "Coban") strives to enable seamless and secure real-time access to the continuous events or "streams", serving as Grab's unified, common access pattern for real-time data. We build the platform for writing, consuming, enriching and retrieving real-time data, and provide a cost-effective, fully managed "NoOps" service for all product teams to leverage.

Get to know the team
The functional areas this team covers are streaming (Kafka/AutoMQ), in-house streaming SDK, stream processing framework (Flink, Flink SQL, Kafka Connect), Change Data Capture, stream exploration (Zeppelin, Flink SQL Gateway), as well as an in-house control plane for tenancy and resource management.

Our customers are engineers, analysts, and data scientists at Grab (across all verticals like Transport, Deliveries, Geo, Ads, and various Fintech verticals), who leverage realtime data for state machines, pub/sub architectures, insights and reporting, forecasting and anomaly detection, as well as online feature engineering. The team is responsible for mission critical systems and clusters that ingest and process 10s of TB of data every hour and make streaming data simple, convenient and reliabily for engineers across Grab to use.

Get to Know the Role
Senior Engineers are expected to be significant and autonomous contributors to their team, trusted with designing, shipping, operating and monitoring software systems in a consistently high-quality manner. You would work on the Golang components of the team, such as our in-house streaming SDK, control planes, etc , considering the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options, ensuring that you deliver a secure, reliable, testable, maintainable, extensible, and well-tested system.
You will report to the Engineering Manager II and will work onsite at CMC Creative Space, Tan Hung ward, HCMC

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Work with a team of cross functional engineers to make Data Streaming and Stream Processing easy and reliably across Grab, primarily via self-served capabilities baked in our control plane and streaming SDK.

  • Write go code that is well tested across the test pyramid/trophy (unit, integration, end-to-end) and can be maintained by a cross functional team.

  • Implement and drive large-scale technical initiatives, ensuring seamless platform evolution across the organization

  • Weigh in on design questions around platformization, infrastructure, observability and security, and work closely with (and build over the platforms provided by) our infrastructure team.

  • Participate in and evolve on-call and incident response procedures for the team.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 4+ years of experience in software engineering.

  • Hands-on proficiency with at least one programming language (preferably Golang)

  • Effective communication in written and spoken English.

  • You are excited to learn new programming languages and apply new technologies.

The Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Kafka, MySQL, Spark, Temporal, Saga patterns.

  • Experience with Flink, Kafka Connect, Kubernetes, Gitlab CI, AWS, Terraform.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For at Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.
