Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Domain Service Engineer to support the planning, building, and operations of a large, globally accessed, hybrid cloud computing system. The Domain Services Engineer provides support, implementation, and design services for ISE and Microsoft Active Directory and Windows-based systems across the enterprise, including directory and identity management solutions.

We are looking for an individual who will serve as our internal Domain Services team a broad scale of technologies, working with 802.1X network access control using Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), while simultaneously taking ownership of our core DDI (DNS, DHCP, and IPAM) services. Beyond day-to-day administration and Tier 3 engineering, this individual will play a vital role in designing, modernizing, and documenting system-level architectures to ensure our hybrid on-premises and cloud infrastructures are highly available, secure, and scalable. The ideal candidate will be a motivated self-starter with excellent written and verbal communication skills, who exceeds as an individual, as well as excels among peers in a team environment.

Job Duties include but are not limited to:

•Accountable for the management, uptime, and lifecycle of the organization’s 802.1x architecture.

•Deliver and implement a secure, scalable, and resilient Active Directory design, following industry best practices while adhering to Information Security standards.

•Provide SME level assistance and escalation support for all troubleshooting tasks related to DNS, DHCP, and AD, including but not limited to integration with Windows and non-Windows endpoints, authentication, role-based access controls, DNS, DHCP, etc.

•Manage the environment proactively, anticipating risks and issues, designing and engineering for resiliency. Take technical ownership of projects and systems accordingly.

•Facilitate the implementation of Group Policy Objects (GPO) based on stated requirements. Troubleshoot and resolve any GPO related issues that arise.

•Monitor and identify replication interruptions between domain controllers, DNS and DHCP Server configurations.

•Management of the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) systems and certificates.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

5+ years of experience in progressive roles from Active Directory Administrator to Sr. Engineer

Knowledge of at least scripting languages (e.g. Powershell, Python, Bash, or Perl).

In Depth understanding of Active Directory or LDAP authentication and administration.

Advanced familiarity with enterprise directory synchronization tools such as Azure Active Directory Connect, Cisco Directory Synchronization, or others.

  • Implement and Manage enterprise-wide architecture, deployment, and ongoing administration of Cisco ISE
  • Maintain advanced network access control (NAC) policies, utilizing 802.1X, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), and Web Authentication.
  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex 802.1X/RADIUS authentication issues, certificate mismatches, and supplicant-side issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, and IoT devices.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

1. An analytic mindset with the ability to define complex infrastructure problems, correlate logs across multiple systems (ISE, AD, DNS, Network Switches), and execute systematic resolutions.

2. Someone who looks beyond immediate triage to design architectures that prevent future systemic failures.

3. A strong capability to translate highly technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders, and collaborate across siloed Network, Systems, and Security teams.

4. Configure and optimize network device profiling, Cisco TrustSec (Security Group Tags), and Comply-to-Connect (C2C) architectures.

5. Integrate Cisco ISE with Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, PKI/Certificate Authorities, and SIEM tools for automated threat containment and compliance reporting.

6. Evaluate existing infrastructure pipelines and propose architectural modernizations to leverage Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), automation, and hybrid-cloud capabilities.

7. Architect, document, and present system-level designs that integrate on-premises systems, virtualization platforms, and public/private cloud environments.

8. Experience working in a fast tempo government agency production IT environment.

9. Experience troubleshooting various Microsoft Windows Server platforms' roles and features.

title: Pastoral Care & Wellbeing Coordinator
description:
About the opportunities:

We’re recruiting two empathetic and experienced Pastoral Care and Wellbeing Coordinators:

  • One position supporting students at Auckland Institute of Studies (AIS) - Mt Albert
  • One position supporting students at UP International College (UPIC) - Auckland CBD

Each position will support the wellbeing, engagement and educational success of students at its respective provider while working collaboratively with the wider pastoral care team.

Working closely with the Head of Pastoral Care and Wellbeing, academic teams and student services, you’ll provide day-to-day support to students experiencing personal, academic, social or behavioural challenges. You’ll have a particular focus on international learners, students under 18 and those identified as requiring additional wellbeing support.

This is a varied, hands-on role encompassing student check-ins, case management, early intervention, critical incident response, safeguarding, referrals and wellbeing initiatives. You’ll also help ensure pastoral care practices meet relevant regulatory and organisational requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Providing proactive pastoral care and wellbeing support to students.
  • Acting as a point of contact for students requiring wellbeing assistance.
  • Conducting wellbeing check-ins and following up with students requiring support.
  • Identifying and monitoring students who may be at risk or need early intervention.
  • Developing and maintaining individual student support plans.
  • Connecting students with appropriate counselling, health, academic and community services.
  • Supporting student critical incidents and safeguarding matters.
  • Maintaining accurate and confidential case notes and student records.
  • Monitoring attendance, engagement and academic indicators for potential wellbeing risks.
  • Working with academic teams to coordinate appropriate student support.
  • Supporting pastoral care-related complaints and disciplinary processes.
  • Communicating appropriately with parents and caregivers where consent and privacy requirements allow.
  • Coordinating student and parent workshops, surveys and wellbeing activities.
  • Supporting orientation and transition activities for new students.
  • Contributing to pastoral care reporting, audits and Code self-review activities.
  • Participating in continuous improvement initiatives across student support services.

The roles will also help manage the 24/7 student support phone and may occasionally need to respond to urgent wellbeing matters outside standard working hours. Flexibility will therefore be required when emergency situations or operational needs arise.

About you

You’re an empathetic and culturally responsive professional who can build trust with students while maintaining clear boundaries, confidentiality and sound professional judgement.

You’ll be comfortable managing sensitive situations, coordinating support for students with varied needs and working collaboratively with academic and professional services teams.

You’ll bring:

  • A relevant tertiary qualification, preferably in social work, psychology, counselling, health, education, quality assurance or a related field.
  • Experience in pastoral care, student support, wellbeing, safeguarding or a related area.
  • Experience supporting people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
  • Strong interpersonal and written communication skills.
  • The ability to manage sensitive situations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong organisation, administration and case management capabilities.
  • Sound judgement and the ability to recognise when concerns require escalation.
  • An understanding of privacy, confidentiality and appropriate information sharing.
  • Confidence maintaining accurate records within student or case management systems.
  • The ability to work effectively across academic and professional services teams.
  • A full New Zealand driver licence.
  • The flexibility to respond to urgent student wellbeing matters outside standard working hours when required.

For the UPIC position - Bilingual capability and professional proficiency in Mandarin would also be advantageous, to help support effective communication with students and their families.

Experience within New Zealand tertiary or international education would be highly advantageous, particularly if you have supported international students or learners under 18.

An understanding of the Education (Pastoral Care of Tertiary and International Learners) Code of Practice 2021, safeguarding responsibilities and the Privacy Act 2020 would also be beneficial.

Successful candidates will be required to complete relevant safeguarding and children’s worker safety checks.

Why work with us?

You’ll join a collaborative team committed to placing student wellbeing at the centre of the educational experience.

These are meaningful opportunities to support learners through important and sometimes challenging moments, strengthen the support available across AIS and UPIC and contribute directly to student belonging, resilience and success.

As part of UP Education, you’ll also become part of a wider network of education professionals committed to helping learners achieve their goals.

To apply

If you’re passionate about student wellbeing and have the empathy, judgement and practical experience to provide effective pastoral care, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Please indicate in your CV whether you are interested in the AIS position, the UPIC position or both.

Questions about your identity help us appreciate the diversity of individuals looking to work with us, ensuring we’re attracting applications from people with identities and perspectives that are as diverse as our students.

We are an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to equity, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Job Description:

GDIT is looking for a Senior Cloud Solutions Engineer to join our National Institutes of Health (NIH) CIT Hosting and Storage Services Program.

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused cloud engineer to design and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions for customers whose requirements extend beyond our standard cloud infrastructure and platform offerings. Our ideal candidate combines broad AWS and Azure expertise with an understanding of application architecture, infrastructure, security, networking, identity, automation, and modern DevOps practices.

As a member of our Cloud DevOps team, this engineer will work directly with customers to understand business, application, data, and scientific requirements and translate them into well-designed cloud solutions. They will take ownership of solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering and delivery, leveraging standard platform capabilities where appropriate while developing custom Infrastructure as Code, automation, and integrations where needed. The successful candidate will bring strong technical judgment, consider the downstream impacts and tradeoffs of design decisions, and operate as a trusted technical consultant to customers throughout their cloud journey.

● Location: Remote working candidates will be considered; however the preference is for candidates to go onsite to Bethesda, MD 3 days out of the week. If you're within 60 miles of customer site, we would look for you to go onsite, as needed.

This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner directly with customers to discover and document business, application, data, security, and technical requirements and translate them into cloud architectures and actionable engineering plans.

  • Design and implement custom solutions in AWS and Azure for application and data hosting, including scientific and research platforms such as REDCap, Posit, and other specialized workloads that do not align with standard IaaS or PaaS offerings.

  • Engineer end-to-end cloud solutions incorporating compute, storage, databases, networking, identity and access management, security, monitoring, backup/recovery, application architecture, and other required cloud services.

  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules, configuration, scripts, and automation required to provision and manage custom solutions, leveraging standard reusable services and patterns wherever practical.

  • Design and integrate DevOps and CI/CD capabilities that support application deployment, infrastructure delivery, security scanning, testing, monitoring, and ongoing lifecycle management.

  • Apply sound engineering judgment and second-order thinking to evaluate technical alternatives, dependencies, security risks, operational impacts, scalability, maintainability, and long-term consequences when recommending solutions.

  • Independently drive assigned solutions through delivery while collaborating within an Agile Cloud DevOps team, participating in sprint planning, technical design and code reviews, and coordinating with security, infrastructure, application, and other engineering teams as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/BA and 8+ years of relevant IT experience, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong hands-on AWS and Azure experience across compute, storage, databases, networking, identity, security, monitoring, and related cloud services.

  • Experience designing and implementing cloud solutions for applications and data, with knowledge of application architectures, availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, including developing custom modules, leveraging reusable modules, and working within shared Git-based code repositories.

  • Experience with cloud networking, identity and access management, security, and DevOps/CI/CD practices, including automated infrastructure and application deployment, testing, security scanning, and monitoring.

  • Experience independently owning technical solutions from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, troubleshooting, documentation, and transition to operations.

  • Strong consulting, communication, and analytical skills, with experience engaging customers, translating requirements into technical architectures, evaluating tradeoffs and downstream impacts, and delivering solutions within an Agile sprint-based environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience architecting and supporting scientific, research, healthcare, or data-intensive applications in the cloud, including platforms such as REDCap, Posit, or comparable research technologies.

  • Experience with containerized and cloud-native architectures, managed cloud services, application modernization, cloud migrations, and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.

  • Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Terraform, DevOps, or architecture certifications and experience supporting federal government, healthcare, life sciences, or similarly regulated environments.

title: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description:
Headquarters: United States
URL:

Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer

Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial

Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands.

This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools.

You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials.

The work

You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals.

Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell.

  • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents.
  • Decide what each batch should test and why.
  • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references.
  • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction.
  • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads.
  • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level.
  • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop.
  • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance.
  • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output.
  • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests.
  • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch.

What you must be good at

  • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy
  • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation
  • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit
  • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page
  • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production
  • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation
  • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools
  • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish
  • Fast, organised batch production
  • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test

You are probably not right for this role if

  • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context.
  • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism.
  • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work.
  • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision.
  • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production.
  • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples.
  • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback.

What success looks like

Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow.

Compensation

The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000. If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month, based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator.

We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output.

How to apply

Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work.

  1. Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed.
  2. For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel.
  3. Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable.
  4. Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed.
  5. List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset.
  6. Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test.
  7. State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial.

Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial.

title: Sr. Lead Talent and Learning Management Platform IT Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced IT professional to support our Talent and Learning Management platforms, with strong hands-on experience in Applicant Tracking Systems. Experience with learning platforms is preferred.

This individual will work closely with HR business leaders to support the Avature recruiting and onboarding platform, drive system enhancements, manage configuration changes, and support future business requests. The role will also partner closely with the Workday technical team to support integrations, master data, and new hire onboarding data flows.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support the Avature Applicant Tracking and Onboarding platform from the IT side.
  • Work closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, and business leaders to understand requirements.
  • Configure Avature to support recruiting, onboarding, workflow, and business process needs.
  • Support system enhancements, issue resolution, testing, and production support activities.
  • Partner with business teams to improve the candidate, recruiter, and hiring manager experience.
  • Work with the Workday technical team to support integrations between Avature, Workday, and other HR systems.
  • Help manage master data, new hire data, and onboarding-related integration flows.
  • Support technology-driven integrations, data validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for system updates, defects, enhancements, and releases.
  • Provide guidance to business users on system capabilities and best practices.
  • Support learning platform initiatives as needed, including enhancements, testing, and business support.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with IT and HR technology standards.

REQUIRED:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Applicant Tracking System.
  • Experience working with Workday HCM or Workday integrations.
  • Good understanding of recruiting, applicant tracking, and onboarding processes.
  • Experience with system configuration, workflows, forms, templates, and business process changes.
  • Ability to work directly with business leaders and translate requirements into system solutions.
  • Experience supporting application enhancements, production issues, testing, and releases.
  • Strong understanding of HR technology integrations and data flows.
  • Experience working with technical teams on integration support and troubleshooting.
  • Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and work closely with business and IT teams.

PREFERRED:

  • Avature experience is preferred
  • Exposure to learning management platforms.
  • Experience supporting new hire, onboarding, and employee master data integrations.
  • Experience in a global HR technology environment.
  • Knowledge of HR data security and access management.
  • Experience working with vendors, implementation partners, and cross-functional teams.

title: SI Solutions - Senior Analyst
description:
About the Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Job Description

Title SI Solutions - Senior Analyst

Department Asset Management CAO

Location Dalian

Level: 3

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About your team

Asset Management CAO team is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management. The Investment Management Solutions team is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

About your role


As the SI Solutions - Senior Analyst you will be responsible for maintaining documentation, executing core reporting responsibilities, designing & developing automated tools & capability to reduce manual processes for more efficiency and higher accuracy, and provide technical support on database management and business analysis. This role will support FIL’s investment, client services & workplace investing teams to produce reporting, analysis and data used to understand, describe & demonstrate FIL’s approach to sustainable investing.

About you

The successful candidate will be expected to develop a deep understanding of our current & future capabilities, FIL’s product & operational platform. The role will execute a variety of reporting-based deliveries across a broad stakeholder base, actively monitor the overall status of documentation, and proactively prepare & renew essential authorization documents. With the growing understanding on Sustainable Investing reporting functions, the role is expected to work with related stakeholders to deliver technical deliverables on different types of data warehouse related requirements and automation requirements. As data sets & global regulations focused on Sustainable Investing continues to rapidly develop, you will be expected to learn, adapt & evolve deliverables to meet evolving requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collate information and data from voting platforms, internal records, and some from third-parties to produce voting and engagement reports.
  • Production of public voting activity disclosure reporting to meet regulations and local stewardship codes.
  • Produce climate reporting & quarterly reporting for Global Platform Solutions.
  • Identify automation opportunities and lead implementation where needed.
  • Support on database development, management, processing and optimizing.
  • Coordinate communications from the investment team and client services on sustainable reporting.
  • Assist on fund screening, bespoke exclusion reporting, and maintenance of supporting processes.
  • Produce data & reports as well as other administrative tasks required to integrate client facing vendor platforms
  • Assist on general ESG reporting projects and requirements.
  • Maintaining POA documentation and take end to end ownership of all processes.
  • Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.
  • Identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvement.

Experience and Qualifications Required

  • Data analytical and automation skills - Python, SQL, PowerBI is required, experience of developing automation tool based on business requirement is highly preferred.
  • Experience with data management tool and database platoform - Snowflake, Azure, etc. is preferred
  • Highly efficient English communication skills in both writing and speaking. Japanese Language skills is preferred.
  • Background in finance related functions or business data reporting & support management is required.
  • Highly sufficient skills in Microsoft Excel, PPT is required.
  • Experience or qualifications within Sustainable Investment subject matters preferred.
  • Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA related certificate is highly preferred.
  • Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and dedication to manage tight deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
  • Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is highly preferred.
  • A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
  • Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.
  • Able to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Full-Time Key Carrier
description:
Homesense

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Opportunity: Grow Your Career

The Key Carrier role is an elevated extension of the Coordinator role. Key Carriers alternate their role based on store needs, predominantly performing the role of Coordinator and occasionally acting as Key Carrier, taking on a leadership role in maintaining all aspects of the store. Key Carriers must have open availability, including nights and weekends. Role models exceptional customer service.

  • Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
  • Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
  • Acts as Manager on Duty adhering to company policy and procedure
  • Ensures store team performs tasks and activities in accordance with store plan; prioritizes as needed
  • Addresses immediate customer service issues and provides appropriate coaching to Associates
  • Exercises discretion regarding customer service policies to satisfy customers
  • Maintains accurate Associate coverage in service areas for a positive customer experience
  • Ensures Associates adhere to all operational procedures
  • Ensures opening/closing procedures are executed according to company guidelines
  • Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
  • Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
  • Provides feedback, recognition and coaching to Associates
  • Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
  • Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
  • Promotes credit and loyalty programs
  • Supports and participates in shrink reduction goals and programs
  • Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
  • Other duties as assigned

Who We’re Looking For: You.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
  • Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
  • Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
  • Knowledge of company standard software, systems, and procedures
  • Knowledge of merchandise flow in stores
  • Proven problem solving skills
  • Able to effectively coach, delegate, and follow-up on multiple people/tasks
  • Able to act quickly under challenging circumstances
  • Capable of multi-tasking
  • Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • 1 year retail, 6 months leadership experience

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

title: Working Student – PMO & Project Assistance (f/m/d)
description:
In BA Markets the mission of the Unit OU Operations is to drive the digital transformation. OU Operations consists of diverse and highly skilled employees from more than 20 countries. We work internationally from our locations in Stockholm, Hamburg and Amsterdam.

Job Description

Would you like to gain practical experience while contributing to a reliable and future-oriented energy system?

As a working student with us, you become part of a collaborative team where you can learn, contribute your ideas, and grow step by step. At Vattenfall, we believe “there is a way” — and together, we explore better ways of working every day.

You will support our Agile Coaching & Initiative Management team in strengthening project portfolio execution & transparency, improving operational processes, and enabling better collaboration across BA Markets. In this role, you will contribute to PMO activities, reporting, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives — gaining hands-on experience in how projects and business initiatives are managed in an international energy company.

You will help us turn information into insights, improve the quality of planning and reporting, and support initiatives that make cross-team collaboration easier and more effective.

What you will do

  • Support the team with PMO tasks such as preparing meetings, updating project overviews, tracking actions, and creating reports.
  • Help improve planning and reporting by structuring information and keeping data up to date.
  • Support the visibility of KPI:s and trends by collecting, checking, and presenting data in a clear way.
  • Prepare material for sponsors and stakeholders, such as presentations, summaries, and follow-ups.
  • Help organize workshops and formats that strengthen collaboration across teams.
  • Bring in your own ideas on how we can improve quality, transparency, and ways of working,
  • Explore further practical use cases for AI tools and help identify how they can improve reporting, coordination, knowledge sharing, and day-to-day ways of working.

You are curious, motivated to learn and enjoy working with others. You feel comfortable asking questions and sharing ideas, and you appreciate being part of a supportive team.

Qualifications

  • Enrolled at a university in Germany in business informatics, business administration, energy management, information technology, or a related field.
  • Interest in the energy sector, project management, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Structured and reliable way of working with an eye for improving processes and ways of working.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills in an international environment.
  • Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of tasks.
  • Good Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Power BI, SharePoint, Teams, or AI tools is a plus.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plus.

If you do not meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply — we value motivation and willingness to learn.

What we offer

  • Meaningful work that contributes to the energy transition
  • Practical experience in an international energy company
  • Support from experienced colleagues and opportunities to build your professional network
  • Modern office directly at Hamburg Elbbrücken station

More Information

  • Start date: as soon as possible
  • Working time: Up to 20 hours per week during university term and up to 37.5 hours per week during semester breaks.
  • Hybrid working with regular office presence
  • Duration: 6-12 months

We welcome your application in English, no later than 19.09.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website. The following documents are needed: CV, enrolment certificate, and current overview of grades.

For more detailed information regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruiter Sabrina Parsons: sabrina.parsons@vattenfall.de

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
You are interested in the position as Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) at Peter Park System GmbH?

On the job platform Instaffo, you can apply for this and other jobs with ease. Create your profile in under 3 minutes and start the application process with just a few clicks.

Please note that this position requires work authorization for Germany.

The language requirements for this position are: English - Fluent.

The estimated salary range from XING does not necessarily correspond to the salary range of this job offer.

Peter Park runs barrier-free digital parking across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Italy — serving 450+ B2B customers and 90,000+ parking spaces with computer vision instead of gates. Behind it sits a rich data model and millions of transactions.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to turn that data into decisions and revenue. You'll work closely with our technical leadership to find the patterns that matter, build tools that scale, and shape our product with evidence. If you value ownership, real-world data, and seeing your work move the business, you'll fit right in.

Activities

• Analyze large datasets to surface trends, patterns, and anomalies across our parking and payment ecosystem.

• Develop data-driven hypotheses that drive revenue growth and flag risks and opportunities early directly impacting millions in revenue.

• Continuously monitor and refine revenue-enhancing strategies.

• Extend our product with statistical and analytical tooling that helps B2B customers manage their parking areas smarter.

• Deliver insights on user behavior, product usage, and customer satisfaction to steer product decisions.

• Partner with our data engineers to ensure the data you need is modeled, accessible, and trustworthy.

• Build reporting and dashboards that let business teams self-serve on insights.

• Ground your models and analyses in validated data you can stand behind.

• Build data pipelines for collection, processing, and transformation.

• Stay ahead of developments in data science, ML, and applied AI, and help lift the team through best practices and mentorship.

Requirements

• Real seniority in data science, ML, and analytics with real-world data measured by impact, ownership, and drive for improvement, not just years on paper.

• A degree in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, or similar).

• A deep curiosity about data and the processes behind it, with strong problem-solving and analytical instincts.

• Proven experience in data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning.

• Expert-level Python, SQL, data visualization, and Git.

• Experience with cloud computing, data warehouses, and NoSQL databases (we run AWS, Aurora PostgreSQL, and Redshift, with Tableau as our BI layer).

• Strong command of data manipulation libraries (Pandas, NumPy) and ML frameworks (Scikit-Learn, PyTorch).

• A collaborative, cross-functional working style.

• Excellent written and spoken English (C1).

Application Process

• Initial Contact: We’ll get back to you within 48 hours.

• HR Interview: Discuss your experience and expectations with our HR team.

• Live Assessment: Complete a technical exercise designed to challenge you with scenarios beyond your usual experience.

• Tech Challenge: Tackle a problem in a familiar context to demonstrate your technical skills and approach.

• Leadership Conversation: Dive deeper into the role and expectations with the Head of Product.

• On-Site Meeting: Visit our Munich office, meet more of the team, and experience our culture firsthand.

About the Company

Revolutioniere mit uns die Parkraumbewirtschaftung! Gestalte die Zukunft mit digitalen Lösungen und einem dynamischen Team.

Wir bieten unseren Kunden digitale Lösungen zur Parkraumbewirtschaftung. Wir ersetzen Schranken, Papiertickets und Parkscheiben durch barrierefreies Parken mit mobilen Bezahlmöglichkeiten. Im engen Austausch mit unserem Kundenstamm und Unternehmenspartnern stellen wir uns der Herausforderung, unsere Lösung ständig zu verbessern und zu erweitern. Als dynamisches Startup legen wir Wert auf Begeisterung, Eigenverantwortung und Feedback-Kultur. Dafür suchen wir engagierte Leute für unser Team!

Zusammenhalt & Team

Unser Erfolg wird gesichert durch unser Team - Wir arbeiten füreinander und miteinander, anstatt gegeneinander. Ohne unser Team sind wir nichts. Wir inspirieren und motivieren einander, lernen voneinander und wachsen gemeinsam.

Dabei darf auch Spaß und das Feiern von Erfolgen nicht zu kurz kommen!

Can-Do Mentalität

Verpasste Chancen sind schlimmer als Fehlschläge. Wir entwickeln kreative Ideen um jeden Tag mit positiver Energie auf unsere Ziele hinzuarbeiten. Jede Idee ist es wert, gehört zu werden. Dabei behalten wir unsere Ziele immer klar im Blick und vertrauen auf das Können und die Selbstständigkeit unserer Team-Mitglieder.

Integrität & Offene Kommunikation

Als Team begegnen wir uns auf Augenhöhe, das wird vor allem durch offene Kommunikation und authentisches Auftreten gesichert. Du bist du, das ist gut so und das sollst du auch immer sein dürfen - auch auf der Arbeit! Ehrliches Feedback und ein Umfeld, in welchem man sich entwickeln kann, sind uns sehr wichtig.

title: Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) II
description:
Type of Requisition:

Regular

Clearance Level Must Currently Possess:

Top Secret/SCI

Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:

Top Secret SCI + Polygraph

Public Trust/Other Required:

None

Job Family:

Cyber and IT Risk Management

Job Qualifications:

Skills:

Information Security, Information Security Management, Information System Security

Certifications:

None

Experience:

2 + years of related experience

US Citizenship Required:

Yes

Job Description:

The ISSO is responsible for ensuring the appropriate operational security posture is maintained for an information system and as such, works in close collaboration with the ISSM and ISO. The position shall have the detailed knowledge and expertise required to manage the security aspects of an information system and, in many organizations, is assigned responsibility for the day-to-day security operations of a system. This also will include physical and environmental protection, personnel security, incident handling, and security training and awareness. It will be required to work in close coordination with the ISSM and ISO in monitoring the information system(s) and its environment of operation to include developing and updating the authorization documentation, implementing configuration management across authorization boundaries.
This will include assessing the security impact of those changes and making recommendation to the ISSM.

The position will provide “day-to-day” support for Collateral, Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Program (SAP) activities.

Performance shall include:

  • Develop physical or logical topologies for a system.

  • Assist the ISSM in meeting their duties and responsibilities.

  • Prepare, review, and update authorization packages.

  • Ensure approved procedures are in place for clearing, sanitizing, and destroying various types of hardware and media.

  • Notify ISSM when changes occur that might affect the authorization determination of the information system(s).

  • Conduct periodic reviews of information systems to ensure compliance with the security authorization package.

  • Coordinate any changes or modifications to hardware, software, or firmware of a system with the ISSM and AO/DAO prior to the change.

  • Monitor system recovery processes to ensure security features and procedures are properly restored and functioning correctly.

  • Ensure all IS security-related documentation is current and accessible to properly authorized individuals.

  • Ensure audit records are collected, reviewed, and documented (to include any anomalies).

  • Attend required technical and security training (e.g., operating system, networking, security management) relative to assigned duties.

  • Execute the cyber security portion of the self-inspection, to include provide security coordination and review of all system assessment plans.

  • Identify cyber security vulnerabilities and assist with the implementation of the countermeasures for them.

  • Prepare reports on the status of security safeguards applied to computer systems

  • Perform ISSO duties in support of in-house and external customers

  • Conduct security impact analysis activities and provide to the ISSM on all configuration management changes to the authorization boundaries


Experience:

  • 2+ years related experience

  • SAP experience required

  • Prior performance in roles such as System, Network Administrator, or ISSO


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree OR Associate’s degree in a related area + 2 years’ experience OR equivalent experience (4 years)


Certifications:

  • IAT Level II or IAM Level II - within 6 months of hire (Security+ CE, CCNA Security, etc.)


Security Clearance:

  • TS/SCI required.

  • Must be able to Attain – TS/SCI with CI Polygraph

Other Requirements:

  • Must be able to regularly lift up to 50 lbs.

#AirforceSAPOpportunities

The likely salary range for this position is $88,400 - $119,600. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

title: QA Test Engineer
description:
QA Test Engineer – Full-time, Permanent

Location: Poole, Dorset (4 days per week onsite)

Salary: £35-40,000 per annum, negotiable depending on experience, plus benefits

The Opportunity:

If you work in QA, you may know how frustrating it is to be brought in at the end of a project, handed a release, and expected to find everything that could go wrong without having had the opportunity to influence it earlier.

This role offers something more involving.

You’ll join an established software company that is investing in modern development tools and testing approaches. Working closely with developers, product specialists and DevOps throughout the Agile delivery cycle, you’ll help shape test coverage, identify risks, and improve how quality is built into complex software. Not simply check it at the end.

The work spans web, mobile and API-based applications, combining thoughtful manual and exploratory testing with automation. With varied projects, technically interesting problems, and software used at scale, this is an opportunity to keep learning while making a visible contribution to the reliability, security and performance of the product.

Why This Role Stands Out:

  • Salary is competitive and negotiable, up to around £40,000 per annum depending on experience
  • Annual salary reviews with regular market benchmarking
  • Hybrid working – 1 day per week remote from home
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Pension scheme with employer contribution and matched enhancements
  • Health Cash Plan including 24/7 GP access, dental and optical cover
  • Death in Service cover (4x salary)
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Paid volunteering days
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Comfortable, modern open-plan office
  • Team and company social events
  • Autonomy, trust and long-term career progression
  • Structured training and development opportunities to help you grow
  • Supportive, team-focused culture that values your ideas and achievements

Why This QA Test Engineer Role May Appeal

  • Quality is treated as a shared responsibility, with close collaboration across QA, development, product and DevOps.
  • You’ll work across manual, exploratory and automated testing rather than being confined to repetitive regression testing.
  • The company has ambitious plans to modernise its development tools and testing approaches, giving you scope to contribute ideas and improve how things are done.
  • Projects vary, so you’ll gain exposure to different technical challenges across web, mobile, APIs, databases and cloud-based environments.
  • You’ll be trusted to investigate problems properly, communicate risk clearly, and follow defects through to resolution.
  • Structured training, development and long-term career progression will support you in expanding your technical capability.
  • You’ll join a stable, growing business with a supportive culture that recognises ideas, initiative and achievement.

What You Need:

  • A strong understanding of QA methodologies and the software testing lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience of both manual and automated testing across web, mobile and/or API environments.
  • The ability to create structured test cases and communicate defects and test outcomes clearly.
  • Experience managing test plans and defects within a modern software development workflow.
  • SQL knowledge for database validation and testing.
  • Experience working within an Agile or Scrum environment.
  • Familiarity with tools or technologies such as Jira, Postman, Selenium and AWS would be useful.

You don’t need to match every preferred technology listed above. If you have strong testing fundamentals, an investigative mindset and the appetite to broaden your skills, the company would still be interested in hearing from you.

Why You Should Apply:

If you enjoy investigating the unexpected, asking the questions others may miss, and helping teams release software with greater confidence, this could be an interesting next move for you.

Apply now or contact me for a confidential, no-pressure conversation to find out more.

We welcome applications from neurodivergent candidates and are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Please note that telephone calls are scheduled by appointment only.

description:

title: Data Platform & Governance Analyst
description:

  • Data capability uplift project

Our client is seeking an experienced Data Platform & Governance Analyst to play a key role in the ongoing maturity and transformation of its enterprise data environment.

This is a highly influential technical role focused on establishing and embedding Microsoft Fabric, CI/CD, Azure DevOps and Microsoft Purview capabilities, while developing robust governance and data quality practices across the organisation.

The Opportunity
You will be responsible for designing and implementing enterprise deployment frameworks for Microsoft Fabric assets, including notebooks, data pipelines, lakehouses, semantic models and reporting solutions.

A key component of the role will be establishing repeatable CI/CD and Azure DevOps processes that improve deployment reliability, automation, consistency and operational control across development, test and production environments.
You will also lead the implementation and adoption of Microsoft Purview, strengthening data governance, lineage, stewardship, data quality and business ownership of critical data assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement automated deployment frameworks across the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.
  • Establish and embed CI/CD, Azure DevOps and release management standards.
  • Develop reusable deployment templates, patterns and automation capabilities.
  • Support the deployment and governance of Fabric notebooks, pipelines, lakehouses, semantic models and reporting solutions.
  • Lead the implementation and configuration of Microsoft Purview.
  • Develop data governance, lineage, stewardship and data discovery capabilities.
  • Establish data quality contracts, accountability frameworks and issue management processes.
  • Work directly with business stakeholders to establish data ownership and stewardship responsibilities.
  • Provide technical advice on platform architecture, governance controls and deployment strategies.
  • Develop platform standards, documentation and operational procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, platform maturity, governance and operational efficiency.

About You
We are looking for a technically strong data platform professional who can combine hands-on technical capability with strong stakeholder engagement and governance skills.
You will ideally bring:

  • Strong experience across Microsoft Fabric and modern data platform environments.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
  • Strong Azure DevOps experience.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric assets including Data Pipelines, Lakehouses, Notebooks and Semantic Models.
  • Practical experience implementing Microsoft Purview and enterprise data governance.
  • Understanding of data quality, lineage, stewardship and data ownership frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data platform architecture, security and governance.
  • The ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on building scalable and sustainable solutions.

Why Join?
This is an opportunity to take a pivotal role in the maturity and future direction of an enterprise data platform.
You will have significant influence over how data is deployed, governed, managed and owned across the organisation, working at the intersection of technology, data governance, automation and business transformation.

If you are looking for a role where you can establish new standards, implement modern Microsoft technologies and make a tangible impact on an organisation's data capability, we would like to hear from you.

DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES:

Advisor, Communicable Diseases Control and Elimination

Join us and be a driving force in strengthening communicable disease prevention, control and elimination in Suriname

The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), Regional Office for the Americas of the World Health Organization (WHO), is seeking an experienced and results-oriented Advisor, Communicable Diseases Control and Elimination to provide strategic and technical leadership in the prevention, control, surveillance and elimination of communicable diseases and public health threats in Suriname.

Under the technical guidance of the Director, Communicable Diseases Prevention, Control and Elimination (CDE) and the direct supervision of the PAHO/WHO Representative (PWR), the selected candidate will:

• Provide technical cooperation to national health authorities in the design, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of communicable disease prevention, control, elimination and surveillance programs, including malaria, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, viral hepatitis, sexually transmitted infections, antimicrobial resistance, vector-borne diseases, zoonotic diseases and neglected diseases.
• Support the strengthening of national and local health services through evidence-based approaches, epidemiological surveillance, disease prevention strategies and health information systems.
• Advise the Ministry of Health and other institutions on diagnosis, treatment, patient management, disease control technologies, environmental public health initiatives and climate-sensitive health risks.
• Analyze and evaluate surveillance data, identify disease risks and outbreaks, and provide recommendations to support public health preparedness, response and decision-making.
• Promote collaboration among government institutions, academic partners, civil society organizations, neighboring countries and international stakeholders to strengthen national capacity and support implementation of the International Health Regulations (IHR).

For a complete list of functions, please see the post description.

What is required for this position?

Education

A bachelor’s degree in a health-related profession and a master’s degree in epidemiology, public health or any other field related to the functions of the position, from a recognized university.

Experience

Nine years of combined national and international experience working in epidemiology and control programs or in the administration of health services related to control of diseases, health analysis and statistics. Practical managerial experience in the operational aspects of prevention and control programs.

Languages

Fluency in English. A working knowledge of Spanish, French and/or Portuguese would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to effectively use current technology and software, spreadsheets and presentations, as well as Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and management information systems. Other IT skills and knowledge of software programs such as Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Word are considered essential.

Competencies and Skills

For a complete list of competencies and skills, please refer to the post description.

The skills required are:

• Theoretical and practical expertise in communicable disease surveillance, epidemiology, prevention and control methods.
• In-depth knowledge of disease transmission, diagnosis, prevention and treatment of communicable diseases.
• Professional expertise in preventive public health, epidemiological research, disease control and health services.
• Ability to analyze surveillance systems and develop innovative solutions for their improvement.
• Knowledge and skills in the formulation, monitoring and evaluation of technical cooperation interventions and programs.
• Managerial skills for the development, implementation and analysis of technical cooperation programs and activities.
• Strong oral and written communication skills, including preparation of reports, presentations and technical documents.
• Knowledge and practical expertise in the International Health Regulations (IHR), outbreak control and public health emergencies.
• Ability to develop collaborative multisectoral partnerships and mobilize resources.
• Knowledge of surveillance strategies to maintain disease elimination achievements and prevent re-establishment.
• Knowledge of communicable disease surveillance and response in remote, cross-border and mobile-population settings.
• Knowledge of One Health approaches and the relationship between climate, environmental conditions, vector-borne diseases and zoonotic risks.

Post of limited duration. First year probationary period.

title: Automyyjä
description:
Tule töihin Suomen suurimpaan vaihtoautokauppaan! 🚗

Etsimme kasvun myötä vakituista myyjää Rovaniemen toimipisteeseemme vahvistamaan myyntitiimiä 🔥 Meillä asenne ratkaisee – sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis autoalan ammattilainen, sillä me koulutamme sinut alan huipuksi!

Onko sinulla nälkää menestyä omalla työlläsi ja halu ansaita juuri niin paljon kuin tuloksesi näyttävät, ilman palkkakattoa? Tulevana sakalaisena sytyt kehittämisestä ja kehittymisestä. Et hätkähdä kovia tavoitteita ja tekemisen meininkiä, vaan ne saavat sinut painamaan lisää kaasua. Asiakkaat ovat meille tärkeintä ja asiakaspalvelumme on tutkitusti maan parasta, joten olet luonteva ihmisten kanssa sekä haluat löytää asiakkaillemme parhaat ratkaisut.

Mikäli olet ennakkoluuloton, yrittäjähenkinen ja löydät keinot päästä tavoitteisiin, on aika laittaa vaihde silmään ja tulla mukaan Sakan kasvavaan joukkoon!

Kaiken tekemisemme ytimessä ovat meille tärkeät arvot: menestymme intohimolla yhdessä, arvostamme jokaista ja olemme aina luotettavia sekä rehellisiä.


Millaista on automyynti Sakalla?

Sakalla myyntityö on monipuolista ja tarjoaa erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä alan huipuksi. Arkesi koostuu asiakkaiden kanssa neuvottelemisesta, vaihtoautojen hinnoittelusta ja kauppojen klousaamisesta. Asiakkailla on aina tarve jo valmiiksi olemassa! Pääsetkin tarjoamaan heille tarpeeseen sopivia ratkaisuja laajasta valikoimastamme ympäri Suomea sekä auttamaan asiakkaita tekemään isojakin valintoja. Vaikka vastaat omasta myynnistäsi, et työskentele yksin. Tukenasi on myyntitiimi, automyynnin assistentit, myynnin johto sekä hallinnon väki.

Työaika tehtävälle on 37,5 h/vko. Myymälä on auki arkisin klo 10-18 sekä lauantaisin klo 10-16, mihin työvuorotkin ajoittuvat. Työsuhde alkaa Sakademyn järjestämillä uusien myyjien START-päivillä Helsingissä.

Tehtävän vaatimuksena on sujuva suomen kielen taito. Lisäksi sinulta löytyy B-ajokortti sekä puhtaat luottotiedot.

Kurkkaa videolta automyyjämme Osmon fiiliksiä Sakalla työskentelystä:


Miksi Sakalle? 🔥

  • Vaikuta ja kehity: Sakalla saat ajatella itse. Kasvuyrityksenä haastamme itseämme ja koko toimialaa kehittymään jatkuvasti.

  • Sakademy: Koulutusyksikkömme coachaa alan huipputekijöitä ja hiottu myynnin konseptimme auttaa sinua menestymään.

  • Hienot autot myyntituotteena: Tarjoamme 4000 laadukkaan ja monipuolisen auton valikoiman, jota on helppo kaupata.

  • Innostava työympäristö: Sakalla tekeminen on matalahierarkkista, nopeatempoista ja energistä. Arkeemme sisältyy paljon naurua, skabailuja ja aidosti hyvää meininkiä.

  • Palkkaus: Tarjoamme alan parhaat edellytykset onnistua: laadukkaan autovalikoiman, alan kovimman kannattavuuden ja motivoivan provisiomallin, joka mahdollistaa esimerkiksi 4000-10000€ kuukausiansiot. Pohjapalkka on 700€/kk sekä ensimmäiselle 2 kuukaudelle saat takuuprovision.

  • Työsuhde-edut: Työterveyshuollon Mehiläisessä, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen sekä koeajan jälkeen liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hierontaedun sekä auton myynti- ja ostoedun.

  • Etene uralla: Vahvasti kasvavassa yrityksessämme aukeaa mahdollisuuksia edetä uralla erilaisiin rooleihin ja haluamme panostaa jokaiseen meille valittuun työntekijään. Tänäkin vuonna meillä on ollut useita sisäisiä rekrytointeja uusiin ja vastuullisiin tehtäviin.

Saka on palkittu työnantaja mm. työntekijäkokemuksen, palvelun ja markkinoinnin saralla. Olemme saaneet kolme perättäistä GPTW-sertifikaattia, uusimpana vuonna 2025 Future Workplaces -sertifikaatin ja meidät on palkittu lokakuussa 2024 yhdeksi Euroopan parhaista työpaikoista Fortune 100 -listalla, sijoituksella 37! Olemme myös voittaneet laajan Palvelu 1 -ostotutkimuksen kahtena vuotena parhaana käytettyjen autojen jälleenmyyjänä, sekä markkinointimme on noteerattu useana vuotena Effie-palkinnoin. Työskentelet siis kunnianhimoisessa ja loistosuorituksiin tähtäävässä ympäristössä.

Ajattele itsesi huipulle & hae Sakalle! 🏆


Lisätietoja työnkuvasta ja tehtävästä saat Rovaniemen yksikönpäälliköltä Jere Karjulalta numerosta +358 50 4790901 tai sähköpostilla jere.karjula@saka.fi. Lähetä hakemuksesi 13.9.2026 mennessä! Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävät heti sopivien ehdokkaiden löydyttyä. Lisäksi otamme huomioon ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta tulleet hakemukset.

Tarkistamme ennen palkkausta luottotiedot.

Saka – Suomen suurin vaihtoautokauppa – tekee kaikkensa, jotta sinun ei tarvitse autokaupoilla luottaa tuuriin. Tekemistämme ohjaavat kolme arvoa; menestymme intohimolla yhdessä, arvostamme jokaista sekä olemme aina luotettava ja rehellinen.

Saka Finland Oy lukuina: Liikevaihto noin 751 miljoonaa euroa vuonna 2025, 29 myymälää ja etämyynti kautta maan, yli 220 000 myytyä autoa & yli 35 000 kotiintoimitettua autoa.

Näin rekrytointimme etenee:

  1. Hakemus: Kerro meille kuka olet ja miksi juuri sinä sopisit Sakalle. Suosittelemme videon laittamista mukaan!

  2. Lyhyt henkilöarviointi: tästä saamme lisätietoja juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi ja saat kattavasti myös tietoa itsestäsi esimerkiksi urasuunnittelua varten. Emme pohjaa rekrytointipäätöksiä tähän analyysiin vaan katsomme aina hakijoita kokonaisuutena.

  3. Puhelinkeskustelu: Nopea keskustelu puolin ja toisin – katsotaan, kohtaavatko odotuksemme.

  4. Tapaaminen myymälässä: Pääset tapaamaan myyntipäällikön ja aluemyyntipäällikön. Tässä vaiheessa pääsemme tutustumaan paremmin.

  5. Suosittelijoiden tarkistus ja luottotiedot: Haastattelun jälkeen suoritamme suosittelijoiden tarkistuksen (Refapp) sekä luottotietojen varmistuksen.

  6. Päätökset: Meillä ei turhia jarrutella eli heti kun oikea vahvistus tiimiin löytyy, lyömme nimet paperiin välittömästi.

The main role of the research assistant is to assist with research and quality improvement/assurance projects in the Division of Cardiology, Department of Pediatrics.

This research assistant will interact with the Cardiology quality lead (Dr. Steven Rathgber), Cardiology Division Head (Dr. Emilie Jean-St-Michel), as well as other members of the Division of Cardiology who pursue quality improvement/assurance initiatives.

  • Maintain and update lists, databases, and reports.

title: VP, Corporate Controller
description:
• Lead the corporate and practice accounting organization, including the development, coaching, and performance management of accounting leaders and staff supporting a geographically dispersed, multi-location organization.

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close and consolidation processes, adhering to disciplined close calendars, account ownership, review standards, and reporting timelines.

• Ensure financial statements and accounting records are complete, accurate, and prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP and Company accounting policies.

• Support and provide all financial information completely and accurately to our external tax preparers and advisors for annual income tax return preparation and distribution of multiple partner K-1s.

• Oversee accounting for healthcare practice operations, including gross-to-net patient service revenue, accounts receivable and contractual reserves, cash-to-accrual adjustments, operating expenses, payroll and provider compensation accruals, and related balance sheet accounts.

• Oversee corporate accounting for fixed assets, leases under ASC 842, debt, equity, intercompany transactions, contingencies, accruals, and other complex balance sheet and income statement areas.

• Oversee corporate Accounts Payable and ensure optimized use of Coupa P2P platform for AP automation and adherence to internal controls.

• Lead accounting for acquisitions and integrations, including purchase accounting under ASC 805, opening balance sheets, working capital and balance sheet true-ups, and integration of acquired entities into the Company’s accounting policies, close processes, and financial systems.

• Own the Company’s multi-entity consolidation and intercompany accounting framework, including eliminations, reconciliations, and appropriate accounting for management company and physician practice relationships.

• Serve as the primary accounting owner of NetSuite, ensuring the ERP is appropriately configured and governed to support multi-entity reporting, consolidations, dimensions, workflows, integrations, and scalable accounting processes.

• Establish, document, and maintain a strong internal control environment, including accounting policies, approval controls, balance sheet reconciliation standards, segregation of duties, and financial reporting controls appropriate for a growing privately held company.

• Lead the annual external financial statement audit and coordinate audit planning, technical accounting support, schedules, documentation, and resolution of audit matters.

• Research and document complex accounting matters and new accounting standards; prepare or review technical accounting memoranda and ensure consistent application of U.S. GAAP.

• Partner with FP&A and executive leadership to ensure accurate actual results, explain significant balance sheet and P&L movements, and support management and Board reporting.

• Partner with Treasury, Revenue Cycle, Payroll, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and other functions to improve end-to-end financial processes and ensure transactions are recorded accurately and timely.

• Develop accounting talent, succession plans, standardized procedures, and a scalable organizational structure capable of supporting continued organic growth and acquisitions.

• Perform other accounting, financial reporting, systems, and strategic finance responsibilities as assigned by the Chief Financial Officer.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required; Master’s degree preferred.

• Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license required.

• 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including at least 5 years in a Controller, Corporate Controller, VP of Accounting, or comparable accounting leadership role.

• Significant healthcare accounting and finance experience required; physician practice management, multi-site provider services, MSO/PPM, or other healthcare services experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience leading accounting for a complex, multi-entity and multi-location privately held company; experience in a private equity-backed or acquisition-oriented environment strongly preferred.

• Hands-on NetSuite experience required, including multi-entity consolidations, intercompany accounting, financial reporting, dimensions, workflows, and system/process optimization.

• Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP and strong technical accounting capabilities, including experience with business combinations (ASC 805), leases (ASC 842), revenue recognition, debt and equity, and other complex accounting matters.

• Experience leading external financial statement audits and managing relationships with external auditors and other professional service providers.

• Proven ability to build and lead high-performing accounting teams while remaining hands-on and detail-oriented in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

• Strong process improvement, internal controls, systems implementation, and finance transformation experience.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive presentation capabilities.

• Ability to operate effectively across a decentralized organization and partner with both corporate leaders and field/practice operations.

title: RESIDENTIAL TREATMENT-DIRECT CARE-1st & 2nd SHIFT
description:
Be the Steady Person in a Young Person's Toughest Moments.

Sometimes making an impact looks like helping a child calm down after a difficult day. Sometimes it's celebrating progress that no one else may notice. And sometimes it's simply showing up, being consistent, and reminding a young person that tomorrow is another opportunity to try again.

As a Youth Counselor with Four Oaks' Mason City PMIC program, you'll work directly with boys and girls ages 7–17 in a residential treatment setting. These young people need caring, dependable adults who can provide structure, encouragement, accountability, and support while they work toward their treatment goals.

You don't have to have all the answers. You do need to be willing to show up, build relationships, and make a difference.

What is PMIC?

Our Psychiatric Medical Institution for Children (PMIC) program provides residential treatment and support for children and teens who need a higher level of care. Our team creates a safe, structured, therapeutic environment where youth can develop coping skills, build healthier behaviors, strengthen relationships, and work toward successfully transitioning to their next step.

As a Youth Counselor, you'll be part of the everyday moments that help our youth grow. You'll build relationships, provide consistency and structure, and help young people practice the skills they're learning in treatment.

At Four Oaks, we believe every child deserves the opportunity to succeed. Our Youth Counselors are a huge part of making that possible.

This isn't a job where every day looks the same. You'll have challenging moments, rewarding moments, and moments when you realize something you said or did truly made a difference.

And while you're helping our youth grow, we want you to grow too!

Your Presence Can Make a Difference!

MASS MoCA is a vibrant non-collecting art museum with approximately 300,000 square feet of exhibition space. Half of that space is dedicated to rotating 10-month exhibitions of which we present 4 to 6 large-scale exhibitions per year, along with smaller projects. MASS MoCA frequently works directly with artists on the fabrication of new commissions and large scale site specific installations.

  • Custom fabrication based on skill and experience, ranging from woodworking to metalworking, sculptural processes, etc.
  • Maintaining a positive rapport with colleagues and artists through challenging and complex installations.
  • Maintaining safe working spaces through clear communication and tidiness.
