title: Deputy Director of Finance and Administration (0953)
description:
Reporting to the Department Head, Deputy Directors function at the highest level of department management and are responsible for all functions and activities of a major division or area. Positions in this class are exempt from Civil Service appointment (Charter Section 10.104); appointment to Deputy Director positions are made by the department head and appointees serve at their discretion.

Under general direction of the Chief Adult Probation Officer of the Adult Probation Department (ADP), the Deputy Director of Finance and Administrative Services is senior executive -level manager that plans, develops and implements all fiscal and administrative functions and activities of the department.

Positions in this class provide executive direction for highly specialized professional functions within departments. Incumbents in these positions make decisions critically impacting diverse functions of the division/bureau; manage organizational changes; and provide direction to Division Managers responsible for major program areas.

Deputy Directors within a single department may be allocated at different classification levels, including acting on behalf of the Chief Adult Probation Officer

This position oversees the financial, budgetary, procurement, fiscal and administrative affairs of the Adult Probation Department. The incumbent advises the Chief Adult Probation Officer on financial and budgetary issues, operations, human resources planning and administrative policy and legislative matters. The primary functions of this position are as follows:

  1. Department Accounting Manager
    • Serve as subject matter expert overseeing accounting and budgeting structures and hierarchies, and developing and maintaining related policies and procedures
    • Provide leadership, coordination, and primary point of contact for internal and external auditors; developing, composing, and implementing corrective action plans, progress reporting, and practice change across the department.
    • Lead development and implementation of internal controls to ensure fiduciary integrity and compliance with city/county, state, and federal fiscal, accounting, budgeting, contracting and purchasing policies and procedures and regulatory requirements.
  2. Chief Budget Strategist:
    • Develop and coordinate budget development processes and strategies to maximize funding streams from state, federal, sales, tax, vehicles, and grants.
    • Develop and manage the department’s master budget production schedule, convening division budget meetings to develop budget recommendations;
    • Compile and consolidate annual budget recommendations, appropriation modifications and mid-cycle budget amendments, and revenue and expense cost impact analysis;
    • Oversee position control and reconciliation; and managing budget expenditure and revenue projections, reporting, and budgetary controls.
    • Plan, develop and present budget narratives, budget policies and procedures, and ensuring budget system integrity and reconciliation, and budget variance reporting.
  3. Procurement
    • Serve as subject matter expert overseeing all procurement including request for proposal and other solicitation, personal service contract(PSC) development, establishing procurement policies and procedures.
  4. Interpret and ensure compliance with city procurement regulations
    • Oversee financial integrity and reconciliation of financial, accounting, budgeting, banking, and contracting systems
    • Develop and producing financial and statistical reporting of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial projections
    • Account reconciliations, discrepancy resolutions, cashiering and escheatment functions, and adjusting accounting transactions and write-offs.
    • Plan, develop, and implement financial business analytics and dashboard reporting system solution to integrate financial data in disparate accounting, banking, and case management systems.
    • Develop and implement financial and statistical feasibility studies for compliance reporting, legislative impact and funding analysis, new operations and program proposals, grant proposals, capital projects and facility renovations and relocations.
  5. Human Resources
    • Manage and oversee all areas of human resources including leave management, reasonable accommodations, examination development and administration, recruitment, labor and employee relations, payroll and operations.
    • Manage and coordinate the development and review of departmental personnel policies and procedures.
    • Interpret and ensure compliance with CSC Rules, City Charter, Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs), and other employment laws and regulations.
    • Oversee the day-to-day responsibilities of the ADA reasonable accommodation and leave management programs as well as Workers’ Compensation claims.
    • Develop and provide training to managers on employee/labor issues and trends, including administration and facilitation of disciplinary and grievance processes and performance management
    • Advise managers and supervisors on employee/labor relations issues, CBA interpretation, disciplinary actions, grievances, employee coaching, counseling, performance management, employment laws, CSC rules, City Charter, City and County of San Francisco (CCSF) policies, Department policies.
  6. Compliance
    • Monitor, analyze, and interpret federal, state and local legislation and regulations;
    • Conduct full internal affairs investigations
    • Serve as department audit manager coordinating responses to local, state and federal audits.
    • Develop and implement strategies and administrative, personnel, financial and operations policies and procedures to achieve compliance;
    • Develop recommendations to minimize department financial and programmatic impacts.
    • Consult with department executives, directors, managers and staff to plan and develop new and updated administrative/management policies and procedures.
    • Consult with department executives, directors, managers and staff to plan, develop, and implement Department’s strategic plans including a Racial Equity, Five-Year Plans, etc.
  7. Supervision
    • Planning, organizing, and managing day-to-day operations of the Finance and Administrative Services of the Department including subordinate work assignments and work schedules to ensure continuity of services to the general public and clients;
    • Supervise and train staff, evaluate their performance and takes or recommends appropriate action where disciplinary matters are concerned.
  1. Department Representation
    • Developing and maintaining collaboratively works with other City departments, Superior Court, and other organizations on joint funding projects including inter-agency agreements, MOUs, grant agreements, contracts, and oversees integrity of financial, accounting, and budgeting operations.
    • Representing the department for budgeting, accounting, and financial related matters with City and County agencies, state and federal agencies and committees, and other organizations including the Mayor’s Budget Office, Board of Supervisors, other county, state, and federal agencies, and the public.
    • Developing and maintaining relationships with elected and appointed officials, state and federal representatives, community groups, and labor organizations.
  2. Other duties as assigned

Possession of a baccalaureate degree in accounting, finance, business administration, public administration, or a closely related field; AND

Three (3) years of progressively responsible managerial experience directing a complex financial and administrative operation, all of which must include supervisory experience.

Education Substitution: Additional years of experience as listed above may substitute up to two years of the required degree (on a year for year basis).

title: AI Founding Engineer: RF Machine Learning (SIGINT) (f/m/d)
description:
Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum. Every drone, every radio, every radar leaves a trace in it. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems that listen to that spectrum, understand what is in it, and act on it.

At the centre of this sits one capability: models that learn directly from raw I/Q data. Not from decoded protocols, not from hand-built feature extractors, but from the signal as it arrives at the antenna. This is how we handle emitters no system has seen before, in environments where new frequencies, new protocols, and new platforms appear faster than any rulebook can follow.

We are looking for engineers who have this capability.

Tasks

Your role

You are the founding engineer for RF machine learning at Datacept. You take responsibility for the cognitive core of our systems. The layer that turns received I/Q data into detection, classification, and understanding of emitters for SIGINT and COMINT missions.

We build the foundation model in a space where no foundation models exist. The domain of RF machine learning is just in its starting phase. Methods that work in audio and computer vision like self-supervised pretraining, learned representations, large pretrained backbones carry over to RF only if you understand why they work.

Second, the models have to run in the field. Our systems are deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites, on hardware with real limits on compute and power.

Our cloud platform enables scalable processing of the largest RF datasets, here we can deploy the full power of the foundation model. We maintain one of the largest RF datasets in the world which is constantly growing.

Besides being the integral part of the engineering team you will directly work with the founders. You set the direction for RFML at Datacept, you make the architectural decisions, and as we grow you build the team around you.

What you will do

  • Design and train models that learn from raw I/Q recordings: detection, classification, and more
  • Research and implement ML methods from other domains to improve our data pipelines
  • Define how we evaluate: test sets, metrics, and scenarios that reflect real conditions such as domain shift between sensors, sites, and interference environments
  • Make models fit the hardware: Besides the foundation model we need expert models that are also compact and deployable on edge
  • Continuous testing of all pipelines in real world conditions provides continuous feedback
  • Integrate new data sources into our data platform

How we work

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before – the spectrum changes faster than any CV
  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. You challenge assumptions, test ideas against real recordings, and pivot when the data says so
  • Adaptability. We are organised, but things change quickly – a new idea, a customer trial, a funding deadline. You find a way to make it work and balance short-term deliverables with the long-term architecture
  • Ownership of outcomes. You optimise your own time, focus on what matters to deliver quickly, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you
  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to hardware, to the founders, and to the customers at the sites we protect, so that all the pieces fit together in the field

Requirements

Skills

  • You have built and shipped ML systems that people depend on, preferably on signal-like data: audio, time series, sensor streams, images, video or ideally RF
  • You understand self-supervised learning well enough to explain why a given method works, and you can move ML ideas between domains with intent
  • You have strong mathematical fundamentals and are comfortable when the problem first has to be formulated before it can be solved
  • You go from idea to prototype to deployed model on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck
  • You work well with few fixed structures and changing priorities
  • You are prepared for the intensity of a founding role: long and unconventional working hours, field trials, deployments
  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Helpful, not required

  • Prior work in RF or signal-centric ML: spectrum sensing, modulation recognition, SIGINT, EW. We are just as interested in people from adjacent domains who have shown they can reason about hard problems and are eager to learn
  • Projects that you build yourself (in the software/hardware) space. We want people that can create things and not just implement a set of requirements.
  • Signal processing basics: sampling, spectral analysis, I/Q representation
  • SDR, communications engineering, or embedded background
  • Publications, open-source work, or architectures that made it into production

Benefits

  • Possibility to contribute to strengthening Europe's sovereignty
  • Virtual shares (VSOP) as part of the founding engineer package
  • A development and compensation roadmap that we define together and that grows with the company
  • Remote work with full mobile equipment, plus a workplace at both of our locations: Hamburg HafenCity (HQ) and Horneburg (R&D)
  • Insights & Access to real RF data, real hardware, and real deployments

Hiring process

  • Intro call (15 min, remote) – who you are, why Datacept
  • Technical interview (45–60 min, remote) – we start with a technical challenge right away
  • Final call, in person in Hamburg with all three founders
  • Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.

title: Senior Principal AI Systems Architect
description:
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran needs an engineer-architect who can make the AI analyst experience real, dependable, and extensible. This role owns the architecture behind the analyst AI system, including metadata contracts, tool interfaces, context assembly, prompt and skill orchestration, evaluation loops, and the operational patterns that make agents useful in real workflows instead of isolated demos.

This is a systems role as much as an AI role. The challenge is not just getting an LLM to do something impressive once. The challenge is building a product-quality analyst system that can reason over schema and business context, use tools correctly, recover from ambiguity, and improve through disciplined evaluation and iteration.This is a full-time, hybrid position based at our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What Youll Do

• Define the architecture for the analyst AI stack across prompts, tools, metadata, memory and context strategies, evaluation, and runtime safety.

• Build the abstractions and interfaces that allow product teams to add new agent capabilities without creating brittle prompt sprawl.

• Design retrieval and context strategies that give the model the right information at the right time with strong cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs.

• Establish evaluation loops, benchmark suites, and review processes so model behavior can be measured, debugged, and improved systematically.

• Partner with product, engineering, and analyst-domain experts to translate real analytical workflows into robust AI-assisted product capabilities.

• Drive quality standards around correctness, trust, transparency, and failure handling in analyst-facing AI experiences.

What Were Looking For

• Deep experience building AI-enabled product systems, not just running experiments.

• Strong software architecture skills, especially around APIs, contracts, orchestration, and system boundaries.

• Practical understanding of LLM prompting, tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation methods.

• Ability to work fluently across backend engineering, product constraints, and user workflow design.

• Clear judgment about where agent systems should be flexible and where they should be constrained.

• Comfort working in ambiguous environments where patterns are still being invented.

Why This Role Matters

The quality of the AI analyst experience will shape how differentiated Fivetran feels. This role determines whether the system is merely novel or actually reliable enough to become part of an analysts day-to-day workflow. Strong architecture here reduces product risk and creates leverage for the rest of the team.

title: Commission on Human Relations - Principal Assistant
description:
This position performs advanced legal and policy work in support of the Commission’s enforcement, investigative, mediation, educational, and policy development functions. The employee provides legal guidance regarding complaints and inquiries submitted to the Commission, supports investigations through legal analysis and complaint review, and assists in the development of policies, procedures, trainings, and public education materials related to the Commission’s work.

Work includes advising investigators and intake staff on legal and procedural issues, conducting legal research, drafting legal analyses and interpretations, assisting with mediation and conciliation efforts, monitoring legislative and judicial developments, and representing the Commission in external meetings and trainings. The employee also develops educational programming and supervises legal interns and volunteer mediators.

Work is performed with considerable independence under the direction of senior leadership.

Essential Functions

  • Provide legal information, guidance, and assistance regarding inquiries and complaints submitted to the Commission.

  • Work closely with intake staff to identify potential legal claims and draft complaints for investigation.

  • Review complaints submitted by outside counsel to ensure proper jurisdiction and legal sufficiency.

  • Prepare legal issue summaries and supporting documentation for investigators assigned to complaints.

  • Conduct legal research related to federal, state, and local laws, regulations, judicial decisions, and administrative rulings relevant to the Commission’s work.

  • Advise and train non-legal staff on interviewing techniques, complaint drafting, investigative methods, discovery practices, and related procedures.

  • Develop, revise, and maintain intake forms, templates, legal analysis documents, and other operational materials to ensure compliance with new or revised legislation.

  • Create and update training programs, instructional materials, and educational resources for Commission staff and external stakeholders.

  • Conduct educational and outreach training sessions for staff, community groups, employers, advocacy organizations, and other outside entities.

  • Collaborate with senior staff to develop brochures, posters, guidance documents, and public education materials explaining existing and newly enacted legislation.

  • Collaborate with the Executive Director and Deputy Director, and Law Department to review proposed legislation and evaluate its impact on Commission operations and enforcement activities.

  • Assist in developing policies, procedures, and operational standards to ensure consistency in Commission processes and practices.

  • Monitor federal, state, and local legislative developments, as well as relevant judicial and administrative agency decisions affecting the Commission’s jurisdiction and operations.

  • Conduct case reviews with investigators and provide legal guidance regarding investigative findings and recommended actions.

  • Prepare responses to subpoenas and other legal or administrative requests for records and information.

  • Represent the Commission in professional organizations, industry groups, affinity organizations, community meetings, and public events.

  • Develop, implement, and administer the Commission’s mediation program.

  • Recruit, train, and coordinate volunteer mediators and provide substantive legal and procedural guidance as needed.

  • Create and maintain mediation program documents, procedures, and scheduling systems.

  • Remain available throughout mediations to address procedural or substantive issues that arise during the process.

location: Children's Healthcare of Atlanta Support Center
description:

Children’s is one of the nation’s leading children’s hospitals. No matter the role, every member of our team is an essential part of our mission to make kids better today and healthier tomorrow. We’re committed to putting you first, and that commitment is at the heart of our company culture: People first. Children always. Job Description

The Project Manager is responsible for leading complex operational and supply chain projects across Supply Chain and Ancillary Services, with accountability for project design, planning, execution, facilitation, implementation, change management, and sustainment. The role manages projects to defined scope, timeline, budget, quality, service, and operational performance expectations. This individual is responsible for working closely with clinical, operational, financial, technology, and vendor stakeholders. The Project Manager develops project charters, workplans, governance structures, communication plans, risk and issue logs, and performance dashboards to support transparent decision-making and successful implementation. The Project Manager evaluates project outcomes, identifies lessons learned, supports standard work and adoption plans, and makes recommendations to Supply Chain and operational leadership to drive measurable, sustainable improvement. This role may provide functional direction, coaching, and work coordination for project coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional project team members.

Job Description

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience managing projects, operational initiatives, process improvement efforts, or cross-functional workstreams in healthcare, supply chain, logistics, ancillary services, hospital operations, or a comparable complex service environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business administration, health administration, supply chain management, industrial engineering, operations management, or related field
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), Lean Six Sigma, Certified Healthcare Operations Professional, or equivalent project/process improvement certification
  • Healthcare operations, supply chain, logistics, procedural services, ambulatory operations, pharmacy, laboratory, facilities, or ancillary services project experience
  • Experience leading system-level or multi-site operational projects, technology implementations, workflow redesigns, new facility activations, or service expansion initiatives
  • Experience with project governance, executive reporting, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and change adoption
  • Experience providing functional direction, coaching, or supervision to project coordinators, analysts, or cross-functional project team members

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.

Certification Summary

  • No professional certifications required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of project management practices, including project charters, work breakdown structures, schedules, resource plans, risks/issues logs, governance routines, and status reporting
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Microsoft Planner, Teams, SharePoint, or comparable platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and monitor operational metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and project benefit realization plans
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret data, processes, workflows, and systems to identify root causes, risks, opportunities, and measurable improvement actions
  • Strong leadership, facilitation, relationship management, and influencing skills with the ability to align clinical, operational, finance, technology, and vendor stakeholders
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate project status, decisions, risks, and recommendations clearly to frontline teams, managers, directors, and senior leaders
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously, prioritize competing demands, and maintain progress despite ambiguity, resource constraints, and operational disruption
  • Ability to build trust, support adoption, and lead change across departments and locations while maintaining a customer-service and patient-care orientation
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead collaborative, cross-functional project teams and provide functional direction to project coordinators, analysts, or assigned team members

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the full project lifecycle for assigned initiatives, including intake, charter development, scope definition, planning, governance, execution, implementation, sustainment, and closeout
  • Create, manage, and execute project scope, schedules, resource plans, budgets, milestones, deliverables, metrics, and change management activities
  • Develop project charters, workplans, communication plans, governance structures, stakeholder maps, risk/issue logs, decision logs, and executive-level status reports
  • Clearly, concisely, and professionally communicate project plans, progress, risks, decisions, business goals, and governance expectations to project teams, operational leaders, vendors, and senior leadership
  • Identify, escalate, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, constraints, and opportunities proactively, recommending mitigation strategies and decision options
  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, finance, technology, supply chain, ancillary services, and vendor partners to align project activities with operational priorities and patient-care needs
  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings, workshops, readiness reviews, implementation planning sessions, process mapping sessions, and post-implementation reviews
  • Ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within scope, within budget expectations, and aligned with quality, safety, service, compliance, and operational performance goals
  • Analyze and interpret data, workflows, processes, systems, and performance trends to develop recommendations, business cases, action plans, and measurable improvement opportunities
  • Maintain and improve project management methodologies, tools, templates, dashboards, and common practices to strengthen consistency, transparency, and effectiveness across projects
  • Partner with leaders to monitor project benefit realization, including operational KPIs, service levels, process efficiency, supply availability, cost savings, risk reduction, and stakeholder satisfaction
  • Coordinate vendor activities, implementation tasks, timelines, deliverables, and issue resolution for projects involving external partners or technology solutions
  • Develop, recommend, and implement action plans to resolve project barriers and ensure successful completion of assigned projects within specified timeframes
  • Provide functional direction, coaching, onboarding support, and day-to-day work coordination for project coordinators, analysts, or assigned project team members
  • Mentor team members to encourage personal and professional growth and promote continued skill development in project management, process improvement, and healthcare operations

Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

Who Are We: -

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

About the role: -

This is a dynamic role where you get to combine people support with sales, relationship building and administration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

You will:

  • Support participants (many facing barriers such as disability, injury, or long-term unemployment) to become job-ready
  • Actively market candidates to employers and generate job opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with local businesses to create sustainable employment pathways
  • Success in this role comes from your ability to balance people support with proactive employer engagement and outcome delivery.

  • Build strong relationships with participants to understand their employment goals and position them for success.
  • Coach participants to be job-ready, competitive, and interview confident.
  • Assist participants with resumes, interview preparation, job search strategies and facilitate access to training and upskilling opportunities.
  • Drive employment outcomes by actively advocating on behalf of participants to employers and securing job placements.
  • Generate new employment opportunities through cold calls, employer visits, and face-to-face engagement with employers to generate job opportunities.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of employers to consistently convert opportunities into placements.
  • Identify and capitalise on hidden job opportunities through proactive business development.
  • Pitch candidates confidently, positioning their skills to meet employer needs.
  • Influence hiring decisions by promoting the commercial and social value of inclusive recruitment
  • Negotiate job trials, work experience placements, and wage subsidies to secure employment outcomes.
  • Maintain and grow employer relationships to drive repeat business and ongoing vacancies.
  • Achieve and exceed KPI targets across placements, engagement, and activity levels.
  • Conduct regular appointments and track participant progress toward employment outcomes.
  • Manage compliance, documentation, and data entry in line with program requirements.
  • Track performance against KPIs and achieve employment outcome targets.
  • Celebrate milestones and successful placements to build participant confidence and engagement.

What Success Looks Like: -

  • Strong employment outcomes for participants.
  • A growing network of engaged local employers.
  • Consistent achievement of KPIs and performance targets.
  • Positive, long-term placements that change lives.

About You: -

You are:

  • A natural communicator and relationship builder with confidence engaging employers.
  • Experienced in sales, business development, recruitment, or customer-facing roles.

  • Resilient, target-driven, and motivated by achieving outcomes.

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Monitor calibration schedule to ensure necessary equipment is properly calibrated in a timely manner. Works closely with calibration contractors to schedule and perform calibration activities. Review equipment specifications for the appropriateness of all preventive maintenance requirements. Collect, report, and monitor calibration performance metrics. Initiate and report any out of tolerance results. Work with equipment owners to initiate and support investigation of all calibration results for equipment found out of tolerance.
  • Provide support to Environmental Health & Safety activities.
  • Control the non-conforming material. Using a variety of inspection methods to determine if a non-conforming condition exists. Perform root cause and corrective action analysis as required. Conduct daily RCCA meeting with manufacturing, engineering and QA personnel to determine the disposition of product. Create reports to monitor trends. Authorize customer’s request for product return. Conduct investigation, coordinate RCCA meetings and provide containment and corrective action response to the customers. title: Consultant - Data & AI
description:
Role Summary

Deliver structured, insight-led data workstreams that improve data quality, support readiness and enable better decision-making across transformation programmes.

About PACT Solutions

PACT Solutions is a specialist management and digital transformation consultancy working exclusively with higher education institutions across the UK.

We help universities solve complex challenges across strategy, student records, data, change and delivery. As we grow, we want to strengthen the way we run the business internally while protecting the quality, culture and partner focus that have made us successful.

The Role

Own delivery of defined data workstreams, combining hands-on analysis with stakeholder engagement and structured delivery.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead delivery of data workstreams (planning, coordination, reporting)
  • Conduct data quality assessment, cleansing and validation activity
  • Translate data into insights and actionable recommendations
  • Develop dashboards and reporting to support programme oversight
  • Engage stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve issues
  • Maintain governance (RAID, documentation, reporting)
  • Support coordination across projects and workstreams
  • Contribute to internal tools, methods and continuous improvement

Our Values

Our values sit at the heart of everything we do:

Partnership: We work with you, not for you.

Integrity: We do the right thing, even when it requires difficult conversations.

Inquisitive: We dig deeper to uncover what will truly deliver value.

Transformative: We focus on outcomes that create lasting, measurable improvement.

Why join PACT?

Build your consulting and data delivery capability across impactful transformation programmes, with opportunities to take increasing ownership and grow within the Data career pathway.

This role sits at the Consultant level within PACT’s consulting career pathway (Analyst → Consultant → Senior Consultant → Lead → Principal), with increasing ownership of delivery, stakeholders and outcomes.

Requirements

  • Experience in data analysis, reporting or data quality roles
  • Strong SQL and experience working with structured datasets
  • Experience using tools such as Power BI (or similar)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Organised and able to manage workstreams independently

Desirable:

  • Higher education or transformation experience
  • Data migration, integration or governance exposure
  • Consultancy or project-based delivery experience

title: MIS Reports and Admin Officer
description:
MIS Reports and Admin Officer

Job Reference: MISRA/04.2026

Salary: This is a full-time role with an actual salary of up to £29,063 per annum dependent on skills and experience.

Working Hours: 33 hours per week over 4 days, working one in four Fridays, 52 weeks per year.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a MIS Reports and Admin Office to join our MIS Exams and Registry department.

The purpose of the role is to process data relating to student enrolments and attendance, ensuring accuracy of data on a timely basis for the submission of data to external agencies and for use internally. Create and maintain reports of student data as required by management.

The successful applicant must have:

  • GCSE Mathematics and English at level C/ 4
  • IT skills including Microsoft Office (Word/Excel/Outlook/Teams
  • Ability to understand and use MS SQL.
  • Ability to work on own initiative and prioritise workload producing accurate work to tight deadlines under pressure
  • Flexible and adaptability with a methodical and organised approach to work
  • Good communication skills both written and oral
  • Ability to work as part of a team and autonomously and to follow instructions and meet agreed timescales
  • Good organisational skills and able to work without supervision
  • Willingness to learn and maintain confidentiality
  • Experience and knowledge of FE and funding would be desirable

The roles main duties include to:

  • Develop, maintain and review the College suite of reports and dashboards, extracting and purposefully presenting data in an informative format.
  • Manage data to support reporting, including the creation and maintenance of databases and stored procedures, using MS SQL Server, SSRS/SSIS and ensuring these data sources have appropriate data security
  • Maintain an understanding of the technical aspect of the job and keep abreast of technical development and emerging technologies and reporting strategies
  • Respond quickly and efficiently to ad hoc data requests to suit the needs of the business.
  • Support with other duties across the MIS department, as required.
  • Advise staff on accessing information and to provide in-house training for staff in the use of information systems and other systems as appropriate
  • Streamline reporting process via Flow
  • Investigate other methods of using MIS data via other tools such as Microsoft Power BI / AI
  • Document standard operating procedures
  • Engage with MIS groups / forums
  • Process New Course Forms, maintain and set up Course Codes and Occurrences via EBS Central.
  • Check and generate part time/HE Enrolment paperwork and send out weekly ‘not generated lists’ to chase for missing forms and highlight outstanding queries.
  • Run the ILR and assist the MIS Manager in correcting any errors caused by generating.
  • Set up/maintain learner records on Learning Curve system as signed enrolment paperwork is received, request initial contact log from assessor to confirm start date and allow funding to be claimed.
  • Manage learner progressions via EBS. Send to SLT for authorisation and process as per last date of attendance on registers.
  • Assist with Timetabling and general amendments to registers as required.
  • Assist with the process of updating qualification results on the college ILR.

This role requires you to engage in regulatory activity in the FE sector. The full definition of regulatory activity is set out in the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 as amended by the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012. Regulated activity includes teaching, instructing, caring for or supervising children if the person is unsupervised.

Fancy a 4-day working week*?

Grantham College operate a 4-day working week. Staff benefit from working a full-time contract over four days. You will work core hours of Monday to Thursday, working a Friday morning once a month

Grantham College experience positive benefits from the 4-day week, including improvement to staff wellbeing and morale. We have also seen benefits in terms of reduced staff turnover leading to greater consistency of performance for our students and apprentices. The number of staff sickness absence days has reduced alongside the energy usage for the college and therefore its carbon emissions. We have also seen improvements in key quality indicators such as student attendance and retention and we are confident this will feed through into improved achievement rates and more positive outcomes for our students.

What we offer you in return:

  • An excellent pension scheme :
    • Local Government: Employer Contribution 24.5%
  • A continued professional development programme of up to £750 per academic year
  • In addition to the 8 Bank Holidays a year, a generous annual leave allowance of:
    • 5 Weeks for Support employees, this will increase to 5.8 weeks, after 5 years’ service
  • Generous occupational sick pay scheme after one years service
  • Family friendly policies, including up to 5 paid occasions for time off for dependants within a 12 month period, after the first year of service
  • Up to Five college closure days in December in addition to annual leave

The closing date for all applications will be Sunday 06 September 2026.

Job Description:

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) is seeking a seasoned Senior Zero Trust Cybersecurity Manager to support the U.S. Central Command (USCENTCOM) J6 Directorate. In this role, you will serve as an advisor and coordinator for implementing the Department of War (DoW) Zero Trust Architecture across the USCENTCOM enterprise.

You will bridge the gap between high-level defense strategy and technical execution, coordinating across diverse technical teams (Identity, Device, Network, Application, and Data) while translating progress and roadblocks into concise executive briefings, both verbal and in writing, for senior leadership including General and Flag Officers.

HOW A SENIOR ZERO TRUST CYBERSECURITY MANAGER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Road mapping: Maintain and optimize the USCENTCOM Zero Trust efforts and transition roadmap, ensuring alignment with DoW milestones and Combatant Command operational priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Synchronize efforts across diverse IT, Cybersecurity, Network and Operational teams (e.g., Identity, Endpoint, Network, Cloud, and Data Security) to drive unified Zero Trust maturity.
  • Executive Briefings: Prepare and deliver high-impact, formal briefings, visual dashboards, and performance metrics for General/Flag Officers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Procurement & Governance: Identify capability gaps across the Zero Trust pillars, define procurement requirements, support the submission and tracking of acquisition packages through the contracting lifecycle to prevent implementation delays.
  • Policy Compliance and Creation: Interpret new Executive Orders, DoW and Joint Staff policies, instructions, cybersecurity guidance, mapping them directly to USCENTCOM J6 operational activities. Develop or update USCENTCOM Zero Trust policies, instructions or technical guidance, as required.

Requirements:

  • Zero Trust Expertise: Strong familiarity with the Executive Order 14028 (Improving the Nation’s Cybersecurity), DoW Zero Trust Strategy, NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust Architecture), and the (7) DoW Zero Trust pillars, (91) Target Level Activities, and (61) Advanced Level Activities.
  • Joint Staff/COCOM Experience: Previous experience operating within a Combatant Command (preferably USCENTCOM) or Joint Staff environment.
  • Communication: Proven ability to synthesize complex technical architectures into strategic, actionable briefs for senior military leadership.
  • Operational Technology Familiarity: Demonstrated expertise of operational technologies with Zero Trust dependencies, including:
  • Identity & Access: Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM), Identity and Access Management (IdAM) frameworks.
  • Endpoint Security: Trellix Enterprise Security Suite (ESS).
  • Network Visibility: Comply-to-Connect (C2C) capabilities (including Forescout and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)).
  • Network Micro-Segmentation
  • Analytics & Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools: Splunk (Enterprise Security, User Entity Behavioral Analytics (UEBA), Security Orchestration and Automated Response (SOAR).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct knowledge of USCENTCOM’s current IT infrastructure, legacy data sources, and coalition network constraints.
  • Additional DoD 8570/8140 IAM Level II certifications (i.e., CISSP, CISM, GSLC, or equivalent).
  • Active Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Required Education: Bachelor’s degree in information technology (IT), Cybersecurity, or related field and 5+ years’ experience; or, 8+ years of experience managing/supporting complex IT and/or cybersecurity programs in a government or defense environment (preferably within the USCENTCOM Area of Responsibility).

Location: Tampa, Florida (U.S. Central Command HQ, MacDill AFB)

title: Facility & Logistics Coordinator
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an enthusiastic Facility & Logistics Coordinator to join our Carson team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a fast-paced operational environment, likes keeping things organized, and wants to build experience across logistics, facility coordination, shipment support, reporting and day-to-day site operations.

This role is ideal for a junior to mid-level coordinator who is hands-on, detail-oriented and eager to learn. You will help coordinate transportation schedules, support facility needs, maintain operational records, prepare reports and work closely with internal teams, suppliers, carriers and service providers to keep our Carson operation running smoothly.

What You’ll Do

Logistics & Transportation Coordination

  • Coordinate inbound and outbound transportation scheduling for the Carson operation.
  • Support domestic shipments, export shipments, customer deliveries, supplier arrivals and LTL movements.
  • Work with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, distribution centers and 3PL partners to confirm appointments and shipment status.
  • Prepare and maintain shipping documents, including BOLs, packing lists and supporting shipment paperwork.
  • Provide timely updates on shipment activity, delays, exceptions and follow-up actions.

Facility & Site Coordination

  • Support day-to-day coordination needs for the Carson facility.
  • Coordinate maintenance requests, site services, vendors and general facility support activities.
  • Help prepare for internal meetings, visitors, audits and operational reviews.
  • Support a safe, organized and efficient working environment.

Operational Reporting & Coordination Support

  • Maintain accurate operational records, logs, trackers and reports.
  • Support weekly and monthly reporting on logistics activity, service performance and site coordination items.
  • Help track delivery activity, customer requirements and follow-up actions.
  • Coordinate communication between Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Customer teams, suppliers and service providers.

Purchasing, Supplies & Service Support

What We’re Looking For

  • 1-3+ years of experience in logistics, operations coordination, facility coordination, warehouse support, customer service or a similar administrative coordination role.
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence working with schedules, trackers, documents and follow-up actions.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work with internal teams, customers, vendors, carriers and service providers.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Outlook and Teams.
  • A proactive, positive and organized working style, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
  • Interest in sustainability, circular economy or reuse solutions is a plus.

Why Join Us?

At Pact Reuse Retail Solutions, you will be part of a business that is helping retailers move toward smarter, more circular ways of working. This role offers hands-on exposure to logistics, facility operations and customer support in a practical, real-world environment. If you enjoy solving problems, keeping things moving and being at the center of daily operations, this could be a great next step in your career.

Interested?

We’d love to hear from motivated, detail-oriented candidates who are excited to support a growing reuse business and make a visible impact every day. Apply now or reach out to learn more about the Facility & Logistics Coordinator opportunity at our Carson site.

Our vision is to lead the circular economy through packaging, reuse and recycling solutions. It’s a future-driven group commitment, designed to create lasting value.

We’re the largest plastics recycler in Australia and New Zealand and one of the region’s biggest user of recycled materials. We have 6,000+ team members, operate 110 manufacturing facilities across 15 countries, and our customers include some of the world’s largest brands that consumers know and trust.

title: Assistant Director, Field Performance
description:
Assistant Director – Field Performance

About the Job

Assistant Directors (ADs) will serve as subject matter experts on the “Core 4” New Rep Growth & Development (NRGD) systems and processes in Recruiting, Internship, Leadership Development, and Early Productivity. They assist Principals in driving execution of business plans and aligning these plans with the broader company strategy. They will influence local strategy, operational and financial management, talent optimization, culture refinement, and leadership development by building and maintaining relationships with key network office partners. The Assistant Director will tackle complex business challenges by leveraging strong problem-solving skills and experience-based judgment, deploying the 5 Team Tools or equivalent methodologies. ADs will also help shape department and company strategy related to these focus areas by partnering with stakeholders from across the business on an ad hoc basis.

What you’ll do

  • Provide tailored consulting to network offices by analyzing data to craft sustainable, actionable recommendations that leverage the capabilities of office leaders and key team members across their portfolio.
  • Build relationships and serve as a trusted business partner to the Principal, network office executive leaders, second line leaders, and key team members.
  • Work with network office leaders and staff to stage, sequence and deliver strategic initiatives within each assigned office with a focus on driving results in the Core 4.
  • If called upon, serve as an execution resource for implementing strategic initiatives in assigned network offices on a temporary basis while consulting on how and when to best transition these initiatives to local ownership.
  • Advise network offices on leadership & culture initiatives by working with key network office leaders to build a tailored action plan leveraging belonging and impact resources and survey results following biennial Culture Survey.
  • Assist in the building and refinement of leader development programs in network offices, alignment of local offices to home office programs and resources, and providing development resources and insights to promote readiness for future leadership roles in collaboration with Managing Partners.
  • Provide proactive counsel to the Principal on tactical needs of the network office across NRGD and Leadership & Culture performance dimensions.
  • Collaborate with home office business partners to support the implementation of key growth and alignment resources connected to the home office 2030 vision.
  • Provide change management consulting and expertise to enable local offices to plan for and execute and change initiatives, both locally driven and those driven from the home office.

Skills You Have:

  • Storytelling through Data: Communicates insights and opportunities from a dataset, using narratives, visualizations, and analysis.
  • Field Advocacy: Ability to serve as a trusted advocate and liaison for the field by gathering insights, representing field needs, and influencing the design, prioritization, and delivery of products, services, and processes that improve field adoption, satisfaction, and business outcomes.
  • Client Engagement & Influence: Possesses the ability to engage, negotiate, and influence clients effectively, synthesizing complex information and executing challenges and opportunities.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Includes self-awareness and self-management, empathy towards stakeholders (internal and external) via active listening. Builds trusting relationships and establishes credibility with peers, mangers and stakeholders to influence optimal outcomes for employees and clients.
  • Consulting: Connects with stakeholders to understand and gain specific information to help resolve customer problems in a given domain. Communicates effectively intent to customers, solicits customer requirements, utilizes domain knowledge and collaborates with the right stakeholders.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
We're looking for an Applied Scientist to join the team – whose mission is to build machine learning capabilities that power better decisions, experiences and outcomes across ASOS.

You'll work on challenging real-world machine learning problems, developing scalable models and intelligent systems that support a range of business domains.

As an Applied Scientist, you'll work alongside data engineers, ML engineers, analysts, product managers and business stakeholders to design, develop and deploy machine learning solutions at scale. You'll have the opportunity to influence both the scientific direction of our ML capabilities and the products they enable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and deploy machine learning models and data-driven solutions in production environments.
  • Apply machine learning and optimisation techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Partner with engineers to productionise models and build reliable, scalable ML systems.
  • Design and analyse experiments and evaluation frameworks to measure model performance and business impact.
  • Explore, evaluate and prototype new approaches from both industry and academia.
  • Work closely with product and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where machine learning can create value.
  • Contribute to the team's technical and scientific direction through knowledge sharing, code reviews and collaboration.
  • Help shape best practices in machine learning, experimentation and applied research across the organisation.

About You

You'll enjoy applying machine learning to large-scale, real-world challenges and translating research into production systems that deliver measurable impact.

We'd be particularly interested in candidates who bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
  • Applying statistics, analytics and machine learning techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Developing and applying machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems.
    • Building predictive models, intelligent systems or decision-support capabilities using large-scale data.
    • Translating research, experimentation and analytical insights into production-ready solutions.
    • Designing and evaluating models using appropriate performance, business and customer impact measures.
    • Working across the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, from problem definition and experimentation through to deployment and monitoring.
    • Applying quantitative, statistical or optimisation techniques to support decision-making and product development.
  • Proficiency in Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar.
  • Experience working with large datasets and distributed data processing systems.
  • Strong software engineering practices, including testing, version control and maintainable code.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, pragmatism and a willingness to learn, experiment and share knowledge.
  • Experience bringing ML products from ideation through to production.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, product-driven environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native ML platforms and MLOps practices.
  • Publications, open-source contributions or evidence of staying current with developments in machine learning and AI.

  • Private medical care scheme
  • Fixed Annual Payment in addition to your salary each year, it's just an extra thank you from us
  • Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role

title: Design Intern
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Job Description

Role Overview

Design Interns will support the Product Design team in creating intuitive, consistent, and impactful experiences for enterprise users. They will work on real product features, learn design systems, contribute to user-centered research and discovery, and collaborate with senior designers and design managers to deliver measurable value. This role is especially relevant for candidates who are curious about artificial intelligence (AI), agentic design practices, and how emerging technologies can help people complete complex work with greater clarity, trust, and control.

What Makes You Qualified?

  • Portfolio with 2–3 projects showing process and outcomes.

  • Strong fundamentals in interaction design, hierarchy, and usability.

  • Proficiency in Figma (components, auto-layout, prototyping)

  • Exposure to artificial intelligence (AI) design tools and workflows, including Figma, Lovable, Cursor, or similar tools used for exploration, prototyping, and design iteration.

  • Understanding of agentic design practices, including designing experiences where AI systems can plan, act, explain their reasoning, request confirmation, recover from errors, and keep users in control.

  • Some experience with user research, competitive research, or secondary research, with the ability to translate findings into clear design decisions and product recommendations.

  • Ability to frame problems and find solutions.

  • Works well with peers and cross-functional teams.

  • Clear, structured storytelling and rationale

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

title: Delivery Practice Lead, Digital Delivery Enablement - Melbourne
description:
About Us

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Digital Delivery Enablement, the Delivery Practice Lead is accountable for designing, embedding and continuously improving the delivery system that enables consistent, predictable and high-quality delivery across Digital. The role is responsible for defining and protecting Digital's Ways of Working, uplifting delivery capability through practice leadership, and ensuring teams are equipped to plan, prioritise and execute effectively.

The Delivery Practice Lead acts as a key enabler of delivery performance, partnering with Transformation, Technology, Business and Risk leaders to improve delivery maturity, strengthen planning disciplines, and ensure future demand, capacity, dependencies and delivery readiness are visible and actively managed. Through ownership of PI Planning, delivery standards, continuous improvement practices and forward planning frameworks, the role helps Digital make informed prioritisation decisions and maximise delivery outcomes for customers, colleagues and the business.


The role owns:

  • Ways of Working, Delivery Standards & Continuous Improvement – defining, embedding and governing the delivery rhythms, standards, controls and practices that improve consistency, quality and predictability across Digital delivery.
  • Practice Leadership & Capability Development – leading the Business Analyst and Agile Delivery Lead practices to build capability, alignment, professional standards and delivery excellence.
  • Delivery Effectiveness – coaching teams and leaders to improve agile maturity, planning effectiveness, flow, collaboration and execution outcomes.
  • Planning, Prioritisation & Delivery Readiness – coordinating PI Planning and governing the Digital "Ice, Water, Steam" planning framework to ensure future demand, capacity, dependencies and delivery readiness are understood and support effective prioritisation and investment decisions.

Role type: Permanent, full time

Role location: Melbourne or Brisbane

What will your day look like?

The Delivery Practice Lead acts as a practical delivery enabler and Agile Coach across Digital, ensuring teams have clear standards, strong practice support and effective planning routines.

Ways of Working, Delivery Standards & Continuous Improvement

  • Design, maintain and continuously evolve Digital delivery Ways of Working, including delivery rhythms, artefacts, governance touchpoints, controls and minimum practice standards.
  • Embed consistent delivery practices across squads and value streams, ensuring clear expectations for planning, discovery, delivery, risk management and reporting.
  • Protect the integrity of agreed Ways of Working by challenging unnecessary variation, reducing process drift and ensuring delivery practices remain fit for purpose.
  • Partner with Transformation, Product, Technology and Risk stakeholders to ensure delivery standards enable pace while maintaining appropriate control, transparency and compliance.
  • Use delivery insights, metrics, retrospectives and practice feedback to identify systemic bottlenecks, process gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve flow, reduce hand-offs, strengthen accountability and increase delivery predictability.
  • Escalate material delivery practice risks, unresolved dependencies or recurring process failures through appropriate governance forums.
  • Ensure Digital delivery practices remain aligned to Digital Delivery Enablement priorities and enterprise delivery expectations.

Planning, Prioritisation & Delivery Readiness

  • Own the Digital "Ice, Water, Steam" planning framework, providing transparency of future demand, capacity needs, dependencies and delivery readiness across multiple planning horizons.
  • Own Digital PI Planning activities, including planning cadence, preparation milestones, stakeholder engagement, dependency management and governance.
  • Ensure teams enter PI Planning with sufficient backlog maturity, capacity visibility, dependency awareness and risk consideration to support realistic commitments.
  • Surface future resource constraints, capability gaps and dependency risks early, ensuring leadership can make timely prioritisation and investment decisions.
  • Support Digital leaders in balancing short-term commitments with long-term strategic outcomes and delivery sustainability.

Practice Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead the Business Analyst and Agile Delivery Lead practices (a team of ~80), creating communities of excellence focused on capability uplift, standards alignment and knowledge sharing.
  • Define role expectations, career pathways, practice standards and common artefacts for Business Analysts and Agile Delivery Leads across Digital.
  • Coach and support practice members to strengthen stakeholder engagement, requirements quality, planning discipline, dependency management and delivery execution.
  • Identify capability gaps and partner with leaders to shape targeted development, onboarding, succession and community learning activities.
  • Promote a culture of learning, collaboration and continuous improvement across Digital delivery practices.
  • Build organisational capability through the adoption of modern agile, lean and delivery management practices.

What will you bring?


Critical knowledge, skills and experience required for this role:

Delivery Operating Models & Ways of Working

  • Deep experience establishing, embedding and governing large-scale delivery Ways of Working
  • Strong understanding of agile, lean, product and technology delivery practices.
  • Experience designing delivery standards, governance frameworks and planning disciplines that improve delivery predictability.


Agile Coaching & Delivery Excellence

  • Demonstrated experience coaching delivery leaders and stakeholders to improve agile maturity, planning effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of flow metrics, dependency management, backlog quality and continuous improvement practices.
  • Ability to influence behaviours and drive lasting organisational change without direct authority.


Practice Leadership & Capability Development

  • Experience leading communities of practice or capability disciplines. Strong coaching and mentoring skills.
  • Proven ability to define professional standards, uplift capability and build high-performing delivery teams.


Planning, Prioritisation & Delivery Readiness

  • Experience coordinating PI Planning or equivalent enterprise planning processes.
  • Strong understanding of demand management, capacity planning, sequencing and dependency management.
  • Ability to create forward visibility of demand, readiness and delivery risks across multiple planning horizons.


Stakeholder Management & Leadership

  • Strong communication and influencing skills across business, product, technology and risk functions.
  • Ability to support strategic prioritisation discussions and facilitate decision-making across competing priorities.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in complex, matrixed environments.


Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualification in Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Significant leadership experience in portfolio management, delivery management, technology transformation or enterprise change.


Preferred qualifications

  • SAFe, Scrum, ICAgile, Agile Coaching or equivalent certification.
  • Business Analysis, Product Management or Program Management qualifications.
  • Formal training in coaching, facilitation, systems thinking or organisational change.
  • Lean, Agile or Product Operating Model certifications.

Desirable, but not mandatory, skills, knowledge and experience:

  • Experience in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry and Digital experience a bonus.
  • Experience working in agile environments.
  • Exposure to portfolio management, investment prioritisation and strategic planning processes.
  • Experience using delivery and portfolio tooling such as Jira, ADO, Confluence or equivalent platforms.
  • Knowledge of organisational change, operating model transformation and modern product delivery practices.

So why join us?

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. You'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.

At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. title: IdAM Privileged Access Management Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Pacific Life is investing in bright, agile and diverse new talent to contribute to our mission of innovating our business and creating a superior customer experience. We’re actively seeking a talented Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer who will be responsible for the delivery of Privileged Access Management (PAM) products and capabilities required to support the enterprise infrastructure and business line applications. In this role, you will assist with the development of the PAM strategy and corresponding roadmaps considering the corporate strategy, industry security trends and regulatory requirements. You will also collaborate and coordinate with IT leaders, technologists and support staff to ensure the requirements are clearly defined and established timelines are met. Finally, you will work to improve and track the maturity of the PAM products and capabilities showing increased adoption, speed to market, and resiliency.


How you’ll help move us forward:

  • Serve as a Privileged Access Management Engineer
  • Contribute to a strategy and multi-year plan incorporating all parts of PAM: scan/discovery, remediation, lifecycle management, password rotation, password vaulting, just in time administration
  • Architect, design, develop and troubleshoot PAM solutions with the ability to provide technical and architectural design documentation, recommendations, specifications, use cases, requirements and test cases
  • Create solutions that drive full automation, self-service, and resiliency
  • Eliminate duplicative capabilities where possible, reduce complexities, and leverage enterprise standards and industry best practices
  • Define best practice and development of troubleshooting processes, methodologies, standards, alerts and reporting from PAM platform(s) to be leveraged for operational monitoring
  • Identify, manage and remediate existing or future risks, issues, and roadblocks for timely delivery
  • Partner with internal technical teams ensuring the strategy and roadmaps are well understood while monitoring successful implementation
  • Lead change, by acting as change agent, to use skills and expertise to inspire a shared purpose of intent, drive awareness, communications, documentation, and training
  • Develop and implement program communications framework and metrics to keep stakeholders, customers, and IAM colleagues well informed
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of information security strategy and architecture


The experience you bring:

  • 10+ years Information Security experience, with strong focus in PAM platforms (e.g. CyberArk, Delinea, Netwrix)
  • Detailed knowledge and experience in enabling new, migrating to, and/or managing an enterprise PAM platform based on best practices.
  • Detailed knowledge and experience with automating PAM processes by leveraging out of box capabilities and custom build connectors / API’s.
  • Knowledge and experience of Just-in-Time Administration, Zero Trust, and Multi-Factor Authentication.
  • Strong technical understanding of Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure, Windows, Linux, networking, databases, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and corresponding Agile based tools
  • Proven ability to influence and gain trust at senior management levels in multi-cultural environments
  • Ability to manage complex activities simultaneously to short timescales
  • Ability to demonstrate continuous improvement


What makes you stand out:

  • BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science or related field
  • CISSP, CISM, CISA or other relevant security certifications and knowledge of ISO and NIST security standards preferred

description:

POSITION TITLE

AI Solutions Engineer

POSITION LOCATION

Stamford, CT

This position is available to NY/CT residents as Stamford, Connecticut in-office applicants

YOUR ROLE

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where Artificial Intelligence, intelligent agents, automation, and modern Microsoft technologies can improve business processes and employee productivity. You will help design, build, and support AI-powered solutions, including conversational agents, intelligent automation, and workflow integrations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems with technology and has hands-on experience developing AI, automation, or low-code solutions.

What you will be doing

  • Partner with business teams to understand challenges and identify opportunities for AI-driven solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, and support AI-powered applications, agents, automation, and workflow solutions.

  • Monitor solution performance and recommend enhancements based on business feedback and usage data.
  • Document solutions and support knowledge transfer activities.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies and recommend opportunities for adoption.
  • Support AI enablement efforts through demonstrations, training, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Support Data Servicing with the Microsoft Power Platform including Power BI.

What you bring

  • BA/BS degree, preferably in a computer science, information systems, engineering, business analytics or related field
  • 2+ years operations/IT experience, preferably in an insurance or asset management company
  • Experience with automation tools (e.g., Automation Anywhere, Power Platform or CoPilot Studio)
  • Ability to design, develop, and maintain automated solutions
  • Understanding of systems integration and workflow automation
  • Strong process mapping (as-is / to-be) and documentation skills
  • Experience working with complex business processes (e.g., investments, operations)
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and proven ability to design and maintain complex processes
  • Ability to multi-task and absorb information across a broad spectrum of systems and asset classes
  • Ability to initiate and drive tasks to completion, self-starter
  • Advanced Excel and Power BI skills (e.g., Power Queries, VBA)

Nice to have

  • Experience with MS Power Platform, Power BI, SharePoint, SQL, Python and Azure AI Foundry
  • Knowledge of Blackrock Aladdin BlackRock Trading Platform
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Services, and cloud-native technologies
  • Exposure to investment operations / asset management workflows
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Basic understanding of governance and controls for automation

COMPENSATION

High-Cost Range (includes New York): $97,300 – 146,000

Disclaimer: This role is aligned to a national market-based pay range. Actual compensation will vary based on geographic location, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in a bonus incentive plan. Incentive compensation is based on individual and company performance and is not guaranteed.

ADDITIONAL
