title: Water Service Inspector -Facilities-SFO (TPV-7316-165087)
description:
Under general supervision, the Water Service Inspector performs inspections, testing, monitoring, and regulatory compliance activities to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the Airport's potable and recycled water distribution systems.

Essential duties include, but are not limited to:

  1. Inspect, test, install, remove, replace, and verify the operation of water meters, services, backflow devices, and related equipment. Perform flow and pressure tests and inspect meter boxes, service connections, fittings, and fire hydrants for damage, improper use, or needed repairs.
  2. Investigate water service complaints and unusual water use, including low pressure, leaks, dirty water, unusual noises, tastes and odors, and high bills. Identify causes and recommend or coordinate corrective actions.
  3. Read water meters, calculate water consumption, inspect properties for leaks or faulty plumbing, and turn water services on or off for new, changed, or discontinued accounts.
  4. Review construction plans and inspect new or modified water services to verify proper meter sizing, service locations, taps, connections, and installation.
  5. Support the Cross-Connection Control Program by inspecting and testing backflow prevention devices, ensuring required annual testing is completed, and coordinating inspections and surveys with San Mateo County.
  6. Monitor construction and street work involving water services; coordinate temporary water service; verify water use and charges; and investigate unauthorized use of water from fire hydrants and water service connections. Take appropriate action to address violations.
  7. Conduct water conservation inspections and recommend ways to improve water efficiency and reduce water consumption.
  8. Collect water quality samples and support the Airport’s water quality monitoring program and compliance with state drinking water regulations.
  9. Respond to emergency water service issues and coordinate with maintenance staff, contractors, plumbers, tenants, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to restore service and resolve problems.
  10. Prepare and maintain accurate records of inspections, meter readings, water usage, service changes, repairs, sampling results, and regulatory compliance activities.
  11. Explain water service requirements, water use regulations, and compliance procedures to tenants, contractors, consultants, and other customers.
  12. Perform other functions outlined in the 7316 Water Service Classification.

1. Experience: Two (2) years of experience in a water or wastewater agency performing various phases of field and distribution operations including: water sample collection and field analysis, water service inspection and repair, meter readings, investigation of customer complaints, investigation of customer accounts or investigation and enforcement of efficiency codes and standards.

2. LICENSE AND CERTIFICATION

  • Possession of a valid California driver's license.

Required Special Condition: Some positions may require additional qualifications such as special conditions that may differ from the standard minimum qualifications associated with this classification.

  1. Possession of a California Water Distribution Operator Grade II (2) certificate upon hire
  2. Possession of an AWWA, ABPA or ASSE Backflow Prevention Assembly Certification.

Obtain the following within 12 months of appointment:

  1. Cross Connection Control Specialist Certification
  2. Grade 3 Water Distribution Operator Certification

Working Conditions: Involves possible work in inclement weather conditions with frequent exposure to various environmental elements and health hazard materials. May involve working in confines spaces, climbing ladders, stooping and bending over. May be required to deal with emergencies outside of regular schedule, including weekends and holidays.

Desirable Qualifications: The stated desirable qualifications may be considered at the end of the selection process when candidates are referred for hiring.

  • Experience as a journey-level plumber
  • Experience conducting indoor water conservation and leak evaluations at residential and non-residential properties and conducting outdoor evaluations of irrigation systems and landscapes.

title: Senior Memory Systems Design Engineer ( FPGA DESIGN) 5-8 years
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced System Design Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team. This position offers the opportunity to work on next generation NAND Flash Storage systems, develop solutions demonstrating cutting-edge architecture and extreme performance, and contribute to the validation and verification of complex designs. The ideal candidate will bring 7-10 years of proven experience in FPGA design, RTL development, and embedded systems, combined with a solid foundation in digital design principles.

Role:

You will lead sophisticated FPGA implementations, architect high-performance IP solutions, and drive innovation in accelerated, adaptive computing while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading storage solutions. You will develop critical RTL logic, be responsible for porting RTL for FPGA implementation, and oversee the verification and validation of FPGA designs to ensure robust, production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

FPGA Design & Development:

  • Design, implement, and optimize complex digital systems using Xilinx FPGAs (Zynq, UltraScale+, Versal architectures)

  • Develop and maintain RTL code using VHDL/Verilog for high-speed digital signal processing applications

  • Create timing-critical designs meeting stringent performance requirements

  • Implement advanced FPGA features including DSP blocks, block RAM, and high-speed transceivers

RTL IP Design & Integration:

  • Design reusable, parameterizable IP cores for various applications

  • Develop custom interfaces including PCIe, AXI4, DDR memory controllers, and high-speed serial protocols

  • Create comprehensive IP documentation and integration guidelines

  • Collaborate with IP verification teams to ensure robust, production-ready designs

Embedded Firmware Development:

  • Develop embedded software for Zynq SoCs and microprocessor systems

  • Implement device drivers and low-level firmware for FPGA-CPU interfaces

  • Optimize software-hardware partitioning for maximum system performance

  • Work with real-time operating systems and bare-metal implementations

System Debug & Validation:

  • Lead comprehensive FPGA system validation and verification efforts

  • Develop and execute test plans for complex digital systems

  • Utilize advanced debug tools including ChipScope, ILA, and hardware debuggers

  • Perform signal integrity analysis and timing closure activities

  • Troubleshoot complex hardware-software integration issues

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on FPGA best practices

  • Participate in design reviews and architectural decisions

  • Interface with customers and stakeholders on technical requirements

  • Drive continuous improvement in design methodologies and tools

Experience & Technical Skills:

  • 5-7 years of proven experience in FPGA design and development

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Xilinx FPGAs, including:

  • Zynq-7000 and Zynq UltraScale+ SoCs

  • Vivado Design Suite and associated tools

  • IP Integrator and block design methodologies

  • Strong RTL design skills with VHDL/Verilog

  • Embedded firmware development experience with C/C++ for ARM Cortex processors

  • System-level debug and validation expertise using industry-standard tools

  • Experience with high-speed interfaces (PCIe, DDR3/4 and NAND Flash)

Core Competencies:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams

  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git, SVN)

  • Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Tcl, Bash)

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Machine learning principles and implementation on FPGA platforms

  • Experience with other FPGA vendors (Intel/Altera, Microsemi, Lattice)

  • Knowledge of AI acceleration frameworks and neural network deployment

  • Familiarity with high-level synthesis (HLS) for ML workloads

  • Experience with high-level synthesis tools (HLS)

title: Counsellor
description:
• Full-time, 12 month fixed term position at HEW Level 8.
  • Parramatta South campus with flexible working arrangements.
  • Salary: $118,969 – $132,069 per annum, plus 17% Super and Leave Loading.


Provide counselling, case management and wellbeing support that strengthens student safety, retention and success.

The Opportunity
You will provide professional counselling, psychoeducation and case management services to students experiencing personal, academic and wellbeing concerns. Working across individual, group, phone, face-to-face and electronic service models, you will deliver timely, ethical and accessible support that contributes to student safety, retention and success.

You will assess student needs, respond to risk and support critical incident responses while maintaining accurate records and completing appropriate follow-up. You will also provide consultation, training and practical advice to staff on student mental health and wellbeing, supporting informed and consistent responses across the University.

You will contribute to service planning and improvement by reviewing student feedback, using data and practice insights, and developing prevention and education initiatives. Through multidisciplinary consultation, referrals, advocacy and stakeholder partnerships, you will strengthen early intervention pathways and coordinated student support across a multi-campus environment.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Deliver timely, ethical and accessible counselling and psychoeducation across multiple service models.
  • Provide effective case management and critical incident support, including risk assessment, accurate records and follow-up.
  • Strengthen service delivery through student feedback, data, practice insights and digital tools.
  • Build staff and student capability through consultation, training, prevention and education initiatives.
  • Maintain effective referral, advocacy and support pathways with internal and external stakeholders.


Please refer to the Position Description for full details.

About You

  • A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work or Psychology, with AASW membership or AHPRA registration.
  • At least five years of direct counselling experience within an organisational setting.
  • Experience designing and delivering group, education or training programs, including the use of technology.
  • A strong understanding of university student wellbeing, including mental health, cultural diversity, equity, identity and faith.
  • Strong communication, consultation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to resolve sensitive or complex matters.


Benefits
We invest in the people who make our mission possible. Alongside a rewarding career, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your financial, personal and family wellbeing.

  • Financial benefits: Access to staff-only products and offers with selected banking partners, salary sacrifice options for onsite parking, and novated motor vehicle leasing.
  • Health and wellbeing support: Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP), complimentary annual flu vaccination, eligibility for Fitness Passport membership, and access to discounted private health cover.
  • Onsite childcare: Long day care and early learning services operate at our Campbelltown, Hawkesbury, Parramatta, and Penrith campuses. Staff may be eligible for discounted fees and salary packaging, with places subject to centre capacity.


Application Details

  • Position Enquiries: Direct to Hiring Manager, Rhiannon Grime, Manager, Counselling via r.grime@westernsydney.edu.au. Please include the job reference code REF1795L.

  • Working Rights: You must provide evidence of full-time working rights in Australia at application.
  • How to Apply: Please note that only applications submitted via the University’s online recruitment system will be considered. As part of your online application, you will be asked to respond to screening questions addressing the key qualifications, experiences and skills required for this position.


Belonging at Western
We are committed to substantive equality as outlined in our Equal Opportunity Policy. We actively encourage applications from Indigenous Australians, candidates of all gender identities and expressions, people of all abilities, and those from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.

For Reasonable Adjustments during the application process, please contact talentacquisitionteam@westernsydney.edu.au.

title: Allergist
description:
St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.

The St. Luke’s Physician provides medical services in the general care and treatment of patients in both practice and hospital settings. Physician provides comprehensive medical services for patients on a continuing basis. Physician will provide high quality, cost effective medical care. This individual will also participate in quality, patient satisfaction and performance improvement initiatives.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs history and physical examination of all patients seen.
  • Provide cost-effective, high-quality care based on best practice evidenced based medicine.
  • Make best efforts to adhere to standardized orders and practice guidelines that have been approved by the medical staff.
  • Demonstrates competency in the assessment, range or treatment, knowledge of growth and development and communication appropriate to the age of the patient treated.
  • Provide regular, timely, and appropriate communication with referring physicians, patients and their families.
  • Participates in education of patients and their families.
  • Evaluates and implements patient health care needs. Performs routine exams and obtains patient histories. Manages patient treatment program based on assessment of needs. Initiates treatment via prescriptions, diagnostic tests, exams and procedures. Reviews lab results and plans actions according to results. Performs routine health maintenance activities for new and established patients.
  • Coordinates patient care and makes referrals to physicians, nurses, psychologists, nutritionists, et cetera, as needed. Collaborates and communicates with other professionals, nurses, physicians, and outside agencies regarding patient care.
  • Coordinates patient care and family counseling with public and mental health agencies as appropriate.
  • Teaches wellness habits and educates patients on prevention of potential health problems or method of dealing with present problems. Provides information and materials relating to patient health care needs.
  • Maintains knowledge of current medical practices and skills.
  • Maintains confidentiality of all materials handled within the Network/ Entity as well as the proper release of information.
  • Complies with Network and departmental policies regarding issues of employee, patient and environmental safety and follows appropriate reporting requirements.

PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:

Sitting for up to three (3) hours per day; three (3) hours a t a time. Standing for up to eight (8) hours per day; eight (8) hours at a time. Walking for up to six (6) hours per day; one (1) hour at a time. Frequent fingering, handling, grasping, twisting, and turning as it relates to therapeutic procedures. Consistently lift, carry, and push objects up to 10 pounds. Occasionally lift, carry, and push objects up to 75 pounds. Rarely lifting with assistance, up to 100 pounds. Rarely pushing and pulling patients weighing up to 300 pounds in a wheel chair or stretcher. Occasionally stooping and bending. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Seeing as it relates to normal near, far, color, and peripheral vision. Hearing as it relates to normal conversation and high and low frequencies.

EDUCATION: Graduate of an accredited medical school and completion of residency and/or fellowship in area of specialty.

TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE: Current or recent experience in area of specialty.

LICENSE AND CERTIFICATIONS: MD or DO - licensed by the state licensure board within the State of practice. Board Certified/Eligible in the area of specialty by the appropriate medical board.

Please complete your application using your full legal name and current home address. Be sure to include employment history for the past seven (7) years, including your present employer. Additionally, you are encouraged to upload a current resume, including all work history, education, and/or certifications and licenses, if applicable. It is highly recommended that you create a profile at the conclusion of submitting your first application. Thank you for your interest in St. Luke's!!

Organization

  • Embracing related assignments and responsibilities as required to contribute to the overall success of our team.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Fantastic communicator both written and oral

Temporary, Full Time

£35.00 ph umbrella

Essex County Council (ECC) are delighted to be supporting Maldon District Council to recruit a Principle Technical Lead on a three-month temporary basis. Please note that this role requires 2 days a week site attendance.

Maldon District Council is looking for an experienced and proactive Principle Technical Lead to play a key role in supporting the effective delivery of Development Management services.

This is an important leadership role within the Place, Planning & Growth service, supporting the day‑to‑day management of Technical Support and Validation functions. The role focuses on ensuring compliant, efficient and customer‑focused processes, strong team performance, and continuous service improvement.

The role:

Reporting into the Technical Support Team Leader, you will:

  • Support the day‑to‑day management, workflow and prioritisation of Technical Support and Validation Officers
  • Act as a point of escalation for complex or sensitive customer and internal enquiries
  • Help drive service improvement, consistency and resilience across Development Management processes
  • Support staff development, performance management and training
  • Contribute to improved systems, digital services and customer self‑service
  • Work collaboratively across teams and services to support statutory and corporate objectives

This role suits someone who combines strong technical understanding with people leadership, process improvement and a genuine commitment to public service.

The experience you will bring:

  • Strong experience in Development Management and/or Building Control environments
  • Confidence managing workflows, priorities and competing demands
  • The ability to support and develop others through coaching, guidance and clear communication
  • Experience contributing to business or process improvement initiatives
  • A customer‑focused approach, with the confidence to handle complex or contentious enquiries
  • Good working knowledge of planning support systems and digital tools
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work positively with colleagues, members, partners and stakeholders

The ideal candidate will need to attend the office at least twice a week, ideally Tuesday and Wednesday or Wednesday and Thursday.

To read more about us please visit: https://www.maldon.gov.uk/site/

Maldon District Council is an equal opportunities employer and therefore all staff are expected to comply with our equality policies and help create a work environment in which everyone is treated with dignity, respect, courtesy and fairness. You are also expected to fully comply with health and safety policies and procedures in force to help maintain and develop a safe working environment. In pursuing a practice of continuous improvement and seeking to obtain best value in all aspects of the service, staff will be expected to assist in other such duties as may be allocated for the benefit of the organisation and their own personal development. Staff will be expected to assist if the council has to deal with the results of a civil emergency.

What you should do next

If you are interested in finding out more about this role, we would love to hear from you. Please apply via the Working for Essex website.

Please note that Maldon District Council has determined that the off-payroll working rules will apply to this assignment and where a worker elects to provide their services through an intermediary (such as a personal services company) then income tax and primary national insurance contributions will be deducted at source from any payments made to the intermediary.

title: Mechanical Maintenance Officer
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

Our Port Kembla Manufacturing facility is looking for a Mechanical Maintenance Officer in our Hot Strip Mill (HSM) Team based in Port Kembla. As a part of the broader Australian Steel Products portfolio, we have six major manufacturing sites at Port Kembla that deliver a variety of products, innovative solutions and services to our export and domestic customers

In this critical role, you will use your technical background and experience to deliver key outcomes in maintaining and developing the Down Coiler and Coil Handling equipment. You'll implement and improve our maintenance strategies to achieve optimum equipment performance and reduction in failures, as a result; your contributions will ensure that this world-class asset delivers safe, efficient and reliable continuous operations.

What Will You Do?

As a Mechanical Maintenance Officer, you will:

  • supervise the day-to-day management of plant maintenance activities, including planning, organising, execution and review of maintenance
  • coordinate and provide technical support to the maintenance resources within the section
  • coach, mentor and develop maintenance personnel in manufacturing excellence principles and process, particularly around root cause and problem analysis and the development and execution of corrective actions
  • participate in cost reduction and capital upgrade projects
  • respond to the day-to-day Mechanical availability and reliability issues

More About You

As an enthusiastic and motivated individual, you will bring your experience and demonstrate a willingness to develop your skills. You will also bring:

  • a Mechanical Trade or tertiary qualifications
  • experience working in a similar industry within Mechanical Maintenance, with a focus on defect elimination and equipment reliability
  • a commitment to the safety and wellbeing of yourself and others
  • experience in maintenance coordination and collaboration with multiple internal and external customers

Why BlueScope

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope gives you opportunities to innovate, learn and grow with the business, supported by inclusive leadership and a positive, passionate team. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. With opportunities to build skills specific to your role and aspirations, our lifelong learning culture will support your future career pathways.​
  • Create innovative solutions. Seek better, smarter ways to solve problems, create sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do. ​

At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and welcome people of all backgrounds, skills, experiences and perspectives. description:
$68,600-$85,000 Annual Salary + Comprehensive Benefits

Full-Time | Extensive Regional Travel | Field Operations | Safety Leadership


Make an Impact Where Safety Matters Most


Hulcher Services is seeking an experienced Regional Field Safety Specialist to help protect our employees, support field operations, and strengthen our culture of safety across multiple locations.


This is not a desk-only position. You'll spend time in the field working directly with crews, managers, and leadership to ensure safe operations during railroad, industrial, environmental, and emergency response projects throughout your assigned region.


If you're passionate about safety, enjoy traveling, and thrive in fast-paced industrial environments, this could be the career opportunity you've been looking for.

About Hulcher Services

Hulcher Services is a nationwide leader in railroad, industrial, environmental, and emergency response services. With more than 500 employees operating from over 25 divisions throughout the United States and Mexico, our teams respond to derailments, industrial emergencies, disaster recovery projects, environmental remediation, engineering services, and track maintenance.


Safety is the foundation of everything we do—and our Field Safety Specialists play a critical role in ensuring every employee returns home safely.


What You'll Do

As a Regional Field Safety Specialist, you'll partner with operations leadership to promote safe work practices, reduce risk, and ensure compliance across multiple job sites.


Responsibilities include:

  • Conduct field safety audits, inspections, and jobsite evaluations.
  • Investigate workplace injuries, incidents, near misses, vehicle accidents, and DOT-related events.
  • Prepare detailed reports and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, FRA, DOT, and company safety policies.
  • Deliver safety training, coaching, and mentoring to field personnel.
  • Assist in developing and updating safety training programs and educational materials.
  • Evaluate jobsite hazards including confined spaces, elevated work, hazardous materials, noise, dust, vapors, and other environmental risks.
  • Recommend and monitor corrective actions to minimize workplace hazards.
  • Provide technical guidance regarding PPE, respiratory protection, confined space entry, and safe work practices.
  • Maintain accurate safety documentation, training records, and compliance files.
  • Partner with operations managers to strengthen the company's safety culture.

title: Deputy City Solicitor - Tax Litigation and Collections Unit - Business Tax Division
description:
Position Summary

The City of Philadelphia Law Department is seeking to hire an attorney as a Deputy City Solicitor in the Tax Litigation and Collections Unit’s Business Tax Division. The ideal candidate has tax law experience, and strong communication, analytical, and writing skills. In addition, preference will be given to candidates with significant experience in the City of Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas.

Essential Functions

The functions listed below are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or essential functions. Duties may be modified, assigned, or reassigned as operational needs evolve, consistent with applicable law.

  • Mentoring junior attorneys in the Division.

  • Assisting the Divisional Deputy with training and case management;

  • Trying state court collection cases before the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas:

  • Working with lawyers from the Appeals Unit on tax cases taken to the Pennsylvania appellate courts;

  • Trying agency appeal cases before the Tax Review Board and resulting statutory appeals in state court;

  • Attending court conferences and hearings;

  • Reviewing regulations and providing advice as requested to the Revenue Department;

  • Drafting pleadings, motions, and briefs; and

  • Researching and analyzing complex legal issues

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of laws, legal codes, court procedures, precedents, government regulations, executive orders, and agency rules and process;

  • Significant experience in the City of Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas

  • Ability to analyze large amounts of information, determine relevant facts, and propose viable solutions;

  • Ability to find what applicable laws and regulations apply to a specific matter;

  • Ability to communicate information and ideas in writing so others will understand. Must be able to clearly present and explain their case to arbitrators, Board members, opposing parties, or judges, and listen, answer questions, present to large groups and high-level officials and employ diplomacy in challenging situations.

  • Ability to effectively communicate complex rules and procedures to the public and to businesses.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to identify and analyze legal issues within complex fact patterns.

  • Ability to foster and maintain a collegial, inclusive, and professional work environment.

  • Excellent writing, case management, negotiating, and trial skills.

  • Ability to support and supervise a team of attorneys and professional staff.

  • Ability to train professional legal staff as well as non-legal staff on applicable legal requirements.

  • Excellent judgment and critical thinking in high-pressure situations.

  • Strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion;

  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to work on teams and collaborate with colleagues and clients;

  • This is an intermediate level position, with a minimum of approximately five (5) plus years of legal experience relevant to the subject matter and/or responsibilities required.

  • Candidates must have a law degree from an ABA accredited law school and must either be a member in good standing of the Pennsylvania Bar, or currently be eligible to be admitted by reciprocity to practice in Pennsylvania (Pa.B.A.R. 204). Continued employment of attorneys not admitted to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania within six (6) months of hire is at the discretion of the Law Department.

Work Location & Onsite Expectations

This position is designated as fully onsite and employees are expected to report in person five (5) days per week, in accordance with the City Policy. Regular on-site presence is an operational requirement of this role.

description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Located on the southeastern coast of the pristine island of Lāna’i, lies the secluded retreat of Four Seasons Resort Lāna’i, an oceanfront destination offering travelers a curated, personalized island escape. The five-star, five-diamond Resort offers outdoor restaurants, including Nobu Lāna’i, a kid’s club, Tennis Garden, cultural programming, beach and pool with spacious seating areas nestled among tropical gardens, Hawanawana spa and luxury retail boutiques. Built on lava outcroppings, the award-winning Jack Nicklaus-signature golf course features ocean views on every hole. Island activities, many managed by Four Seasons include sunset sails and whale watch tours, horseback riding, sporting clays and archery, biking, hiking, and aerial adventures at Lanai Adventure Park or learn about Hawaiian wayfinding at the on-site observatory.

OBSERVATORY GUIDE

The Four Seasons Resorts Lāna’i is looking for an Observatory Guide who shares a passion for excellence and who infuses enthusiasm into everything they do. Our teams have the opportunity to shape our guest experience by providing exceptional knowledge of the Resort and exemplifying the Golden Rule in each interaction. Work authorization required.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Observatory Guide delivers immersive observatory experiences that combine astronomy, Hawaiian culture, and luxury guest service. This role leads nightly stargazing programs with a 1‑meter telescope, conducts presentations and workshops, and maintains observatory equipment. The position works closely with resort teams and community partners, supports cultural programming, training, and special events, and consistently upholds high standards of service, safety, and cultural respect. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead and facilitate nightly observatory experiences, including storytelling, cultural interpretation, Hawaiian wayfinding, and guided stargazing for group and private sessions

  • Operate and oversee the safe use of a 1‑meter telescope and related systems; conduct safety briefings and guide guests through celestial viewing experiences (planets, galaxies, star clusters)

  • Manage observatory bookings and guest communications using internal systems (Outlook, Book4Time, Key), including scheduling, reservations, waivers, and coordination of guest preferences and flow in collaboration with resort teams

  • Support internship programs, team development, and community outreach by mentoring students and assisting with training, educational events, and community nights

  • Partner with Activities, Concierge, Guest Services, and Cultural teams to coordinate programming, events, guest logistics, and transportation while supporting cultural programming as scheduled

  • Maintain observatory equipment (telescope, optics, cameras, software), monitor environmental conditions for optimal viewing, and assist with astrophotography and image processing to enhance guest experiences

  • And More!

WHAT TO BRING

  • Successful candidate must possess legal work authorization in United States

  • The hospitality business functions seven (7) days a week, twenty-four (24) hours a day and scheduled days and times may vary based on need. Holidays and weekends availability is required.

  • Hawaii Driver’s Abstract and PUC Certification is required for this role

  • Ability to stand for extended periods, lift up to 30 lbs., and push/pull as needed during shifts

  • Strong public speaking and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and educate diverse audiences

  • Knowledge of or willingness to learn astronomy, Hawaiian wayfinding, and celestial navigation

  • Additional cultural or astronomy-related certifications are preferred

JOIN OUR ‘OHANA & ENJOY OUR AMAZING BENEFITS:

  • 100% Employer contributed Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

  • Competitive wages and other benefits (Retirement Plan, Wellness Credit, etc) as well as Paid Time Off & Holiday Pay

  • Inclusive and diverse employee engagement & recognition events all year-round

  • Complimentary stays and exclusive discounts at Four Seasons Worldwide

  • Complimentary Employee Meals & Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms

  • Owner subsidized on-island housing, inter-island airfare to Oahu and other resources

  • Comprehensive learning and development programs to help you master your craft

  • Energizing Employee Culture where you are encouraged to be your true self!

  • And so much more!

How you will make an impact:

· Lead efforts in defining institutional lifetime income product features and necessary documentation to facilitate knowledge transfer and development of requirements across project teams. Products can include annuity and retirement solutions proprietary to Pacific Life, or in collaboration with strategic partnerships.

· Collaborate with and influence various stakeholders including risk, pricing, legal, finance, sales, and operations.

· In partnership with the project management function, drive the end-to-end product implementation process, including idea generation, requirements gathering, and product design to ensure seamless implementation.

· Coordinate with marketing and sales teams to plan and execute successful product launches, which includes effective product positioning, training materials and optimal sales support via product collateral and presentation deck updates. Be able to lead and/or support product training across various stakeholders.

· Conduct market research to identify customer needs, market trends. Gather insights to guide product development strategies.

· Monitor DCLI and retirement income competitive landscape broadly and create positioning and differentiators against competitors. Contribute to competitive intelligence updates.

· Identify retirement market needs by leveraging insights from the sales / relationship management / strategic partnership teams.

· Apply industry knowledge to drive product development strategies and identify market opportunities.

· Track product performance metrics, client feedback, and market response. Continuously evaluate product success and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement. Report out on progress to senior leadership as needed.

· Partner with our Consumer Markets Division (CMD) to understand enterprise retirement product initiatives and determine areas of cross collaboration and information sharing, with the goal of creating economies of scale in the product development process.

· Represent Pacific Life’s Institutional Division at industry events and conferences.

The experience you will bring:

· Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, economics, or a similar field.

· Extensive knowledge of retirement solutions and annuities in the financial services industry, with a strong preference for Defined Contribution experience.

· Demonstrated 10-12 years of experience in product development and/or product management in the retirement/insurance/annuity industry.

· Ability to influence, partner and collaborate with divisional stakeholders.

· Strong desire for collaboration and a demonstrated ability to think creatively.

What will make you stand out:

· In depth knowledge of Defined Contribution plans, lifetime income product types and competitor landscape.

· Desire to stay up-to-date with retirement income trends, emerging technologies and regulatory changes that impact the insurance landscape.

· Experience with retirement plan advisors, plan sponsors and plan administrators.

· Finance, Actuarial, and/or Quantitative background, with an ability to create proof of concepts, business cases, and understand pricing and profitability.

· An agile mindset and the ability to demonstrate results in a start-up environment.

· Compelling presentation skills.

· Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

· Advanced degree, certifications and/or industry licensing (MBA, CFA, ASA/FSA, or other relevant education/designation/licensing).

Depending on the customer use case, you will work across cloud data platforms, integration architectures, agentic AI systems, governance and operating models. You help bring today's trends down to earth and turn them into real, lasting business value. As part of a dynamic and fast-growing practice, you will develop with the field itself - at our customers and inside our own organisation.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as an AI & Data Architect, you

  • Define target architectures and roadmaps across AI & Data platforms that are aligned with our customers' business, IT and security requirements
  • Translate between the worlds of engineering, business, IT and operations, making sure everyone ends up with the same picture
  • Guide customers in building AI-ready data foundations and governance, from data quality and access control to lineage
  • Own architecture decisions and make them traceable through ADRs, documented trade-offs, and the reasoning behind them
  • Put our partnerships with Microsoft and Databricks to work, weighing up for each customer which technology decision fits their case
  • Support pre-sales through technical discovery, solution design and effort estimation, and stay with the project from concept to implementation

Who we are looking for

  • Strong experience designing and implementing modern Data & AI architectures, from the data foundation to the AI services and workflows built on it
  • Confidence in customer-facing situations - from technical discovery to explaining a difficult architecture decision to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to build architectures that evolve, working hands-on and in close collaboration with engineering & operations teams
  • You have taken Data & AI solutions into production, not just into pilots - including governance, security, scalability, observability and lifecycle management
  • Up-to-date knowledge of platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry or Databricks, gained through hands-on experience
  • Professional working proficiency in German and English, enabling you to confidently communicate with customers and project teams

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes actions and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. You take ownership of architectural topics and feel comfortable guiding teams and customers through decision-making processes. You are communicative, collaborative, and able to translate between business and technology. Continuous learning and curiosity for new technologies are part of your mindset. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We offer

  • professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance
  • access to an extensive international network of industry experts
  • opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector
  • flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working
  • benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “KlimaTicket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more.
  • We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful.
  • Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge

The annual gross salary for this position will start from € 80.000,00 on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. Our aim is to provide you with a salary package that is both competitive and reflective of your relevant experience, while also aligning with current market standards.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Cloud Platform Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing core components of the cloud infrastructure that support business services, with a focus on improving availability, reliability, and operational excellence. This role works within an agile, cross-functional team managing a customer cloud environment encompassing hundreds of servers and multiple cloud service implementations (SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS). The engineer is expected to apply strong hands-on expertise in cloud technologies, maintain configuration standards, and stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and software development best practices.

Responsibilities | CORE

  • Set up, test, implement, and maintain technologies in AWS cloud environments.
  • Set up, test, integrate, and support CI/CD tools and pipelines.
  • Architect and develop cloud solutions to meet project and service requirements.
  • Work in an agile, cross-functional team; actively engage to ensure team and delivery success.
  • Solve complex technical problems independently and collaboratively.
  • Operate, manage, and support IT infrastructure and services to meet prescribed client service levels.
  • Provide AWS production maintenance support (monitoring, tuning, patching, updates/upgrades).
  • Demonstrate hands-on DevSecOps practices, including Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development and deployment for project deliveries.
  • Use AWS CloudFormation to automate infrastructure deployment and reduce production lead time.
  • Build, maintain, and support Amazon Machine Images (AMI) and Auto Scaling Groups (ASG).
  • Improve resource utilization and implement resource tagging to support cost allocation, budgeting, reporting, and governance.
  • Ensure implementations and operations align with client technology standards and policies.
  • Review and improve operational/service support processes using industry best practices.
  • Document new and updated processes, standards, and runbooks.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of technology standards, industry trends, emerging technologies, and software development best practices.

Essential Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Experience implementing and supporting cloud infrastructure components in production environments.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools, including setup, testing, and integration.
  • Hands-on experience with operations/support practices (monitoring, tuning, patching, upgrades) for cloud-based production systems.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevSecOps practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues individually and as part of a team.
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to create and maintain technical documentation (processes, procedures, operational runbooks).
  • Understanding of cloud service delivery models (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) and supporting infrastructure at scale.

Preferred Attributes

  • 1–3 years of experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience using AWS CloudFormation to automate infrastructure deployments.
  • Experience developing and maintaining AMIs and Auto Scaling Groups (ASG).
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization and governance, including resource tagging strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to continuously improve service support processes based on industry best practices.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with stakeholders and team members.

Professional and/or Technical Certifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (preferred)
  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate (preferred)
  • AWS Certified Developer – Associate (nice to have)
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (preferred)
  • DevOps/DevSecOps-related certifications (nice to have)

ADDITIONS

  • Work with team lead to ensure design and codes conform to architecture and standards
  • Participate in peer reviews to improve project quality.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

Como Supervisor de Stewarding supervisaras y coordinará las actividades de todos los Stewards para garantizar el funcionamiento fluido y eficiente del departamento.

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Previa experiencia a nivel supervision minima de 2 años en hoteleria de Ultra lujo

  • Experiencia en estándares de limpieza

  • Conocimiento en manejo de químicos e inocuidad alimentaria.

  • Conocimiento en montaje de eventos.

  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Supervisar que el personal cumpla con la apariencia personal, y hábitos de higiene

  • Hacer recorridos constantes por todas las áreas, verificado limpieza, orden, necesidades y cualquier anomalía que pudiera afectar la operación del día.

  • Colocar las piezas dañadas o excesivamente gastadas en un área designada para su reparación.

  • Utilizar y almacenar de forma segura todos los compuestos de limpieza, productos químicos y materiales, incluida la solución de remojo, utilizando la ropa protectora adecuada.

  • Realizar las ordenes de mantenimiento de todas las anomalías y de mantenimiento preventivo

  • Supervisar que el miembro asignado al área de trabajo cumpla con sus funciones con el procedimiento establecido.

  • Supervisar el programa de Limpieza profunda, cheklist de limpieza y temperaturas de maquina lavaloza y asegurarse que el personal lo llene correctamente.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

title: HRIS Administrator
description:
He angituutanga: The opportunity

Fixed-Term 14-Month Contract (Parental Leave Cover)

Join a team that plays a vital role in supporting the people who keep Hamilton moving.

Reporting to the Remuneration and Benefits Manager, we're looking for an experienced HRIS Administrator to join our People, Performance and Culture team on a 14-month fixed-term contract, commencing in mid-October 2026.

This role is ideal for an organised, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with HR systems and employee data. Reporting to the Remuneration and Benefits Manager, you'll be responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of employee information while delivering responsive, customer-focused support to employees and leaders across the business. You'll also support the administration of employee benefits and remuneration processes. As part of a collaborative team, you'll play an important role in ensuring our people have a seamless experience throughout their employment journey.

About the Role

As our HRIS Administrator, you'll be responsible for processing employee transactions and maintaining employee records within SAP SuccessFactors, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and a high standard of service delivery.

Some key responsibilities include:

  • Processing employee transactions in SAP SuccessFactors, including appointments, employee movements, remuneration changes, leave-related updates, and terminations.
  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee records, ensuring the integrity of HR data.
  • Managing position and vacancy administration within the HRIS.
  • Supporting the administration of employee benefits and related processes.
  • Assisting with remuneration and benefits reporting, annual reviews, surveys, and other related activities.
  • Preparing employment-related documentation and employee correspondence.
  • Responding to employee, manager, and stakeholder enquiries regarding employee data, benefits, remuneration, and administration processes.
  • Conducting regular audits and data quality checks to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Supporting payroll and other business functions by providing timely and accurate employee information.
  • Running reports and assisting with people data analysis and reporting requirements.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve HRIS administration processes and system efficiencies.
  • Contributing to a positive employee experience through responsive, professional, and customer-focused service.

Oo puumanawa me oo wheako | Your skills and experience

To be successful in this role, you'll bring:

  • Experience in HRIS Administration, Employee Administration, HR Administration, Payroll Administration, or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with employee administration processes in SAP SuccessFactors is a must, including processing employee transactions and maintaining employee records.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • An understanding of employment legislation and the importance of confidentiality when handling employee information.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Experience producing reports and working with employee data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • A proactive approach, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

He aha te wariu o te utu kaimahi? | What’s the salary?

Circa $65k - $75k dependent on skills and experience.

Ngaa waahi whakarato painga kei a maatou: What we offer

  • Flexible by choice; an award-winning flexible working policy.
  • Opportunities for professional development.
  • Two Wellbeing days per year.
  • Free health insurance through Unimed including hospital/surgery grade cover and discounted. membership rates for family members.
  • Free annual health checks and flu vaccination.
  • Ability to purchase additional annual leave.
  • Eye testing/glasses cost reimbursement.
  • Discounted purchases from local businesses; gym memberships, cafes, dentists, hairdressers and many more.

  • Click apply
  • ​Complete your application.

If you wish to include a cover letter with your application, please combine this in the same file as your resume and upload as a PDF file. Alternatively, you can use the 'Write a message to the Hiring Team' text box.

Applications close on the: 6th September 2026

Note: We will be shortlisting and interviewing as we receive applications.

title: Team Leader
description:
What You’ll Do

As a Team Leader, you will drive sales and deliver an outstanding customer experience by leading, motivating, and developing your team of colleagues. You will collaborate closely with the management team to support the daily running of the store, uphold excellent operational standards, and create a high performing and engaged colleague experience.
You will provide clear direction, daily coaching, and in-the-moment feedback to ensure colleagues understand expectations, deliver great service, and maintain strong store standards. With a consistent focus on size availability, stock fill, and merchandising execution, you will help maximize sales while creating a fast, friendly, and efficient shopping experience for customers.
Daily, you will collaborate with managers across the store to support colleague performance, manage operational priorities, and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and high-engagement culture. Here is how it looks in action:
• Maintain strong stock levels and size availability to maximize sales and meet customer expectations.
• Deliver excellent store standards by ensuring the sales floor is well-presented, merchandised, and fully replenished.
• Allocate daily tasks and support schedules so colleagues are productive, engaged, and focused on the right priorities.
• Oversee key customer areas and ensure a fast, friendly, and efficient shopping experience.
• Support day-to-day store operations, including opening, closing, and store duty management when needed.
• Review customer service feedback, handle customer issues professionally, and escalate when appropriate.
• Coach, motivate, and support colleagues through effective communication, recognition, onboarding, and ongoing development.
• Ensure pricing, signage, markdowns, stockroom organization, and safety checks are completed accurately and in line with operational standards.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We’re committed to your success and will provide you with a robust onboarding period. Here, you’ll be empowered to succeed. As we rapidly expand across the globe, we’ll give you the tools that you need to excel. We’ll also offer you competitive benefits and work life balance – we know your life outside of the store is important.

What You’ll Bring

As a Team Leader, you will report into the Department Manager & support the store by leading and developing a team of Sales Associates. Here is what you will bring to the role:

• The ability to lead, motivate, and manage a team effectively, fostering a positive and supportive working environment.
• Strong customer service skills with the ability to deliver a great shopping experience and resolve issues confidently.
• Good organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
• The ability to think on your feet, solve problems, and adapt to changing store needs or customer demands.
• Clear and effective communication skills for interacting with customers, colleagues, and management.
• Confidence using retail technologies, including cash registers, self-checkouts, tablets, and handheld POS devices.
• Position holder must be able to communicate effectively and efficiently, orally and in writing, with managers, supervisors, and hourly colleagues in English to provide instruction, coaching, corrective action, safety instructions and lead teams as a manager daily and in emergencies. Position holder must also be able to provide amazing customer service in English, which includes being able to orally communicate with customers in English and monitor the performance of English-speaking colleagues whose job duties require communication with customers.

Excited? Good. Because it’s energizing to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to helping people express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.

title: Senior Software Engineer, CoinDesk Media
description:
CoinDesk is the most trusted media, events, indices and data company for the global crypto economy. Since 2013, CoinDesk Media has led the story of the future of money and investing, illuminating the transformation in society and culture that comes with it. Our award-winning team of journalists delivers news and unparalleled insights that bring transparency, comprehension and context. CoinDesk Events gathers the global crypto, blockchain and Web3 communities at annual events such as Consensus, the world’s largest and longest-running crypto festival. CoinDesk Indices offers expertise in digital asset indices, data and research to educate and empower investors. For more information on CoinDesk media and events, please visit http://coindesk.com [coindesk.com] and for breaking headlines, data and indices visit http://coindeskmarkets.com [coindeskmarkets.com]

In November 2023, CoinDesk was acquired by the Bullish group, owner of Bullish, a regulated, digital assets exchange. For more information on Bullish, please visit https://bullish.com . CoinDesk operates as an independent subsidiary with an editorial committee to protect journalistic independence.

Reports to:

Director, Engineering, CoinDesk

Engineering Organization & Culture

At Bullish & CoinDesk, we are engineering the institutional standard for the digital asset industry. Our mission is to build a platform centered on security and compliance, requiring a commitment to technical excellence that extends beyond simply delivering code. As a global organization, we set a high bar for those driven to do their best work alongside world-class peers.

We value engineers who treat development as a craft and own the outcome from concept to deployment. We expect our teams to bring structure to ambiguity and shape the frameworks that support our global organization. We refuse to compromise on quality and seek problem solvers who thrive on high-impact technical challenges.

The Team: CoinDesk Media Engineering

Our Media Engineering team is the technical engine behind the world’s leading digital asset information platform. They are responsible for the architecture, development, and continuous optimization of coindesk.com and its accompanying mobile applications, ensuring millions of global users have seamless access to real-time news, market data, and multimedia content.

We're looking for Senior Software Engineers with expertise in Node.js and React to help build our next-generation media products. This role is all about designing and building innovative products that deliver crypto news, insights, and experiences to millions of users, with a focus on user experience, modern engineering practices, and continuous iteration. You'll be working on products that distribute and personalize content, making CoinDesk a daily habit for crypto enthusiasts and investors. This includes building high-performance and scalable backend systems and engaging web and mobile experiences.

If you love working across the stack, enjoy tackling engineering challenges, and want to make an impact in the media and content space, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do:

  • Build and maintain back-end services and React front-end applications that power real-time content delivery, monetization, and interactive features across web and mobile.

  • Build and integrate AI-powered agentic workflows into our products and internal tooling, leveraging LLMs and emerging AI capabilities.

  • Work with product teams to improve SEO strategies, optimize page speed, and ensure best practices for web performance and indexing.

  • Instrument features, analyze outcomes, and iterate based on data, working closely with designers, product managers, and editors to build user-centric products.

What You Have:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with hands-on expertise in React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and RESTful APIs.

  • Experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, content caching, and web performance optimization.

  • Hands-on experience with GCP, including services like Cloud Run, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

  • Strong experience with automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

  • Experience building with AI agents, LLM integrations, or agentic development patterns (e.g., tool use, RAG, multi-step workflows).

  • A data-driven mindset — comfortable with analytics tooling, A/B testing, and using metrics to inform engineering and product decisions.

  • Experience working with design systems and component libraries.

  • Expertise in secure coding practices, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps best practices.

  • Experience with large-scale content platforms or digital media.

  • Strong ability to work across teams, engage stakeholders, and contribute to product vision.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with React Native for mobile applications.

  • Familiarity with Sanity CMS or other headless CMS solutions.

  • Experience with Vercel, including deployment workflows, edge functions, and serverless architecture.

  • Understanding of Core Web Vitals and SEO best practices, including technical SEO auditing and optimization.

  • Experience integrating ad management systems, paywalls, or data analytics tools into content platforms.

Bullish US LLC & CoinDesk Inc. are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $180,000 - $230,000 + discretionary annual target bonus + performance incentives/benefits. Offered salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and commensurate experience.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

ACCOMMODATION

title: Quantum Cryptography Architect
description:
Starling is the UK's first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! Our vision is fast technology, fair service, and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time.

We are about giving customers a new way to spend, save and manage their money while taking better care of the planet, which has seen us become a multi-award-winning bank that now employs over 3,000 people across our offices in London, Cardiff, Dublin, Southampton, and Manchester. Our journey started in 2014, and since then we have surpassed 3.5 million accounts with 350,000 business customers. We are a fully licensed UK bank, but at heart, we are a tech-first company, enabling our platform to deliver brilliant products.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be; innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and take full ownership of everything around you: from building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid model

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

About Role & Team

The Security Architecture team at Starling is driving significant impact across the organisation, actively guiding and empowering teams across Security and the wider technology landscape. We are looking for a mid-to-senior level Information Security Architect to join our ranks.

While you will cover typical end-to-end security architecture across our modern tech stack, this role carries a strategic focus: Cryptography & Post-Quantum Readiness. As quantum computing capabilities evolve, we are looking to ramp up our Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) efforts. We are looking for a leader who will own the strategic design of our cloud-native and on-premise cryptography roadmaps, conduct cryptographic assessments, drive crypto-agility, and define our technical roadmap to keep Starling resilient against emerging future threats.

What you'll get to do

  • Lead our Post-Quantum Strategy: Take ownership of Starling’s Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) initiative over the coming years; designing our crypto-inventory, evaluating PQC algorithms, and designing architectures built for cryptographic agility.
  • Act as the Cryptography SME: Provide expert architecture and design guidance on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), key management, service mesh security, and transport layer protocols across our cloud environments.
  • Enterprise Architecture Delivery: Architect secure, scalable solutions across AWS and GCP, translating complex security requirements into simple, pragmatic design patterns for engineering teams.
  • Secure Architecture Governance: Lead and assist with secure design reviews and threat modeling initiatives, delivering actionable security guidance and continuous support to Engineering teams.
  • Proof of Concept Development: Our architects enjoy a hands-on approach. When suitable, we design and build PoC solutions for engineers to refine or draw inspiration from.
  • Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with software engineers, cloud architects, and security operations to review RFCs and ADRs, conduct threat models, and embed security seamlessly into the development lifecycle without adding friction.
  • Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor within our growing Security Architecture team, staying ahead of industry trends, threat vectors, and regulatory standards to elevate Starling's overall security posture.

Responsibilties

  • Architect end-to-end security solutions for cloud-native applications, microservices, and modern banking platforms.
  • Develop and lead our Post-Quantum Cryptography transition roadmap and crypto-inventory strategy.
  • Perform threat modeling and technical risk assessments on new and existing platform architectures.
  • Define, document, and promote enterprise cryptographic management standards (key lifecycle, hardware security, modern cipher suites).
  • Review architectural design documents, RFCs, and ADRs to ensure alignment with security guardrails and regulatory requirements.
  • Mentor engineering teams and provide guidance on cryptographic implementations, securely managing secrets, and data protection at rest/in transit.
  • Support the rest of the Security Architecture team with daily security architecture activities (e.g. adhoc security architecture advisory services).

Requirements

  • Security Architecture Experience: Proven track record in a Information Security Architect or Senior Security Engineering role designing secure, distributed systems within modern cloud environments (AWS/GCP).
  • Deep Cryptography Expertise: Comprehensive practical and theoretical knowledge of symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, PKI management, digital signatures, key management systems (KMS), and HSMs.
  • Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Knowledge: Strong understanding of quantum computing threats to modern encryption, NIST PQC standards, hybrid key exchange, and strategies for achieving crypto-agility.
  • Threat Modeling & System Design: Demonstrated ability to perform threat modeling on complex cloud-native applications, APIs, and microservices architectures (e.g. Kubernetes, ECS).
  • Pragmatic Problem Solver: A firm believer that security should enable engineering speed, with the ability to design security controls that minimise developer friction.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of distilling complex technical/cryptographic risks into clear guidance for both technical teams and senior leadership.

Desirable

  • Experience in Fintech, Banking, or highly regulated cloud environments (e.g. PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST guidelines).
  • Demonstrated background in a highly technical role (e.g. Security Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Penetration Testing).
  • Experience in infrastructure,application, and AI security (e.g. container security, secure code reviews, secure integration of generative AI/ML).
  • Practical experience leveraging and applying the SABSA (Sherwood Applied Business Security Architecture) framework to design business-driven, risk-aligned enterprise security architectures.
  • Recognised industry security certifications (e.g. SABSA, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, or specialised cryptography credentials).

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the below following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

  • Stage 1: ~20 minute phone call with our Security Architecture Lead
  • Stage 2: ~75 minute technical interview with the team
  • Stage 3: ~30 minute final interview with the Security Architecture Director and CISO

Benefits

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

  • 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
  • An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
  • Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
  • 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
  • Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
  • Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
  • Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
  • Generous family-friendly policies
  • Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
  • Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.
