When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

You will provide academic and people leadership for Social Work at Western Sydney University, taking the discipline forward while enhancing curriculum quality and maintaining excellence in research. The position combines a continuing academic appointment at Level E with a three-year appointment as Head of Discipline and a 30% leadership workload allocation.

You will guide a discipline distinguished by its social justice and human rights orientation, commitment to decolonising approaches and Indigenous perspectives, and deep engagement with the diverse communities of Greater Western Sydney. As an active member of the School Executive, you will help set the direction of the School of Social Sciences and contribute to its mission of impact in, of and with communities. You will strengthen the integration of research, professional practice and community partnerships, including community-led research undertaken through the Centre for Community Research Collaboration.

You will foster interdisciplinary collaboration, strengthen relationships with industry, government, professional bodies and community partners, and pursue competitive research support. You will also mentor academic colleagues, promote educational excellence and build an inclusive discipline culture grounded in diversity, anti-racism and community impact.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Provide clear academic and people leadership that strengthens the direction, culture and performance of the Social Work discipline.

  • Mentor early and mid-career academics and contribute actively to School governance and strategic direction.

title: Shift Coordinator
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

Our Processing and Logistics team are looking for a Shift Coordinator to join the team based at our Acacia Ridge Manufacturing facility. Orrcon Steel Distribution is a leading Australian supplier of steel and aluminium products, offering a comprehensive range engineered to meet the demands of diverse industries. Our products are backed by strong technical expertise, full traceability, and stringent quality standards. Supported by strategic supplier partnerships and a nationwide network of distribution centres, we ensure consistent availability, reliable performance, and dependable supply for customers across Australia.

Reporting to the Operations Coordinator, you will lead a team of 20 team members working with the manufacturing team to deliver exceptional outcomes for our QLD Customers. In this fast-paced site that handles over 500,000 tonnes of steel per year, you will have direct impact on the delivery performance of BlueScope Australian Steel Products.

What Will You Do?

The role will see you:

  • leading and supervising our operations area including product scheduling, machine operation and maintenance
  • supporting and assisting your team with daily operations
  • identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, performance and mitigate risk - striving for on time delivery for our customers
  • ensuring safety standards are continuously evolving, championing change when risks and opportunities are identified
  • growing and mentoring your team to develop their technical capability

More About You

You will be an engaging leader focused on developing your team to deliver creative solutions to complex problems. In addition, you will bring:

  • leadership and guidance ensuring your team follows manufacturing excellence targets
  • effective relationship management and influencing capability
  • a growth mindset of continuous learning and improvement for yourself and the team
  • strong leadership, problem-solving and change management skills
  • a strong customer focus and the ability to deal with ambiguity and change
  • a commitment to your own safety and wellbeing and care for others

What’s in it for you

  • enjoy a permanent full time position offering competitive salary package, option for 14% superannuation, participation in our company incentive program and annual salary review
  • on-going training, development and learning providing career pathways
  • access to numerous wellbeing initiatives including, on site Physiotherapist and masseuse an Employee Assistance Program
  • access to discounted gym fees through the ‘Fitness Passport’
  • free on-site parking

Why BlueScope​

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope supports you to build your expertise within a safe and positive team environment. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. Work alongside specialists and keep your skills and knowledge at the forefront of industry with our lifelong learning culture.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Build innovative products. Seek better, smarter ways to work, help develop sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do. ​

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and we encourage Women and First Nations people to apply. We’re passionate about driving sustainability outcomes that matter to our communities, including action on climate and our 2050 net zero goal.​ At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program.

It’s an exciting time in our history as, together, we work towards Our Purpose: “We create and inspire smart solutions in steel, to strengthen communities for the future.” ​

Come and discover us at www.bluescope.com/auscareers​

Join us, creating strength for the future.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Kia ora!

At Air New Zealand, we’re on a journey to reimagine and elevate our digital platforms. Cloud computing enables us to modernize and consolidate infrastructure, automate workflows, and drive next-gen innovation, all powered by a robust multi-cloud strategy across AWS and Azure.

We’re now looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong DevOps experience, or a software engineer ready to evolve into the platform engineering discipline to join our DevOps Chapter. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a background in building microservices and distributed systems who’s eager to shape the future of platforms and developer experience at Air New Zealand.

The Role You’ll Play

As a senior engineer, you will:

  • Design and implement scalable cloud infrastructure and platform services that empower product teams to build, deploy, and operate with speed and confidence.
  • Lead CI/CD platform development, owning the build, test, and deployment systems that underpin dozens of applications.
  • Champion automation and Infrastructure as Code, driving reliability, consistency, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, SREs, and security specialists to deliver secure, observable, and resilient platforms.
  • Mentor and support engineers growing their DevOps and platform capabilities — fostering a culture of learning and innovation.
  • Contribute to and influence platform strategy, tooling decisions, and technical direction across the organisation.
  • Support key platforms such as Kubernetes (EKS), ECS, API Gateway, and Kafka, helping ensure their scalability, reliability, and performance.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years’ experience in software or platform engineering, ideally with exposure to microservices architecture and cloud-native development.
  • A strong interest in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure, and a desire to deepen your expertise in this space.
  • Proven skills in CI/CD principles, DevSecOps practices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps toolsets (Pipelines, Repos) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS).
  • Hands-on experience with modern programming or scripting languages (Python, Java, Go, Bash, etc.)
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
  • AWS or Azure certification (preferred).
  • A collaborative and curious mindset — you thrive on solving complex problems and helping others succeed.
  • A solid understanding of cloud architecture, security, and automation best practices.

Ready for take-off?

This is your opportunity to help shape the platforms that power one of New Zealand's most recognised brands. You'll work with modern cloud technologies, solve meaningful engineering challenges, and be part of a collaborative team that values curiosity, continuous learning, and innovation. If you're excited by the opportunity to grow your platform engineering expertise while making a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

We want our people to live their best lives and access great benefits that support their lives outside work. As part of Air New Zealand, you'll enjoy benefits including generous staff travel, the opportunity to purchase up to four additional weeks of FlexiLeave each year, ongoing learning and development opportunities, and access to a wide range of employee discounts and wellbeing support.

Applications close 8th September 2026.

Tule osaksi palkittua työyhteisöä

N-Clean on menestynyt HUMAN POWER -kilpailussa useana vuonna, mikä kertoo pitkäjänteisestä työstämme ihmisläheisen ja vastuullisen työelämän kehittämiseksi. Vuonna 2024 meidät valittiin ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi, ja vuonna 2025 sijoituimme kilpailussa kolmannelle sijalle sekä saavutimme 3. sijan Suomen ihmisläheisin työelämäteko -kategoriassa. Tämä tunnustus kertoo ihmisläheisestä rekrytointitavastamme, jossa kohtaaminen, arvostus ja hakijakokemus ovat keskiössä.

Arvomme – luottamus, arvostus ja sitoutuminen – näkyvät arjessamme konkreettisina tekoina: pidämme lupauksemme, teemme työmme huolellisesti ja toimimme reilusti toisiamme kohtaan.

Meillä jokainen on vastuussa omasta työstään ja yhteisestä onnistumisesta, ja tuemme toisiamme myös kiireen keskellä.

🏨 Kerroshoitaja (hotelli- sekä muut majoituskohteet)

Kerroshoitajana vastaat huoneiden, huoneistojen, mökkien sekä iglujen siisteydestä ja viihtyvyydestä. Työlläsi vastaat korkeasta laadusta ja vaikutat suoraan asiakastyytyväisyyteen omalla huolellisella työnjäljelläsi.

Talvikauden työvuorot mukautuvat työskentelykohteiden mukaan ja vuorot ovat pääsääntöisesti aamuvuoroja, jotka päättyvät iltapäivällä sekä iltavuoroja muuramalle henkilölle. Vuoroja tehdään arkisin sekä viikonloppuisin.

Tehtävässä pääset tekemään näkyvää ja merkityksellistä työtä, jolla on suora vaikutus asiakkaiden arkeen, loman ja viihtyvyyteen, olet merkittävä osa kohteen onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta. Työpäiväsi etenee suunnitellun työlistan mukaisesti, ja vastaat omalta osaltasi työn sujuvuudesta, kuitenkin yhdessä tiimin kanssa onnistuen.

Työssä korostuvat oma-aloitteisuus, työn suunnittelu, tehokas työskentely sekä sovittujen aikataulujen noudattaminen. Laatu, turvallisuus ja ystävällinen asiakaskohtaaminen ovat tärkeä osa arkea. Työn huolellinen toteuttaminen laatu- ja turvallisuusohjeiden mukaisesti sekä asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja ystävällinen käytös ovat olennainen osa arkea. Nautit hektisestä työympäristöstä ja asiakaspalvelutyöstä sekä toimit sujuvasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat:

  • hotellihuoneiden, huoneistojen, mökkien sekä iglujen siivous eli liinavaatteiden vaihto ja upeiden petauksien tekeminen, saniteettitilojen siivous, erilaisten lattiapintojen puhdistus, tasojen pyyhintä sekä huonevarusteluiden täyttäminen

  • yleistentilojen, huoneistojen, mökkien sekä iglujen keittiöiden ja/tai kokoustilojen siivous

  • erilaiset lisätyöt esim. ikkunoidenpesu

  • mahdollisuutenasi on päästä myös auttamaan hotellin sydämeen eli keittiöön

🧹 Siivooja (toimitilakohteet)

Siivoojana huolehdit asiakkaidemme toimitilojen viihtyisyydestä ja puhtaudesta. Vastaat laadusta sekä asiakastyytyväisyydestä omalla työnjäljelläsi. Työskentelykohteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myymälä, toimisto, hoivakoti, koulu, kauppakeskus jne.

Työ voidaan toteuttaa kokonaisuudessaan yhdessä kohteessa tai sinulla voi olla useampi eri siivouskohde päivän aikana. Työ sijoittuu arki- ja viikonloppupäiviin, ja työvuorot vaihtelevat kohteiden mukaan – vuoroja voi olla varhaisaamuisin, aamulla, päivällä tai iltaisin. Osa kohteista sijaitsee eri puolilla Rovaniemeä, joten ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus ovat eduksi.

Tehtävässä pääset tekemään näkyvää ja merkityksellistä työtä, jolla on suora vaikutus asiakkaiden arkeen ja viihtyvyyteen. Työ on vaihtelevaa, itsenäistä ja vastuullista, mutta et ole yksin - saat työsuhteen alussa kattavan perehdytyksen sekä tarvittaessa tukea koko työsuhteen ajan. Työpäiväsi etenee ennalta suunnitellun työlistan mukaisesti, ja vastaat omalta osaltasi työn sujuvuudesta. Työssä korostuvat oman työn suunnittelu, oma-aloitteinen työote, tehokas työskentely sekä sovittujen aikataulujen noudattaminen. Työn huolellinen toteuttaminen laatu- ja turvallisuusohjeiden mukaisesti sekä asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja ystävällinen käytös ovat olennainen osa arkea. Nautit itsenäisestä työskentelystä, ongelmanratkaisusta ja vastuun ottamisesta.

Työtehtäviäsi voivat olla:

  • lattioiden imurointi, moppaus tai erilaisten siivouskoneiden käyttö

  • saniteetti- ja keittiö/taukotilojen puhtaanapito

  • tasojen ja muiden pintojen puhtaanapito

  • muut perussiivoustehtävät kuten esim. ikkunoidenpesu

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Määräaikaisen työsuhteen osa-aikaisin (10-30 tuntia/viikko) sopimustunnein loka-maaliskuun aikana

  • Vaihtelevat työajat aamu- sekä iltavuoroissa

  • Huolellisen perehdytyksen yrityksemme uudistetulla Onboarding polulla sekä N-Clean Academyssä. Emme edellytä aiempaa kokemusta alalta, vaikka se voikin vauhdittaa matkaasi

  • Mahdollisuuden jatkaa meillä myös sesongin jälkeen

  • Palkan kiinteistöpalvelualan TES:n mukaan 11,33–13,88 €/h riippuen työtehtävistäsi

  • Aidosti välittävän työyhteisön ja esihenkilöiden tuen

    Meillä sesonkityö on enemmän kuin vain työpaikka – se on mahdollisuus oppia uutta, saada arvokasta työkokemusta ja olla osa yhteisöä, jossa jokaisen panos tulee huomatuksi ja arvostetuksi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen asenne, ja suhtaudut työhön innokkaasti ja uteliaasti. Haluat oppia uutta ja teet työsi huolellisesti, laadukkaasti ja sovittuja aikatauluja noudattaen.

  • Toimit työssäsi oma-aloitteisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti, ja osaat tarttua eteen tuleviin tilanteisiin itsenäisesti. Fyysinen työ ja vaihtelevat työpäivät eivät sinua säikäytä, vaan viihdyt aktiivisessa tekemisessä.

  • Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja joustava, ja toimit arjessa arvojemme mukaisesti. Luotettavuus ja vastuullinen työote näkyvät tavassasi tehdä työtä.

  • Osaat toimia tiimin jäsenenä, mutta viihdyt myös itsenäisessä työssä omalla vastuualueellasi. Tehtävissä edellytetään suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taitoa.

  • Kielitaito, puhut joko suomea tai englantia

  • Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätön eteenkään hotellissa työskennellessä

  • Huomioithan, että jos et ole Suomen kansalainen, sinulla tulee olla voimassa oleva työlupa Suomessa työskentelyä varten.

Meille tärkeintä on oikea asenne ja halu tehdä työ laadukkaasti sekä ajallaan arvojemme mukaisesti. Opimme yhdessä ja tuemme toisiamme, jotta jokainen voi onnistua omassa roolissaan. Viihdyt fyysisessä työssä ja otat vastuuta omasta työstäsi, hoidat tehtäväsi laadukkaasti ja ajallaan. Nautit itsenäisestä työotteesta ja oman vastuualueen hallinnasta.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Työyhteisössämme työskentelee ihmisiä yli 100 eri kansallisuudesta. Edistämme yhdenvertaisuutta ja haluamme, että jokainen voi kokea olevansa arvostettu ja tervetullut. Eri taustat, elämäntilanteet ja osaaminen ovat meille vahvuus.

Hae nyt!

Aiempi työkokemus tai kokemus alalta ei ole välttämätöntä, perehdytämme jokaisen uuden työntekijän.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi mahdollisimman selkeästi, milloin voit työskennellä sekä hieman itsestäsi – esimerkiksi aiemmista kesätöistä-/työkokemuksestasi, koulutuksestasi tai harrastuksistasi. Mikäli etenet prosessissamme ja aloitat meillä sesonkityöt, näiden tietojen avulla pystymme tunnistamaan vahvuutesi ja löytämään sinulle parhaiten sopivaan työkohteen ja tiimiin.

We Are Looking for Housekeepers for the Rovaniemi Winter Season 2026-2027!

We are looking for enthusiastic seasonal employees for a variety of accommodation and commercial properties in Rovaniemi! How does working in an international environment as part of an energetic and supportive team sound to you? Join an Award-Winning Workplace N-Clean has been recognized in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-centered and responsible working life. In 2024, we were selected as Finland’s most people-centered workplace, and in 2025, we achieved third place in the competition as well as third place in the Most People-Centered Working Life Act category. This recognition reflects our people-focused recruitment approach, where respect, meaningful interactions, and a positive candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

Our values – trust, respect, and commitment – are visible in our daily work through concrete actions: we keep our promises, work carefully and professionally, and treat each other fairly. At N-Clean, everyone is responsible for their own work and for our shared success, and we support one another even during busy periods.

🏨 Housekeeper (Hotels and Other Accommodation Properties)

As a Housekeeper, you will be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and comfort of hotel rooms, apartments, cabins, and igloos. Through your work, you will ensure a high-quality guest experience and directly contribute to customer satisfaction with your attention to detail.

During the winter season, working hours vary depending on the property. Shifts are primarily morning shifts ending in the afternoon, with some evening shifts available for a limited number of employees. Work is scheduled on both weekdays and weekends. In this role, you will perform meaningful and visible work that directly impacts guests’ everyday comfort, holiday experiences, and overall satisfaction. You play an important role in creating a successful customer experience.

Your workday follows a planned task list, and while you are responsible for your own tasks, success is achieved together with the team.

The role highlights initiative, planning, efficiency, and adherence to agreed schedules. Quality, safety, and friendly customer service are an important part of everyday work. Completing tasks carefully in accordance with quality and safety guidelines, along with maintaining a positive service attitude, is essential. You enjoy a fast-paced work environment, customer service, and adapting smoothly to changing situations.

Your tasks include:

  • Cleaning hotel rooms, apartments, cabins, and igloos, including changing bed linens, making beautiful beds, cleaning sanitary facilities, cleaning various floor surfaces, wiping surfaces, and replenishing room amenities

  • Cleaning public areas, apartments, cabins, and the kitchens and/or meeting facilities of igloos

  • Additional cleaning tasks such as window cleaning

  • Opportunity to assist in the heart of the hotel operations, the kitchen

🧹 Cleaner (Commercial Properties)

As a Cleaner, you will ensure the cleanliness and comfort of our customers’ facilities. Through your work, you are responsible for maintaining quality and customer satisfaction. Your workplaces may include stores, offices, care homes, schools, shopping centres, and similar facilities.

Your work may be carried out entirely at one location, or you may work at several different sites during the day. Work is available on weekdays and weekends, and shifts vary depending on the location, including early mornings, mornings, daytime, and evening shifts. Some locations are situated in different parts of Rovaniemi, so a driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage.

This role offers meaningful and visible work that has a direct impact on customers’ everyday comfort and satisfaction. The work is varied, independent, and responsible, but you will never be left on your own. You will receive comprehensive onboarding at the beginning of your employment and support whenever needed throughout your employment. Your workday follows a planned work schedule, and you are responsible for ensuring your tasks are completed efficiently. The role emphasizes planning your own work, taking initiative, working efficiently, and meeting agreed schedules. Performing tasks carefully according to quality and safety standards, together with a friendly customer service attitude, is an essential part of everyday work. You enjoy independent work, problem-solving, and taking responsibility.

Your tasks may include:

  • Vacuuming, mopping, and using various cleaning machines

  • Cleaning and maintaining sanitary facilities, kitchen areas, and break rooms

  • Cleaning desks, counters, and other surfaces

  • Other basic cleaning tasks, such as window cleaning

What We Offer You

  • A fixed-term part-time employment contract (10-30 hours per week) between October and March

  • Varied working hours including morning and evening shifts

  • Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy. Previous experience in the industry is not required, although it may help you get started more quickly

  • An opportunity to continue working with us after the season ends

  • Salary according to the Collective Agreement for the Property Services Sector, €11.33-13.88/hour depending on your duties

  • A genuinely caring work community and support from supervisors

    For us, seasonal work is more than just a job. It is an opportunity to learn new skills, gain valuable work experience, and be part of a community where every contribution is noticed and appreciated.


What We Expect from You

  • You have a positive attitude and approach work with enthusiasm and curiosity. You are willing to learn, perform your work carefully and with quality, and follow agreed schedules.

  • You work proactively and with a solution-oriented mindset, and you are able to handle situations independently. Physical work and varied workdays do not intimidate you. Instead, you enjoy active, hands-on work.

  • You have a customer service mindset, are flexible, and act according to our values in everyday work. Reliability and a responsible way of working are reflected in how you carry out your duties.

  • You work well as part of a team but are also comfortable working independently in your own area of responsibility. The role requires Finnish and/or English language skills.

  • Language skills: you speak either Finnish or English.

  • A driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage, but are not essential, especially for hotel positions.

  • Please note that if you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit allowing you to work in Finland.

For us, the most important qualities are the right attitude and a genuine willingness to perform work carefully, on time, and in line with our values. We learn together and support one another so that everyone can succeed in their role. You enjoy physical work, take responsibility for your own tasks, complete your duties with quality and on schedule, and appreciate working independently while managing your own responsibilities. Diversity and Equality

Our work community includes employees from more than 100 different nationalities. We promote equality and want everyone to feel valued and welcome. Different backgrounds, life situations, and competencies are strengths for us.

Apply Now!

➡️ Submit your application through our website no later than 13 September 2026.

Your application and CV are an important part of our recruitment process, and a carefully completed application will help you progress further. Competition for seasonal jobs is strong. Last year, we received more than 12,500 applications for all our seasonal positions. Previous experience or industry-specific experience is not necessary, as we provide comprehensive training for every new employee.

Please tell us as clearly as possible in your application when you are available to work and a little about yourself, such as your previous summer jobs or work experience, education, or hobbies. If you advance in our recruitment process and begin working with us, this information helps us identify your strengths and find the most suitable workplace and team for you.

We contact all applicants throughout the recruitment process, and our goal is to respond within two weeks of receiving your application. You will receive updates on the progress of the process directly by email. Applicants who advance to the interview stage will be invited to our unique recruitment event, which received recognition as the third most people-centered working life act in Finland at the end of 2025 in the HumanPower Gala organized by Hälsa and the Finland Chamber of Commerce. Invitations are sent by email, so please remember to check both your inbox and spam folder.

Participation must be confirmed separately, and places are limited. We recruit our seasonal employees exclusively through this event, so please reserve the dates for yourself.

title: Electrical Reliability Engineer
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

Orrcon Manufacturing is looking for an Electrical Reliability Engineer to join the Engineering Team in Salisbury. Orrcon Manufacturing is a manufacturer of steel tube and pipe and leading Australian steel distributor with nationally recognised brands.

In this business-critical role, you will provide hands-on electrical reliability services to our production teams who operate within a continuous manufacturing environment. Your contribution will enable improved machine safety, uptime and performance so we can continue to make and deliver world-class product to our valued customers.

This opportunity includes a competitive remuneration package including our profit share plan (bonus incentive scheme). When you join our team, we offer flexibility for work/life balance, access to our Employee Assistant Provider, annual flu vaccinations, on-site car parking, on-site physio and training and development.

What Will You Do?

Working in a supportive environment, you will contribute to the safety of our people, the quality of our product and the reliability of our equipment. You will achieve this by:

  • reviewing equipment performance, availability and breakdowns to identify reliability improvement plans
  • developing and updating maintenance lifecycle plans for all critical equipment
  • champion automation, control system optimisation and functional safety initiatives to improve equipment reliability, machine safety and operational performance
  • continually seeking opportunities to improve our maintenance strategies through various projects
  • investigating electrical Safety Health & Environmental incidents, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions
  • assisting in troubleshooting day-to-day problems and recommending simple and robust solutions

More About You

Being a qualified Electrical Reliability Engineer, you will bring:

  • a tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor or Diploma) or trade background with relevant industry experience
  • relevant experience in equipment reliability focused on life-cycle maintenance
  • PLC knowledge (e.g. Siemens S7, TIA, WinCC Flex) and fault-finding skills is highly regarded
  • experience in AC, DC, servo motors and drives (e.g. Siemens, SEW) is highly regarded.
  • proficiency in automation and control systems is highly regarded

Why BlueScope​

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope supports you to build your expertise within a safe and positive team environment. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. Work alongside specialists and keep your skills and knowledge at the forefront of industry with our lifelong learning culture.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Build innovative products. Seek better, smarter ways to work, help develop sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do. ​

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and we encourage Women and First Nations people to apply. We’re passionate about driving sustainability outcomes that matter to our communities, including action on climate and our 2050 net zero goal.​ At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program.

It’s an exciting time in our history as, together, we work towards Our Purpose: “We create and inspire smart solutions in steel, to strengthen communities for the future.” ​

Come and discover us at www.bluescope.com/auscareers​

Join us, creating strength for the future.

We believe having a culture that is accepting, supportive, diverse, and inclusive makes us all better. Provident has been a Bay Area “Top Workplace” since 2017, and our employees rank us on Glassdoor as one of the best credit unions in the nation.

  • Prepares personal sales/production reports on a weekly basis to the management team
  • Review in-branch reports for the purpose of increasing activities to meet/exceed individual contributor goals for sales, service and revenue objectives
  • Ensure branch is recognized in local market area through hands-on promotion, e.g. community event volunteer, school volunteer, etc
  • Conduct internal/external business development activities with current and potential employer groups

title: System Administrator I
description:
The BVI Financial Services Commission (“the Commission”) is seeking a highly motivated professional to join its Information Technology Unit (“IT”) in the role of System Administrator I. The successful candidate will support the Unit in maintaining the efficiency and security of the Commission’s systems, applications, and infrastructure services. Applicants should be independently motivated and able to work within a diverse team. Candidates must adhere to the Commission’s service standards and confidentiality requirements, demonstrate the ability to follow established procedures, and effectively manage competing priorities with strong attention to detail.


The role involves performing routine system administration tasks, including system monitoring, backups, application support, and assisting with infrastructure services. The incumbent is expected to maintain accurate documentation and escalate more complex issues as needed to ensure reliable IT operations.


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Perform daily system monitoring of servers, storage, backups, event logs, and core infrastructure alerts, and report abnormalities promptly.
  • Administer routine Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and related service tasks, including account maintenance, permissions, group membership, patching support and basic configuration changes.
  • Assist with server builds, rebuilds, upgrades, software deployment, backup verification, restore testing and routine maintenance in accordance with approved standards.
  • Provide second-tier support for issues escalated from End User Support Technicians and coordinate with more senior team members when further escalation is .
  • Support enterprise services such as Exchange or Microsoft 365 messaging, IIS or web services, file services, printing, antivirus, monitoring tools and endpoint management solutions as assigned.
  • Assist with operational support for telecommunications, IP telephony, network-connected infrastructure and electronic physical security systems under guidance from senior staff.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, change logs, configuration records, inventory details and operating procedures.
  • Participate in disaster recovery, backup validation, vulnerability remediation and after-hours support rotations as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum qualification for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Approximately 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, advanced desktop support or a closely related IT operations role.


Knowledge and Experience Required:

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 administration, backup concepts and endpoint support.
  • Foundational understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, switching, VLANs and VPN connectivity.
  • Ability to follow change control, security standards, escalation procedures and written technical instructions with consistency.
  • Good written and oral communication skills, sound judgement, and the ability to manage multiple routine tasks and deadlines.


Competencies:

  • Professionalism – complies with Commission’s code of conduct, acts with integrity and shows respect;
  • Adaptability – adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced environment;
  • Confidentiality – understanding and commitment to maintaining confidentiality of sensitive information. Ensures the protection and confidentiality of information pertaining to the Commission’s affairs, refraining from disclosure to unauthorised individuals;
  • Initiative – willingness to take on additional responsibilities and display a proactive approach to work;
  • Quality of Work – consistently generates work that is comprehensive, accurate, pertinent, timely, and aligns with the Commission’s policies;
  • Communication – effectively, professionally and thoroughly communicates, both verbally and in writing;
  • Time Management - effectively plans, coordinates, and identifies optimal methods to schedule, prioritize, and complete assignments within specified deadlines;
  • Customer Excellence – builds positive relationships with internal and external customers and ability to handle inquiries and resolve issues with a customer-focused approach.

title: Founding Data Lead
description:
About the role

The owner of Pocket’s data foundation and decision-making systems end to end. You make our data reliable, accessible, and actionable across product, growth, marketing, sales, finance, and operations.

Pocket has already reached hundreds of thousands of customers and is scaling toward millions. Our data spans customer acquisition, e-commerce, hardware, app usage, subscriptions, customer support, and international markets. Your job is to connect these sources into a trusted system that helps us understand our customers and consistently make better decisions.

You will build the core data infrastructure, define how Pocket measures the customer journey, and work directly with teams to turn analysis into clear recommendations. You should be equally comfortable writing SQL, designing data models, investigating customer behavior, and explaining to founders what the company should do next.

This is a hands-on, founder-facing role for someone who wants to build Pocket’s data function from the ground up—not simply maintain dashboards or respond to reporting requests.

What you'll own

  • Pocket’s data strategy, architecture, and analytics foundation
  • A reliable single source of truth across Shopify, Amazon, advertising platforms, the Pocket app, device usage, subscriptions, customer support, and finance
  • Data pipelines, warehouse architecture, transformation models, documentation, monitoring, and data quality
  • Product instrumentation, event taxonomy, identity resolution, and customer lifecycle tracking
  • Definitions and governance for company-wide metrics and KPIs
  • Analysis of the complete customer journey: acquisition, purchase, activation, engagement, subscription conversion, retention, churn, and referral
  • Customer cohort analysis, behavioral segmentation, and identification of Pocket’s highest-value users
  • CAC, LTV, payback period, contribution margin, attribution, incrementality, and marketing efficiency analysis
  • Product adoption, feature usage, retention, and experimentation measurement
  • Executive dashboards and recurring reporting for founders and functional leaders
  • Proactive analysis and recommendations—not just reporting what happened, but explaining why it happened and what Pocket should do next
  • Self-serve analytics that enables teams to answer common questions without compromising data quality
  • The long-term development of Pocket’s data function, including selecting tools and helping build the future data team

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of experience across data analytics, analytics engineering, data science, data engineering, or a similarly quantitative role
  • Experience working in a high-growth startup or technology company
  • Experience analyzing customer cohorts at the scale of hundreds of thousands of users, ideally while the company was growing toward millions
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong working knowledge of Python
  • Hands-on experience with modern data warehouses, transformation tools such as dbt, BI platforms, and product analytics tools
  • Experience building reliable data pipelines and models—not only analyzing existing datasets
  • Strong understanding of cohort analysis, retention, funnels, segmentation, experimentation, CAC, LTV, and attribution
  • Experience supporting product, growth, marketing, sales, finance, and executive decision-making
  • An obsession with data accuracy, consistency, documentation, and reliability
  • The ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations
  • Strong product and commercial judgment—you understand that the purpose of data is to improve decisions and outcomes
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • High ownership, low ego, intellectual honesty, and the ability to execute without constant direction
  • Consumer technology, DTC, e-commerce, subscription, mobile app, or hardware experience is a strong plus
  • Experience building a data function or operating as an early data hire is a strong plus

What we offer

  • The opportunity to build Pocket’s data function from the ground up
  • Ownership of data across a rapidly scaling consumer hardware and software company
  • Direct access to founders and significant influence on company and product strategy
  • High autonomy and the ability to turn your insights directly into action
  • Complex customer, product, subscription, marketing, and commercial datasets at meaningful scale
  • The opportunity to build the systems Pocket will use as it grows from hundreds of thousands to millions of customers
  • Base salary of $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience
  • Meaningful equity through Pocket’s employee stock option plan

About the interview

  1. Quick intro call (15 min) — experience, motivation, compensation expectations, and location fit
  2. Data case study based on a realistic Pocket business problem
  3. Technical interview covering data architecture, SQL, analytics, and data reliability
  4. Cross-functional interview with Product, Growth, or Engineering
  5. Interview with the founders
  6. Reference check
  7. Offer
  8. Onboarding

About Pocket

Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.

title: Senior Director - Business Execution
description:
This role is the lead execution and strategic engine of the customer experience transformation initiatives across Freshworks' Global Customer Services (GCS) organization. This role partners directly with the VP of GCS to build and execute a world-class vision for customer experience transformation. Following GCS's recent consolidation under a unified ‘From Go-Live to Growth’ mission, the role designs and operates the operating rhythm, governance frameworks, and strategic planning processes for a ~500-person global team spanning Professional Services, Support, Customer Success, Education, Adoption, and Voice of the Customer.

This is a high-leverage role for an inspirational leader who serves as a scale function for the global leader, bridging the services organization with Product and Engineering to align in-product improvements with operational efficiency, while championing Customer Success strategies that secure lasting adoption. The role does not manage a functional silo directly, but holds delegated authority to drive execution across the GCS leadership team, eliminate executive bottlenecks, and represent the VP in cross-functional forums with Sales, Finance, HR, and Product.

What This Role Owns

  • Cross-Functional Transformation Programs: Drives end-to-end execution on high-priority initiatives that bridge support and services with product efficiency and customer success strategy. Partners with functional leads and stakeholders (Finance, HR, Product, Sales) to clear roadblocks and accelerate milestones.
  • Strategic Planning & Product-Services Alignment: Owns the process for setting GCS's priorities and goals across all functions. Synthesizes leadership input into one cohesive roadmap linking post-sales success with in-product improvements and adoption tracks.
  • Executive Communications & Voice of GCS Transformation Progress: Supports and frequently authors high-impact communications, including ELT materials and team wide messaging.
  • Organizational Single Source of Truth: Maintains a live portfolio view of every active GCS transformation initiative with clear owners and velocity.

Role Goals

  • Executive Leverage & Scale: Scales the VP's organizational reach as a trusted proxy in cross-functional forums, accelerating decisions and removing bottlenecks.
  • Transformation Velocity: Drives timely execution of critical cross-functional initiatives.
  • Operational Discipline & Governance: Runs operating rhythm and follow ups to ensure execution is on track.
  • 12+ years of experience in customer experience, SaaS operations, strategic planning, or transformation execution roles, ideally with exposure to Customer Success, Support, or Professional Services organizations.
  • Customer experience domain knowledge - operating model fluency across Professional Services, Support, CS, Education, Adoption, and VoC, including how in-product changes affect the end-to-end customer experience
  • Strategic planning & program execution - synthesizing functional priorities into one roadmap and running the governance/milestone tracking to actually deliver it
  • Vision communication - articulating and evangelizing the CX transformation vision to both customers and internal stakeholders
  • Executive communication & judgment - ELT-level narrative writing, plus knowing when to decide vs. escalate as the VP's proxy
  • Cross-functional influence without authority - driving execution through Finance, HR, Product, and Sales peers who don't report to you
  • SaaS/business acumen - fluency in NRR, ARR, retention, and gross margin, and how services economics tie to them

The annual base salary range for this position is $245,140 — $302,820 USD.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available.

Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability and life insurances. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

CFA, FRM, CFA Institute Sustainable Investing Certificate or other relevant professional qualifications are advantageous.

title: Compliance Director
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Compliance Director to own group compliance across every

regulated entity we operate - setting the framework, holding the regulatory

relationships, and making sure not a single obligation or deadline is missed

anywhere in the group.

You will oversee the MLROs and local compliance leads in each licensed entity,

functionally rather than by title alone: you set the standard they work to, you

review what they produce, and you are accountable to the CEO for the group's

overall compliance posture.

This is a senior role for someone who has already been the accountable person -

a Head of Compliance or MLRO at a regulated payments business - and knows exactly

what a regulator expects to see when they ask.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Group compliance framework

- Own the group-wide AML/CFT, sanctions and regulatory compliance framework, and

translate it into what each entity must do locally.

- Set the standard, the minimum controls and the reporting cadence that every

regulated entity works to.

- Design and maintain the compliance and risk structure itself - how the

function is organised across entities, where accountability sits, what

escalates and to whom.

- Advise the CEO and the business on compliance and risk structure decisions:

new products, new markets, new partners, changes to the licensing footprint.

Oversight of MLROs and local compliance

- Provide functional oversight of the MLRO and compliance lead in each regulated

entity.

- Review and challenge their risk assessments, alert handling, SAR/STR

decisions, and regulatory filings before they go out.

- Run a regular oversight cadence - reporting lines, escalation paths, group

compliance committee, and a consolidated view of risk across entities.

- Coach and develop the local compliance leads. Where an entity is

under-resourced or a control is weak, you say so early and fix it.

Regulatory obligations and deadlines - non-negotiable

- Own a complete, live inventory of every regulatory obligation across every

entity and jurisdiction: what is due, to whom, when, and who prepares it.

- Own on-time, accurate delivery of all periodic regulatory reporting and

submissions across the group.

- Own incident, breach and material-change notifications to regulators, filed

within the required window.

- NO MISSED REGULATORY DEADLINES. This is the hard line of the role. You build

the tracking, the buffers and the escalation that make missing one

structurally difficult.

Regulatory relationships

- Be the group's primary point of contact for regulators.

- Handle regulator queries, information requests, thematic reviews and

inspections directly - draft the responses, manage the timeline, close them

out.

- Track regulatory change across all our jurisdictions and translate it into

concrete action before it becomes a compliance gap.

- Prepare the CEO and the board for regulatory engagement, and represent the

company credibly on your own.

Policy

- Own the full compliance policy suite - AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/KYB and CDD,

transaction monitoring, merchant acceptance and prohibited activity,

complaints, outsourcing, safeguarding-adjacent controls.

- Keep policies current against regulatory change, and make sure changes

actually land in operational procedure and system configuration, not just in

the document.

- Run the annual review and approval cycle, with a clear audit trail of what

changed, why and when.

Audit and assurance

- Own the independent AML/CFT audit and any other compliance audits or external

reviews - scope, timeline, evidence, and the auditor relationship.

- Manage external auditors, consultants and assurance providers across entities.

- Own remediation of audit and regulator findings end to end. Findings get

closed with evidence, on the committed date.

- Maintain the control testing and evidence trail that makes the framework

defensible under examination.

Guidance to the business

- Be the person the CEO, Sales, Risk and Product come to before they do

something, not after.

- Give clear, commercially aware answers - what we can do, what we can't, and

what conditions make a "no" into a "yes".

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

- Prior experience as Head of Compliance, MLRO, or Compliance Officer of record

at a regulated payments, e-money or financial institution. This is not a first

accountable-person role.

- Deep working knowledge of AML/CFT and payments regulation, with real depth in

at least one major regime and demonstrated ability to get up to speed on

others.

- Track record of owning a regulatory reporting calendar across multiple

obligations without misses.

- Direct experience handling regulator engagement - queries, inspections,

thematic reviews - as the named contact.

- Experience managing external auditors and closing out audit and regulator

findings.

- Experience overseeing or managing compliance staff, ideally across more than

one entity or jurisdiction.

- Has personally written and defended compliance policy, not just inherited it.

- Hands-on and detailed. You read the alerts, the filings and the audit evidence

yourself.

- Based in Singapore with existing right to work.

Strongly preferred

- Experience across more than one of: MAS (Payment Services Act), BNM, BSP,

AUSTRAC, HKMA/CSP, US state MTL or FinCEN MSB.

- Experience in a group structure where local entities operate under different

licences or through acquirer/partner arrangements.

- Fitness-and-propriety approval history with a regulator, or clear ability to

obtain it.

- ICA, CAMS, or equivalent professional certification.

- Merchant-acquiring or marketplace payments background - merchant onboarding

risk, prohibited MCCs, transaction monitoring at merchant level.

- Comfortable with data. You can interrogate monitoring output and merchant

portfolios yourself rather than waiting for a report.

How you work

- Deadlines are absolute. You build in buffer and escalate early rather than

explaining a miss afterwards.

- You bring a position, not just a risk. "No" comes with a route to "yes"

wherever one legitimately exists.

- You are direct with the CEO and with regulators, and you don't soften a real

problem.

- You are comfortable building the function while running it.

WHY THIS ROLE

You'll own group compliance for a licensed payments business operating across

multiple regulated markets, reporting directly to the CEO with a seat in the

decisions that shape the licensing footprint and product roadmap. The scope -

multiple regimes, multiple entities, direct regulator ownership - is broader

than an equivalent title at a single-market institution.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
hackajob is collaborating with Redgate Software to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

At a Glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: Flexible hybrid, once in the office every two weeks

Employment type: Permanent

Salary: £60,000 to £75,000, subject to experience

Why This Role Exists

Redgate's product teams move fast, across a growing set of AI and cloud-native technologies, and security can't just be a gate at the end of that process. This role exists to embed security expertise directly into how our engineering teams build and ship software: setting the standards, running the threat modelling, and making the judgement calls that keep pace with delivery instead of slowing it down.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match. AI handles the heavy lifting, our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why Join Our Product Security Team

● You'll shape how security works across multiple product teams, rather than enforcing policy from the sidelines.

● There's real scope to specialise in emerging areas like AI security, work most security roles don't get exposure to yet.

● We value pragmatic, real risk reduction over checkbox compliance, so the judgement you bring carries genuine weight.

About the Role

This role sits within our Product Security function, embedded across multiple product and engineering teams rather than a single one. You'll define and operationalise security requirements throughout the SDLC, from initial design through to release, with real authority to make independent security calls rather than deferring to what a scanner tells you. It's a role built on trust: teams will come to you for guidance, and the judgement you bring to triage, threat modelling, and governance decisions will shape how security actually gets done here.

● Partner directly with engineering and product teams to define and operationalise security requirements across the full SDLC

● Own or co-own application security governance: secure-by-default standards, patterns, guardrails, and risk exceptions

● Lead threat modelling for new features and architectural changes, turning findings into practical engineering work

● Drive SAST/DAST adoption and quality, from tool tuning to severity calibration and developer-facing triage guidance

● Support product teams adopting AI, including LLMs, SLMs, and MCP, giving you visibility into work most security roles wouldn't touch

What Makes You a Great Fit

● Hands-on product or application security experience, embedding security practices across a modern software development lifecycle

● Ability to review code and communicate security issues clearly to developers, primarily within a C# ecosystem, with exposure to Java or Python

● Strong knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and practical mitigation patterns

● Experience implementing or improving SAST/DAST processes: tool tuning, triage workflows, and reducing signal to noise

● Working understanding of cloud and container security fundamentals, ideally with AWS and Docker

What We Offer

Salary range: £60,000 to £75,000, subject to experience

● Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office

● Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

● Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

● Private health insurance

Link to full benefits page here

What Happens Next?

● Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications, and every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

● You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

● Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Belonging at Redgate page here.

title: Clinical Lead  - Crisis Stabilisation Centre
description:
Who are we?

Sonder is a leading not-for-profit human services organisation committed to creating communities where no one is left to navigate life’s hardest moments alone. We work alongside thousands of people each year, bringing together mental health, alcohol and other drug, community and practical supports to deliver connected, person-directed care that helps people live the lives they choose.

About CSC:

The Crisis Stabilisation Centre (CSC) is a first‑of‑its‑kind service in South Australia and a rare opportunity to help establish an entirely new model of crisis care from the ground up. This 16‑bed, 24/7 service provides a voluntary, short‑stay (up to 72 hours) alternative to Emergency Departments, offering a safe, therapeutic, home‑like environment for people experiencing mental health crisis and/or suicidal distress. Co‑located within the Lyell McEwin Hospital precinct alongside Sonder’s Medicare Mental Health Centre, the CSC is designed for seamless integration across hospital, urgent and community services. Guided by a co‑designed Peer First, Peer Last Philosophy of Care, and grounded in zero suicide principles, trauma‑informed practice and cultural safety, this new service represents a once‑in‑a‑career opportunity to help shape culture, practice, and care at the very beginning.

What benefits can we offer?

When you work with Sonder, you become part of the Sonder family and that provides you with a number of benefits such as:

  • Salary (excluding super) paid above award and reviewed annually

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Professional development allowance provided yearly

  • Generous salary packaging options - increase your take home pay by 6-12%

  • 17.5% Leave Loading

  • Modern and welcoming office spaces

  • Christmas Closure Bonus Leave (above annual leave entitlements)

  • Training opportunities

  • Meal & entertainment allowances

  • Paid parental leave, and much more!

Sonder are open to negotiating further benefits with the successful applicant to ensure an excellent working environment for you.

Salary Band: $124,745.40 - $129,958.40 + Super

Hours: 0.8 - 1 FTE

Contract: Fixed term until 23 July 2027

Location: Kaurna Country, Northern Crisis Stabilisation Centre

More Information & Position Description via this link:

Immunisations: Employment is subject to compliance with Sonder’s Immunisation Policy. Applicants must hold, or be willing to obtain, all vaccinations and immunisations required for the role.

About the Role: As the Clinical Lead at the Crisis Stabilisation Centre (CSC), you will play a pivotal role in establishing and leading a contemporary, trauma-informed mental health service that delivers exceptional outcomes for guests experiencing crisis.

You will provide clinical leadership, professional guidance, and supervision to a multidisciplinary team of mental health clinicians, while driving excellence in evidence-based care, clinical governance, and service development. This is a unique opportunity to influence the design and culture of a new service, building a cohesive, integrated model of care that puts people, recovery, and lived experience at its center.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples are strongly encouraged to apply. We are committed to an inclusive and culturally safe workplace.

Experience Requirements:

  • Demonstrated experience in fast-paced mental health or acute care environments.

  • Minimum five years’ clinical experience in mental health treatment and care, preferably therapeutic interventions and/or case management.

  • Senior clinical experience in mental health service delivery.

  • Proven ability to lead and coordinate teams and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

  • Demonstrated experience preparing reports and recommendations.

  • Experience delivering Commonwealth and State-funded mental health programs in line with funding and contractual requirements.

  • Experience coordinating mental health services, including psychosocial assessment, therapeutic interventions, care coordination and discharge planning.

  • Experience as, or working alongside, an Authorised Officer (AO) under the SA Mental Health Act is highly desirable.

Qualification and Other Requirements:

  • Current or willing to obtain a Working with Children's Check (WWCC)

  • Current or willing to obtain a National Police Check (NPC)

  • Current registration with one of the following professional bodies:

  • Social Workers – Registered member of the Australian Association of Social Workers (AASW) with AASW Mental Health Accreditation

  • Psychologists – Registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)

  • Occupational Therapists – Registered with AHPRA and the Australian Association of Occupational Therapists, with Mental Health Endorsement recognised by Occupational Therapy Australia

How to apply:

Applicants are requested to send a cover letter and resume to Sonder via our careers portal on our website.

Feel free to send any enquiries to sondercareers@sonder.net.au

Advert Closing Date: 1 September 2026

Job Description

Performs nursing process while providing direct patient care in a safe and effective manner that promotes quality patient outcomes. Functions as member of interdisciplinary healthcare team.

Experience

  • 12 months RN experience required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing
  • 1 year of experience

Education

Certification Summary

  • No minimally required knowledge, skills, or abilities

Practice (Caring for the Patient)

  • Performs nursing process across the continuum to deliver age and developmentally appropriate patient-family-centered care.

  • Utilizes clinical decision support tools and resources to recognize issues, prioritize care, and modify plan of care as needed.

  • Utilizes resources to plan and provide nursing care that is safe, effective, and financially responsible.

Development (Fostering Clinical Knowledge)

title: Senior VLSI CAD Engineer
description:
Senior VLSI CAD Engineer

We are looking for an experienced Senior CAD Engineer to drive design environment management and automation for Product and TEG chip development. This role is pivotal in developing and maintaining CAD workflows, creating automation scripts, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve design efficiency.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design Automation:
    • Develop and maintain Virtuoso and Customer Compiler interfaces and utilities using the SKILL/Python languages.
    • Develop, optimize and enhance the CAD automation scripts.
  • PCell Support:
    • Create and maintain Parameterized Cells (PCell) to boost schematic/layout productivity.
  • Design Rule & Verification Support:
    • Develop and maintain Design Rule Checking (DRC) runsets using Calibre.
    • Develop and maintain Layout vs. Schematic (LVS) runsets using ICV.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration & Troubleshooting:
    • Work closely with IT teams and design engineers to manage layout data and resolve system issues.
    • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for the CAD infrastructure.
  • Communication:
    • Communicate effectively with EDA vendors to leverage advanced methodologies and tools that benefit the project.
    • Work closely with the design/layout teams to achieve project goals and meet schedules while fostering a collaborative environment.

REQUIRED:

  • Experience: M.S. with 2 - 5 years or PhD degree in CAD development for semiconductor design is required. Experience in team management is highly advantageous.
  • Programming & Scripting: Proficiency in SKILL, TCL/TK, Perl, Python, C/C++ and C-Shell scripting.
  • EDA Tools: Familiarity with Virtuoso, Customer Compiler, Calibre, ICV, strRC, P&R, ERC, EM/IR, PrimeSIM or the other Simulation tools, etc.

SKILLS:

  • Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities and proven experience working in a cross-functional, collaborative environment.

title: Reliability Engineer II
description:
At GAF, we cover more than just buildings. We cover each other. Under this roof, you will have the tools and resources you need to grow and develop in your career. You will experience our incredible culture and will be empowered to support your teammates, your customers, and especially your community. Under this roof, we define the future while leading the present through our deep well of experience and our responsibility to the future to drive improvements and innovation in our products. We are GAF. And under this roof, we protect what matters most.


Job Summary
The Reliability Engineer II position builds upon foundational reliability engineering responsibilities, taking greater ownership of specific reliability and maintenance programs. This role independently leads initiatives to optimize machine operating time, improve uptime and reliability, and reduce the failure rate of equipment and machinery. The Engineer II will also focus on optimizing equipment maintainability, extending equipment life, and introducing engineering solutions that improve operator effectiveness and expedite maintenance services. Beyond technical functions, this individual performs more advanced engineering and specialist functions within the maintenance department, working collaboratively to establish partnerships with Maintenance and Operations counterparts and engage in cross-functional, customer-focused activities to achieve long-term reliability goals and reduce overall operational costs.

Essential Duties
  • Promotes a safe and clean work environment where safety is the highest priority and embedded in our culture.
  • Manage a Failure Reporting, Analysis, and corrective Action System (FRACAS) process, including weekly downtime reporting and monthly FRACAS meetings with action plans for high downtime assets affecting OEE.
  • Manage the preventive and predictive maintenance programs, including PM Optimization reviews, criticality assessments, predictive routes, NDT, and precision maintenance best practices.
  • Manage the lubrication process to improve OEE of critical assets.
  • Develop action plans for improving machine lubrication practices.
  • Manage lubrication sampling program, including developing and tracking plans for out-of-spec asset lubrication.
  • Manage machine lubrication technician position and audit program performance.
  • Develop annual and 5-year workforce development plans.
  • Maintain and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for the department.
  • Audit maintenance practices and implement changes to improve performance.
  • Develop, maintain, and document workflows for maintenance processes (e.g., work request, work orders, planning, scheduling, purchase req's, work order completion).
  • Perform other job duties as assigned

Qualifications Required
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering
  • 2+ years demonstrated industrial manufacturing experience, preferably in a continuous manufacturing process.
  • 2+ years of plant maintenance experience
  • 2+years of experience in maintenance and reliability improvement
  • Able to be certified in Level 1 Thermography, Vibration Analysis 1 and Machinery Lubrication Technician 1 within 2 years of employment
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, hydraulics, pneumatics, bearings, lubrication.
  • Knowledge of vibration analysis, thermal imaging, Oil Analysis, Non-destructive testing, and laser alignment
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documents, including blueprints, schematics, P&IDS and equipment manuals.
  • Experience working with a CMMS, Maximo preferred.
  • Knowledge of probability and statistical modeling, and prediction reliability tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, prioritize, and execute plans to deliver results on multiple projects.
  • Small capital project management skills.

General Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to quality and accuracy
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • Able to influence and lead others over whom he/she has no direct authority.
  • Willing to drive for change in the interest of continuous improvement.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Able to work under limited supervision make independent judgement and decisions as necessary.
  • Excellent organization skills.

Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Advanced knowledge of CMMS/Inventory Management software.

  • Small to medium (less than 50k budget ) capital project management capability
  • Knowledge of probability and statistical modeling, and prediction reliability tools.

•Proactive, solutions-focused mindset with a track record of delivering outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

description:

Non Union Technicians and Research Assistants

Research Assistant

$4,597.80 - $5,469.59 CAD Monthly

August 31, 2026

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.

July 7, 2027

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.


Job Summary
The Appel-Cresswell Lab within the UBC Pacific Parkinson's Research Centre (PPRC), Djavad Mowafaghian Centre for Brain Health (DMCBH), is seeking a part-time (0.6FTE) Research Assistant (RA) to be involved with movement disorders research projects.

The incumbent will be primarily involved with working on clinical research studies involving people living with Parkinson’s. Overall duties include recruitment, cognitive testing, motor assessments, data collection and entry, tracking of collected samples, and assisting with study ethics. The successful candidate will provide primary duties on the LENSER study, with secondary duties including but not limited to study administrative tasks and coverage for other studies in the Lab.

The Research Assistant will work onsite (0.6FTE) at the UBC PPRC at DMCBH in Vancouver, BC.

Organizational Status
The Research Assistant will report to the Research Manager and Principal Investigator (PI). The RA may work with graduate students, Fellows, administrative staff, and various hospital staff. This position requires frequent contact with study participants. Once trained, the RA will work independently as per the study protocol procedures, with primary direction as needed from the Research Manager. The RA will meet with the team on a weekly basis; decision-making will be done in consultation with the PI and Research Manager.


Work Performed
Assists with the daily technical operations of lab projects, including but not limited to:

  • Executes the study protocol procedures under the direction of the PI and Research Manager, in accordance with UBC CREB, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Tri-council guidelines (TCPS-2).
  • Reviews electronic medical record (EMR) charts for recruitment of appropriate research participants, in a respectful and confidential manner.
  • Conducts pre-screening of potential participants to check for study eligibility.
  • Prepares participant study visit documents and performs onsite research visits to collect data, administer rating scales, data entry, and perform other study-related procedures.
  • Maintains a tracking log of the collected biological samples.
  • Maintains the ethics application and any related regulatory documents to ensure accuracy and completeness (updating UBC CREB and VCHRI approvals, certifications, screening logs, etc.).
  • Ensures accurate and timely data collection.
  • Corresponds in a timely manner with the PI, Research Manager, or collaborating teams.
  • Monitors and troubleshoots any study issues in consultation with the Research Manager or team.
  • Assists with other lab duties, related administrative tasks (recruitment, data collection, data entry, etc.), or related studies as needed.

Consequence of Error/Judgement
Errors made could influence the ability of the Principal Investigator to meet critical deadlines, as well as compromise the results of research projects and affect funding applications, thereby impacting the credibility of the Investigator. Poor decisions may be damaging to the reputation of and cause financial loss to the PI, PPRC, and the University.

Supervision Received
The Research Assistant will report to the PI and Research Manager.

Supervision Given

None, but may provide minimal supervision of volunteers or junior RAs, or may initiate new lab team members in the basic routines and procedures of the lab.

Minimum Qualifications
High school graduation, some additional training in a related field and a minimum two years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own

- Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline (Health Science, Public Health, Neuroscience) or an equivalent combination of education or experience.
  • Experienced interactions with patient populations in a respectful and confidential manner.
  • Experience in clinical research and working knowledge of research ethics.
  • Completion of TCPS-2, GCP, and privacy courses.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with proven verbal and written communication.
  • Experience with REDCap and Excel.
  • Computer program proficiency (MS Word, Zoom, Teams).
  • Self-motivated with demonstrated ability to show initiative and sound judgment.
  • Proven organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize workload, attention to detail in data collection.
  • Proactive communications skills.
  • Flexibility to adjust to scheduling changes.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, in a respectful manner.

Sales Manager will drive business growth across the East and North-Eastern region of India in the urban security segment, focusing on government, smart cities, metro rail, critical infrastructure, premium commercials, hospitality, law enforcement, and high-risk public venues. Duties & Responsibilities:

Responsibilities:

1. Business Development & Sales Growth:

  • Prospecting and generate qualified sales opportunities, Manage customer interaction in assigned territories and responsible for end-to-end sales cycle of technical solutions and products.
  • Responsible for generating and preparing quotations and bid proposals, tenders & RFPs, Preparing bid approval forms, quote & bid proposal submissions.

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for Urban Security solutions within the assigned territory.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities in government, homeland security, police, metro, smart city, metro rail, premium commercials, hospitality, law enforcement, high-risk public venues, critical infrastructure sectors and new emerging markets adjacencies.
  • Achieve the assigned annual sales targets, revenue goals, and profitability objectives.
  • Manage the complete end-to-end sales lifecycle and complete prospect-to-bid cycle — from lead generation to closure and post-sales coordination.

Drive every sales pursuit with utmost ownership and accountability and with swift responsiveness to customers.
  • To ensure the Smiths Code of Corporate Responsibility and Business Ethics is upheld in all activities.

  • 8–10 years of proven B2G/B2B sales experience in Security Systems, Surveillance, Defence, Infrastructure, or related industries.
  • Good experience and exposure of working on tenders and RFPs including govt. tenders.
  • Strong Communication for negotiating deals and client interactions
  • Strong analytical abilities to interpret data, track KPIs like conversion rates and forecast trends.
  • Prior experience of working in SAP and CRM environment and data analysis & presentation is must.
  • Technical bent of mind and sound understanding of technology driven solutions and digital offerings.
  • Good relationship management skills with sound commercial acumen and the ability to orchestrate and drive sales closures with good objection handling skills.
  • A go-getter with solution seeking approach and attitude.
