description:
About Honey B

Honey Birdette was created by women for women, to offer an experience unlike any other lingerie retailer. We are a luxury lifestyle brand offering high-end lingerie and premium bedroom accessories. Bold, innovative and a little naughtier than you would expect, Honey Birdette has quickly become one of the most talked-about lingerie brands. We inspire, create curiosity, and empower women through their beauty and confidence.

The Role

As an IT Service & Application Analyst at Honey Birdette, you’ll play an important role in supporting the applications and technology that power our global retail and digital operations.

This is a hands-on, hybrid support role working across our retail technology ecosystem, including ERP, e-commerce, middleware, finance and logistics platforms. You’ll provide first and second line support, troubleshoot application and integration issues, and help keep our omnichannel operations running smoothly.

Working closely with business teams, technology partners and external vendors, you’ll investigate incidents, resolve system and data issues, support end users, and contribute to ongoing enhancements and automation. From troubleshooting API failures and monitoring integrations to setting up new starters and resolving order flow issues, no two days will look quite the same.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide first and second line support across business applications, including ERP, e-commerce, finance, middleware and logistics platforms

  • Troubleshoot, triage and resolve application bugs, incidents and system issues

  • Monitor integration health and investigate REST and SOAP API failures, message queue errors and pipeline issues

  • Investigate and resolve end-to-end order flow issues, from order capture through to warehouse dispatch

  • Support omnichannel processes, including inventory integrations, inter-branch stock transfers and international consolidation flows

  • Investigate data discrepancies across systems, including pricing, stock, orders and currency

  • Manage user access and support end-user onboarding and offboarding

  • Set up and configure laptops, systems and software for new and existing team members

  • Onboard users to business systems and provide training where required

  • Liaise with external vendors to troubleshoot issues and coordinate resolutions

  • Maintain clear system, application and process documentation

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing systems, support processes and automation

  • Contribute to ongoing application enhancements and technology improvements

  • Use AI tools to support ticket triage, problem-solving and day-to-day productivity

Your Sweet Spots (About You)

  • 5+ years’ experience in application support, ideally within a retail or e-commerce environment

  • Experience reading and debugging code in an object-oriented language, preferably .NET or Java

  • Hands-on experience supporting ERP, e-commerce, finance or other business-critical platforms

  • Experience troubleshooting middleware or iPaaS integration flows using platforms such as Boomi, MuleSoft or similar

  • Strong understanding of REST and SOAP APIs, including reading payloads, identifying failures and working with vendors

  • Understanding of omnichannel retail operations, including order management, fulfilment, inventory and inter-branch transfers

  • Familiarity with retail ERP concepts, including purchase orders, goods receipts, stock, pricing and multi-currency

  • Experience supporting the e-commerce order lifecycle and 3PL integrations

  • Working exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI and Power Automate

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and problem-solving

  • Strong troubleshooting skills with a practical, solutions-focused approach

  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to providing dependable end-user support

Desired but not essential:

  • Experience with retail ERP, middleware or e-commerce platforms

  • Exposure to multi-region retail operations across Australia, the UK, the US or Europe

  • Experience supporting international orders and cross-region inventory flows

  • Previous experience working in a fast-paced, global retail environment

Honey Benefits

  • Hybrid Working Arrangements

  • Birthday, Wellness & Parental Leave

  • Generous Product Discounts

  • Self Love Leave

  • Convenient Sydney CBD Office

  • Premium Gym Membership

We love you just the way you are, honey xx

Honey Birdette is an equal opportunity employer. Here at HB, we value honeys of all shapes, sizes, ethnicities and orientations. At the end of the day, we’re all lovers. If you’ve been longing for a workplace that’s fuelled by self-empowerment and self-love, please apply!

We can’t wait to meet you, honey .xx

  • Strong knowledge of C++ and computer science fundamentals.
  • Experience developing and supporting production tools used by multiple teams.
  • Knowledge of character animation systems and contextual dialogue systems.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Structured problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Curiosity and interest in continuously improving tools and systems.

title: Solution Architect - Security, Risk and OT
description:
This Solution Architect is a functional and technical expert who consults with customers on implementing ServiceNow’s Operations Technology Management (OTM) solutions in line with leading practices, accelerating customer business outcomes, and helping build the practice. The role requires the person to be laser-focused on solving the most relevant customer challenges, providing support during sales cycles, engaging directly with our Customers and Partners, and advocating for customer needs within ServiceNow (e.g., Product Management, Customer & Partner Excellence, Training & Certification).

The Solution Architect will provide architectural guidance, business acumen in the technology industry, and deep product expertise, innovation, and knowledge capital to our customers and partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead pre-sales activities including sales presentations, solutioning and scoping workshops, developing Statement of Work (SOW) documentation with clear deliverables and effort estimates, defining project scope and change order triggers, and partnering with Service Account Executives and Sales team members on engagement sizing.
  • Be a lead member of an overall engagement project team focused on delivering successful and substantive customer outcomes, focused on inter-connectivity between Workflow applications and a Customer’s technology landscape, while informing the customer on governance best practices.
  • Interacts with senior leadership, including CXOs, to support discussions on their implementation roadmap and change management best practices for applications within a Workflow.
  • Design and deliver ServiceNow OTM solutions with a technical architecture designed for long-term success and following ServiceNow technical standards and leading practices.
  • Establish mutually beneficial relationships with an OTM’s product owners and stakeholders to promote awareness of Workflow Solutions capabilities and roadmaps.
  • Lead office hours, formal presentations, webinars, and other learning events tailored to field delivery stakeholders (advisory, delivery, Go-To-Market (GTM), etc.) to showcase customer use cases and successes.
  • Promote continuous improvement practices for delivery/engagement materials in partnership with the related Customer & Partner Excellence Team.
  • Enable and mentor other members of the ServiceNow delivery team and partner ecosystem.
  • Up to 50% travel annually, driven by customer needs and internal meetings.
  • Ability to create documentation and service offerings to help promote our services.
  • Ability to be flexible and work in other areas of Risk and Security to maintain their utilization KPI.
  • Acquire and maintain skills/certifications, in their first 90-Days of employment, such as ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSM), Certified Application Developer (CAD), and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS):
    • CMDB Fundamentals
    • USEM (VR)
    • Security Incident Response
    • Integrated Risk Management (IRM)

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Industry domain experience in Operational Technology (OT).
  • Industry domain expertise in ITOM ServiceNow modules. This would cover areas such as event management, Discovery, CMDB, and Service Graph Connectors.

title: Senior Analyst, CRS
description:
Reporting to the Director, CRS Systems, the incumbent acts as the functional specialist for the Radixx Central Reservation System (CRS) and its associated application ecosystem.

Working closely with business teams, IT teams, and external vendors, the incumbent analyzes business requirements, resolves operational issues, and contributes to the evolution of reservation and distribution solutions.

Leveraging a strong understanding of airline business processes, the incumbent assesses the impacts of system and process changes, recommends sustainable solutions, and supports their implementation. The role also involves data analysis, operational reporting, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Additionally, the incumbent contributes to the evolution of team practices by identifying opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence and automation to improve user support, data analysis, documentation, and overall operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
  • Assess the impact of changes on processes, data, and systems.

  • Troubleshoot incidents, recommend sustainable solutions, and coordinate resolution efforts with technical teams and external vendors.
  • Participate in the configuration, maintenance, and enhancement of the CRS and related systems.
  • Prepare and execute functional and regression testing.
  • Use SQL to analyze data, support troubleshooting activities, and produce operational reports.
  • Facilitate communication and mutual understanding between business and technical teams.
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge sharing and knowledge transfer within the team.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the airline industry
  • Bachelor's degree or university diploma in Information Technology, Travel and Tourism, or a related field.
  • Experience with a CRS, PSS, GDS, or DCS platform.
  • Strong understanding of airline reservation, pricing, inventory management, and distribution processes.
  • Experience in functional analysis or application support.
  • Strong SQL knowledge for data analysis and extraction purposes.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, in both French and English

Assets

  • Knowledge of airline industry standards and messaging formats, including IATA, AIRIMP, TTY, and EDIFACT.

title: Staff Digital Design Engineer
description:
We are building a cutting edge 3D memory in our multi-billion dollars Fab. Our memory provides performance, power, and endurance at a lower cost without forgoing quality. The Memory Technology organization is a strategic entity for the company and we are constantly growing. Our group functions as a start-up within Western Digital, and offers a creative, fast paced, entrepreneurial work environment where you’ll be at the center of innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer to lead and deliver projects for our Memory Design team. This is a great opportunity for a results-oriented, entrepreneurial individual who knows how to work with non-volatile memory world-class engineers and has a great track record for delivering innovative results.
You will need to think creatively about the memory as we do take pride in our craftsmanship. We do work together with all engineering teams to identify and execute on the most disciplined way. Your success will be measured by your ability to build great designs that deliver innovation that unlock revenue opportunities for the company.

Join the Memory Technology Design Team and become a leader of this highly motivated, cooperative, and focused team!

In this position, the individual will be responsible for all aspects of digital design in NAND Flash memory, focusing on micro architecture, RTL design, verification, logic synthesis, and timing analysis to deliver a design meeting target power, performance and area goals.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • RTL design and verification in Verilog, RTL linting, clock domain crossing (CDC) analysis, design integration, synthesis, DFT, timing analysis and closure
  • Balance design trade-offs with modularity, scalability, power, area, and performance.
  • Interface with internal and external teams/customers to drive necessary technical specifications and features based on individual requirements
  • Participating in Post-Si evaluation and debug
  • Drive cross function support for productization
  • Technical guidance and mentoring of junior engineers

REQUIRED:

  • MSEE plus 6-8 years of relevant experience
  • Experience with chip level integration, chip lead, and full product life cycle (requirements, design, implementation, test) of Logic design
  • Working knowledge of the entire Logic design flow from RTL to GDSII (RTL coding, simulation, synthesis, static timing analysis, logic equivalence, DFT insertion, place-and-route, clock tree synthesis, extraction, static timing analysis, physical verification)
  • Working knowledge of NAND flash memory cell device operations, algorithms for program/read/erase
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills

PREFERRED:

  • Experience developing digital circuit designs for low power operating conditions
  • Working knowledge of device physics and process
  • Working knowledge of NAND Flash memory design including Analog, Core, Datapath and IO circuits
  • Proficiency with following Digital design tools
    • Synthesis - Synopsys Design Compiler, Cadence Genus or Cadence RTL Compiler
    • Static Timing - Synopsys Primetime or Cadence Tempus
    • Place and Route - Synopsys ICC or Cadence Encounter or Innovus
  • Familiarity with revision control tool and EDA standard formats used in cell/library development and modeling - Liberty (timing model), SDC (Synopsys Design Constraints)
  • Programming experience in C, C++, Python or Perl

The ideal individual must have proven ability to achieve results in a fast moving, dynamic environment. Self-motivated and self-directed, however, must have demonstrated ability to work well with people. A proven desire to work as a team member, both on the same team and outside of the team. Ability to troubleshoot and analyze complex problems. Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines. Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

title: Fleet Technology - Engineer
description:
The role you'll play.

Help shape the future of fleet technology within one of New Zealand's largest and most diverse commercial fleets.

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be involved in the development, integration, deployment, and continuous improvement of technology solutions across our vehicle fleet, including both conventional and electric vehicles. From designing electrical systems and developing new technologies through to testing, commissioning, data analysis, and ongoing technical support, you'll play a key role in bringing innovative ideas into real-world operation.

Working closely with engineers, technicians, suppliers, and operational teams, you will help deliver technology solutions that improve vehicle performance, reliability, safety, and operational efficiency.

This role is ideally suited to an intermediate engineer, however exceptional junior engineers with the right attitude and desire to learn are encouraged to apply.

You'll enjoy solving complex problems, developing new technologies, and seeing your work implemented across operational vehicles and fleet technology systems. In this fast-moving environment, innovation is encouraged, priorities evolve, and you'll gain exposure to the full engineering lifecycle, from concept and development through to deployment, support, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities.

Fleet Technology Development

  • Design and develop fleet technology solutions, in house 3d printing, electrical systems, circuit boards, and wiring harnesses.
  • Support prototype development, testing, commissioning, and deployment activities.
  • Integrate sensors, control systems, telematics, and vehicle electronics into fleet applications.
  • Develop technical documentation, specifications, and implementation plans.

Vehicle Integration & Project Delivery

  • Support technology projects from concept through to deployment.
  • Coordinate component selection, procurement, supplier engagement, and technical deliverables.
  • Work closely with technicians, suppliers, OEMs, and operational teams to deliver successful outcomes.
  • Assist with vehicle testing, field trials, and technology rollouts.

Technical Support & Failure Analysis

  • Provide technical support for deployed fleet technology systems, electric vehicles, and charging infrastructure.
  • Investigate faults and perform root cause analysis using diagnostic tools and operational data.
  • Support field technicians with troubleshooting and technical guidance.
  • Drive improvements that enhance fleet reliability, uptime, and performance.

Data & Reporting

  • Analyse vehicle, telematics, and system performance data.
  • Prepare technical reports, fault investigations, and performance summaries.
  • Identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support reporting tools, dashboards, and performance metrics.

What you'll need.

You will likely have a few years of engineering experience and be ready to take the next step in your career. We are primarily seeking an intermediate engineer, however exceptional junior engineers with the right attitude, aptitude, and desire to learn are encouraged to apply.

Are you technically curious, enjoy solving complex problems, and are excited by the opportunity to develop technology that is deployed into operational vehicles and fleet technology systems. You take a practical approach to engineering, communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, and enjoy seeing projects through from concept and development to deployment and continuous improvement.

You will ideally have experience or interest in:

  • Degree in Electrical, mechatronics or automotive, electronics.
  • Circuit design and electrical system integration.
  • Wiring harness design and documentation.
  • Technical troubleshooting and fault finding.
  • Data analysis and technical reporting.
  • Supplier engagement and technical project delivery.
  • Producing clear technical documentation.

Desirable Skills

  • PCB design using Altium Designer or similar software.
  • CAN Bus and J1939 vehicle communications.
  • PLC programming and industrial control systems.
  • Python, C++, or similar programming languages.
  • CAD design and experience with 3d printing
  • Vehicle telematics and diagnostics.
  • Electric vehicle systems and charging infrastructure.
  • Embedded electronics and control systems.

What's in it for you.

  • The opportunity to develop and deploy technology across one of NZ's most diverse and technical fleets.
  • Exposure to a wide range of technologies including vehicle electronics, controls, telematics, fleet technology, and electric vehicles.
  • Access to modern engineering tools and equipment, including 3D printing, prototyping, testing, and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ownership of projects across the full engineering lifecycle, from concept and development through to deployment and support.
  • Ongoing professional development and opportunities to grow your technical capability.
  • Competitive remuneration, team benefits, and a strong commitment to health, safety, and wellbeing.

If You are a naturally curious and practical engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and turning ideas into real-world solutions. You have strong analytical skills, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and produce clear, well-structured documentation. You are comfortable working with technicians, suppliers, and project teams to deliver successful outcomes.

Apply now if you thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve and new challenges emerge regularly. You take ownership of technical issues, adapt quickly, and enjoy being involved throughout the full lifecycle of a solution, from development and testing through to deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

WM New Zealand is an EEO employer and promotes drug and alcohol-free workplaces. You must be in New Zealand and hold a current work visa/residency or NZ citizenship.

title: Sr. Crane Operator
description:
Ingram Marine Group is looking for a Crane Operator in the Ashland City, TN area.

The Sr. Crane Operator is responsible for safely and efficiently operating friction cranes and material handlers to transport materials and perform various tasks at a river terminal. The operator will assist in loading/unloading cargo, managing inventory, and maintaining a smooth workflow in the terminal. The operator will serve as a subject matter expert for crane operations in the terminal, providing mentorship, training, and technical guidance while ensuring safe and efficient cargo handling. The operator will also train other associates on how to operate friction cranes and material handlers while ensuring compliance with all company regulatory requirements.

What you will be doing:

  • Operate friction cranes and material handler to load and unload cargo efficiently and safely.
  • Effectively train other personnel in the operation of all forms of cranes and material handlers to load and unload cargo materials such as grain, coal, steel coils, salt or other terminal goods.
  • Leads by example with safe work practices and operational excellence.
  • Serves as a mentor and coach to crane operators and terminal associates.
  • Assists management with evaluating and onboarding new operators.
  • Demonstrates proficiency in evaluating operator competency and providing constructive feedback
  • Assist in the loading and unloading of cargo from vessels, trucks, and rail cars.
  • Operate and maintain terminal equipment such as conveyors, and door gun, barge loader spout, and hard car probe at all terminal facilities.
  • Ensure that cargo is properly secured and organized for transport or storage.
  • Assist with opening and closing barge cover access doors, and/or removing and resetting barge cover tops.
  • Monitor and communicate with barge drafter or crane operator.
  • Monitor and communicate barge drafts loader or crane operator.
  • Perform routine checks on equipment and report any malfunctions or maintenance needs.
  • Follow safety protocols and ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area, including dock areas, warehouse spaces, and cargo storage areas.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, coworkers, and vessel crew members to ensure smooth operations.
  • Troubleshoots operational equipment issues and assists maintenance personnel in identifying root causes.
  • Maintains detailed equipment inspection and operational records.
  • Recognized as the terminal expert on friction crane operations and specialized lifting activities.
  • Assist with inventory, including tracking cargo and reporting discrepancies.
  • Perform general labor tasks such as cleaning, sorting, and organizing goods, tools, and supplies.
  • Cleaning product from pits, barge decks and barge covers, and other areas as necessary.
  • Work in varying weather conditions and maintain physical stamina throughout shifts.
  • Perform any other reasonable task as requested.

      Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

      • Physical activities that are essentials to daily functions include but are not limited to: 1) regularly lifting loads up to 50lbs unassisted and occasionally up to 75lbs. 20 Climbing of ladders over 20’ of vertical height while using fall protection. 30 Frequently carrying, dragging, and pulling of wires, lines and railcar door opener equipment. 4) Frequent bending, twisting, kneeling and reaching. 5) Frequent shoveling and sweeping and strenuous sledgehammering of railcars. Familiarity with safety protocols and ability to follow instructions.
      • Proven experience operating friction cranes and material handlers, preferably in a river terminal or maritime environment.
      • Strong knowledge of safety regulations and best practices in crane operations.
      • Ability to work in a fast-paced, outdoor environment in varying weather conditions.
      • Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a team.
      • Physical fitness to handle the demands of the job, including lifting and climbing

      Education & Experience Preferences/Requirements:

      • High School or GED required
      • 4-5 Years experience as a Crane Operator required
      • Certification Required: First Aid & CPR

      Working Environment and Conditions:

      • Outdoor/indoor working environment with exposure to loud noises, dust, and potentially hazardous materials
      • Shift work may be required, including weekends or holidays, depending on the operation schedule
      • Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), such as safety vests, hard hats, gloves, and steel-toe boots

      All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

      • A competitive compensation package
      • Comprehensive benefits including Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA.
      • Generous paid time off benefits
      • 401K match
      • Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more
      • Associate growth and development encouraged through internal training and tuition reimbursement program

      Anticipated start date will be in October.

title: Coordenador de Gestão do Cliente - São Carlos / SP
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Analista Pleno de Administração de Vendas para atuar como parceiro estratégico da área Comercial, garantindo excelência operacional, governança e agilidade na gestão de contratos e processos administrativos relacionados ao ciclo de vendas.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações de Apoio à Vendas para liderar uma das mais importantes jornadas de transformação da área Comercial.

Esta posição terá como principal missão redesenhar completamente o modelo operacional da área, conduzindo a evolução dos processos, da governança e da experiência da força comercial. Mais do que gerir uma operação, buscamos um líder capaz de desafiar o modelo atual, implementar novas formas de trabalho, utilizar tecnologia como acelerador da eficiência e construir uma operação moderna, escalável e orientada por dados.

Você será responsável pela gestão de uma equipe que atua como suporte operacional à força de vendas, garantindo excelência no atendimento, alta disponibilidade dos serviços, conformidade dos processos e evolução contínua da operação.

Principais responsabilidades

Liderança Operacional

  • Liderar a operação de Apoio à Vendas, garantindo excelência na execução dos processos administrativos que suportam o ciclo comercial.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar a performance da equipe por meio de metas, indicadores e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Assegurar altos níveis de qualidade, produtividade, SLA e satisfação dos clientes internos.
  • Atuar como principal interface entre Operações, Comercial, Tecnologia, Produtos, Jurídico, Compliance e demais áreas corporativas.

Transformação e Change Management

  • Liderar o programa de transformação da área, promovendo o redesenho de 100% dos processos operacionais, eliminando atividades de baixo valor agregado e simplificando a jornada da força comercial.
  • Estruturar iniciativas de Change Management, garantindo comunicação, engajamento, capacitação e adoção dos novos processos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, digitalização e padronização das operações.
  • Conduzir projetos estratégicos de melhoria contínua utilizando metodologias Lean, Agile, BPM ou similares.
  • Atuar na implementação de novos modelos operacionais, assegurando estabilidade durante todo o processo de transformação.

Gestão de Indicadores e Performance

  • Definir, acompanhar e evoluir indicadores operacionais (KPIs) e indicadores estratégicos da área.
  • Monitorar continuamente níveis de serviço (SLA), produtividade, qualidade, backlog, capacidade operacional e experiência do cliente interno.
  • Elaborar dashboards executivos e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Implementar rituais de gestão à vista e governança operacional.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação baseados em indicadores e análise de causa raiz.

Excelência no Atendimento

  • Garantir a melhor experiência para a força comercial durante toda a jornada de atendimento.
  • Monitorar a qualidade do atendimento prestado pela equipe.
  • Atuar preventivamente na identificação de riscos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Promover uma cultura de foco no cliente, colaboração e melhoria contínua.

Principais desafios da posição

  • Liderar a transformação completa da operação de Apoio à Vendas.
  • Redesenhar integralmente os processos existentes, tornando-os mais simples, digitais e escaláveis.
  • Elevar significativamente os níveis de eficiência operacional e produtividade.
  • Estruturar indicadores que proporcionem previsibilidade e gestão em tempo real da operação.
  • Construir uma cultura orientada por dados, inovação e melhoria contínua.
  • Incorporar Inteligência Artificial e automação como elementos centrais da estratégia operacional.
  • Garantir uma experiência excepcional para a força comercial, reduzindo tempo de atendimento e aumentando a percepção de valor da operação.

Por que essa posição é estratégica?

A área de Apoio à Vendas é um dos principais habilitadores da geração de receita da companhia. O Coordenador será protagonista na construção de uma nova operação, mais eficiente, digital, escalável e orientada por dados.

Seu desafio será transformar processos historicamente operacionais em uma estrutura moderna, inteligente e altamente integrada ao negócio, utilizando tecnologia, automação e Inteligência Artificial para elevar a produtividade da força comercial e melhorar continuamente a experiência dos nossos clientes internos.

O que buscamos

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Experiência consolidada em liderança de operações, backoffice comercial, Sales Operations, Administração de Vendas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência em gestão de indicadores operacionais, SLA, produtividade e qualidade.
  • Histórico de liderança em projetos de transformação organizacional e redesenho de processos.
  • Excelente capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação executiva e habilidade para influenciar diferentes níveis da organização.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão, Processos, Operações ou Projetos.
  • Certificações Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, Scrum ou Agile.
  • Experiência com Power BI, Power Platform ou ferramentas de Analytics.

title: Security Officer - Full Time
description:
Security Officers are responsible for ensuring the safety and security of guests, team members, and company assets. Duties include but not limited to patrolling property, monitoring security systems, responding to emergencies, and delivering excellent guest service in a professional and courteous manner.

Unarmed Security Officers carry and may utilize non-lethal weapons and defensive equipment which requires completion of company training, qualifications and passing all related examinations.

(including but not limited to)

  • Patrol and monitor all areas of the property, including exterior areas, on foot, bicycle, or in a company vehicle.
  • Monitor alarm systems, surveillance cameras, access control systems and other security equipment.
  • Deliver excellent guest service, responding to questions, complaints, and/or conflicts in a professional manner.
  • Respond to physical threats. altercations, or aggressive behavior.
  • When necessary, engage in self-defense, and defensive tactics (including take downs, handcuffing, restraining, or subduing an assailant).
  • Utilize de-escalation and conflict resolution techniques to minimize the need for force.
  • Act as a first responder during emergencies (medical, fire, criminal, natural disasters).
  • Perform gaming drops and transactions, including carrying and transporting drop boxes and chip carriers. (min weight approx. 3 lbs to max weight 50 lbs)
  • Write detailed and accurate incident reports on accidents, property damage, theft, or unusual occurrences.
  • Serve as dispatcher to relay information, messages, or emergencies by phone or radio.
  • Administer first aid/CPR/AED and Narcan and follow medical emergency protocols.
  • Secure and preserve incident scenes, conduct evacuation procedures, and summon emergency responders when appropriate.
  • Attend and successfully pass all recurring mandatory training (legal, defensive tactics, CPR/AED, drills, etc).
  • Maintain proficiency with assigned equipment and communication devices.
  • Respond to all emergencies, including fires, medical incidents, and criminal activity.
  • Observe, report, and take appropriate action on suspicious or criminal activity.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Required:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in security, customer service, or related role.
  • Strong communication, observation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to successfully complete company Security Officer Academy.
  • Proof of eligibility to work in the United States.
  • Ability to operate vehicles, radios, and security equipment.

Preferred:

  • Previous security, law enforcement, or military background.
  • Experience in resort, casino, or hospitality security environments.

Physical Requirements

(consistent with ADA and industry standards)

  • Lifting/Carrying: Regularly up to 30 lbs.; occasionally up to 50 lbs.
  • Push/Pull: Must be able to push or pull carts or equipment weighing up to 200 lbs. or rolling load (force required approximately 25-40 lbs. depending on surface and incline).
  • Dragging: Ability to drag or assist an unconscious person in an emergency.
  • Standing/Walking: Prolonged periods (up to 5+ hours per shift).
  • Running/Climbing: Must be able to run short distances and climb multiple flights of stairs.
  • Movement: Frequent bending, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, and stooping.
  • Vision/Hearing: Normal color, distance, and peripheral vision; adequate hearing for alarms, radios, and communication.
  • Speech: Clear verbal communication required.
  • Driving: Must safely operate company vehicles.
  • Typing/Reports: Ability to type and complete written and digital reports accurately.

Work Environment

  • Indoor and outdoor assignments in varying weather conditions.
  • May involve high-noise, high-traffic, or crowded environments.
  • Must remain calm and professional in stressful or emergency situations.
  • Must demonstrate safe ergonomics when lifting, carrying, or pushing/pulling objects, including carts used for drop and transport operations.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proficiency in defensive tactics, handcuffing, and de-escalation techniques.
  • Effectively communicate and interact with a diverse range of individuals and groups, including customers, employees, law enforcement and the public.
  • Ability to operate vehicles, radios, and security equipment.
  • Computer literacy to complete reports and access security systems.
  • Ability to direct and participate in evacuation and emergency procedures.
  • Capacity to restrain or subdue individuals when necessary.

Sunflower Bank, N.A. is currently searching for a detail-oriented and highly motivated Commercial Credit Analyst in Dallas, TX.


Description:


The Commercial Credit Analyst will support Commercial Credit Underwriters in every aspect of the latter’s day-to-day activities.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with financial analysis and risk assessment by preparing financial statement spreads, analyzing trends, and supporting credit underwriting decisions.

  • Build a foundational understanding of the bank’s credit policies, underwriting standards, and risk metrics, and apply them in daily activities.

  • Develop the ability to monitor borrower financial performance and track compliance with loan covenants and borrowing base requirements.
  • Conduct industry research and prepare overviews highlighting trends and conditions impacting clients and prospects.
  • Become familiar with loan documentation and capable of producing summaries of important loan conditions and collateral structures.
  • Gain an understanding of the Bank’s ancillary products important to building the bank’s relationship with its commercial/corporate clients and assist and collaborate with internal partners to support cross-sell opportunities.


Education / Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or other applicable undergraduate or graduate degree.
  • 1+ years in commercial lending and credit analysis.
  • Must possess excellent Microsoft Office Suite skills, specifically Word/Excel.

Regular walking may be required, along with occasional bending, stooping, kneeling, or climbing. The role may involve lifting or moving items weighing up to 10 pounds.   • Serve as a principal advisor on all matters, technical and otherwise, involving the security of Information Technology Division information systems.

Our team works alongside the private sector to optimise operational performance and drive transformative change drawing on Deloitte’s business expertise, technology capabilities and deep industry and sector insights.

What will your typical day look like?

You will be working directly with clients across a wide range of public sector organisations to support transformation and operational improvement initiatives. You will work closely with experienced consultants, managers and partners who will provide guidance, coaching and development opportunities as you build your consulting and delivery skills.

Day-to-day responsibilities will vary depending on the project, but you will play an active role in understanding client challenges, conducting analysis, developing recommendations and supporting the delivery of transformation initiatives. Our shared values are at the heart of everything we do. Living these values, including ‘taking care of each other’ and ‘fostering inclusion’, is essential to ensuring everyone feels included at work and able to reach their full potential.
For us to succeed and thrive as an organisation, we understand the importance of creating a culture where diverse perspectives matter and where everyone is given an equal opportunity to grow and develop.

We hold a simple belief – that our people’s hard work should be recognised and rewarded beyond their remuneration.
We have reimagined what ‘work’ looks like and how we can empower all our people to create a work experience that is distinct to their needs. Founded on concepts of trust, balance, wellbeing, and the importance of personal connection, this is the Deloitte experience.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

  • 2+ years’ experience supporting or analyzing transformation initiatives within IT, Technology, Digital, or Data functions, supported by a relevant bachelor's degree.

At Primark, people matter. title: Sampling Technician
description:
He kōrero mō mātou | About Watercare

Ki te ora te wai, ka ora te whenua, ka ora te tangata
When the water is healthy, the land and the people are healthy

Now is an exciting time to join Watercare, we're planning to spend $14 billion over the next 10 years to ensure we can continue to support our growing city in a climate-resilient way. When you average that out, that's an investment of $3.8 million every day!

He whakamārama mō te tūranga mahi | About the role

As a Sampling Technician, you'll play a critical role in helping Watercare maintain the quality and safety of Auckland's water and wastewater systems. You'll collect and field test water samples from a range of locations across Auckland, ensuring samples are gathered, handled and delivered accurately to support regulatory compliance, public health, and operational performance.

This is a hands-on role that combines fieldwork, laboratory support, and customer service. No two days are the same as you travel across the region collecting samples from drinking water, wastewater, environmental, and groundwater sites.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Collecting water and wastewater samples across Auckland.

  • Conducting field testing and accurately recording results.

  • Preparing and maintaining sampling equipment and vehicles.

  • Calibrating field testing equipment and entering data into laboratory systems.

  • Supporting quality assurance standards and accreditation requirements.

  • Identifying and escalating anomalies and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Participating in an on-call roster when required.

Ngā pūkenga e rapu nei mātou | About you

You're someone who enjoys being out in the field, takes pride in producing accurate results, and can work independently while building strong relationships with customers and colleagues.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring:

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

  • Confidence using computer systems and technology.

  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work autonomously.

  • A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to learn.

  • A genuine enjoyment of working outdoors in a variety of environments and weather conditions.

  • Confident / competent swimmer

  • Comfortable driving larger vehicles and collecting samples

Ideally, you'll also have:

  • A science-related qualification or interest in science.

  • Experience in field sampling, environmental monitoring, or laboratory environments.

  • Experience using Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).

Ngā hua mōu | What's in it for you

We offer a competitive salary and staff benefits package including:
• Training and development opportunities

title: LEAD SECURITY OFFICER
description:
The Lead Security Officer in this position is responsible for scheduling the daily activities of Security Officers, acting as a liaison between Security Supervisors and Security Officers while maintaining security protection, which includes money transactions, public relations, performing command center functions, assisting guests and team members as needed.

The Lead Security Officer:

  • Assists Security Supervisor as required and responds to incidents as directed.
  • Assigns daily post positions, breaks, and equipment, ensuring smooth transitions from each shift.
  • Handles pit counts, pit box assignments, pit keys, and other responsibilities concerning the relationship with the Table Games department.
  • Assists supervisor in coordinating actions with outside agencies when needed; aids supervisor in collecting written statements, photographs, reviewing reports, key control, and off property alarm response, when needed.

  • Acts as an officer as needed.

  • Prepare complete, accurate, and detailed reports on security incidents to ensure that Security Management is kept abreast of security related incidents.
  • May serve and assist the On-Scene Leader that reports to the Director of Security for any life safety emergency (such as, fire, flood, bomb threat, evacuation, man-overboard, etc.) on the vessel to ensure safety of casino guests, employees and property.

  • Must be able to lift, push and pull up to 75 lbs, move money boxes, carts and drop equipment as necessary.
  • Must be able to assist sick or injured guests and/or employees.
  • Ability to communicate courteously, effectively, and professionally with guests, outside contacts and all levels of employees.
  • Must be able to use tools and equipment, including but not limited to, keys, handcuffs, flashlights, radios, computers and other tools specific to the position.
  • Must be flexible to work varying shifts and time schedules as needed.
  • Ability to perform duties under varying conditions, including but not limited to, exposure to varying levels of smoke, crowds, noise, and changing weather conditions.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain extremely confidential information.
  • General familiarity with investigation procedures.
  • Must be bondable with no felony convictions.
  • Valid driver's license, preferred.
  • Knowledge of department policies and procedures.
  • C.P.R. and Blood borne Pathogens Certification, preferred.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain all appropriate licenses / certifications per Federal, State, and Gaming regulations.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.

This knowledge and these abilities are typically acquired through the completion of a high school education, or equivalent, as well as one year experience in security operations. Supervisory experience preferred

title: Summer Intern – Machine Learning for Animal Assessment
description:
LIC’s Research and Development (R&D) group is driving innovation to keep New Zealand farmers and their businesses at the forefront of the global dairy industry. Our world-class team is actively engaged in cutting-edge work across genetics, genomics, reproduction, animal health, statistics, and machine learning.

In partnership with the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, we’re offering summer internships that provide hands-on experience across a diverse range of scientific and technical areas—from genetic analysis to data science and modelling—leveraging both in-house and cloud-based computing platform

Project Details:

Project Title:

Machine Learning Feature Advancement for Dairy Animal Assessment

Project scope:

The successful student will contribute to an early-stage project exploring whether computer vision and machine learning can support consistent, scalable assessment of live dairy animal features. The project will focus on capturing video and spatial data from animals, rendering and analysing physical features in three dimensions, and assessing how well machine learning models can generate useful outputs from that data. This work sits within broader interest in improving feature capture and measurement, using scalable technology to make animal assessment more consistent, repeatable, and practical for future research and product development.

Your Contribution:

  • Help progress the project toward a practical proof of concept.

  • Assist with on-farm video capture.

  • Organise and validate captured footage.

  • Annotate key visual features and prepare datasets for model development.

  • Develop a prototype workflow that turns video or spatial data into usable analytical outputs

Expected Outputs:

The project provides time-boxed contribution to an important early-stage machine vision project. The student’s work will help establish whether relatively accessible capture technologies, such as multi-camera phone-based capture, can provide data of sufficient quality to support automated or semi-automated assessment of dairy animal features. The project may also generate reusable datasets, annotation processes, and prototype code that future R&D work can build on.

Key Skills Required:

  • Python programming experience

  • Interest in computer vision, machine learning, image/video analysis, or applied AI.

  • Basic understanding of data handling, data cleaning, and exploratory analysis; experience with tools such as Pandas, Polars, NumPy, or similar would be useful

  • Ability to learn annotation and validation workflows for image or video datasets

  • Clear written communication and documentation skills

  • Curiosity about dairy systems, animal breeding, phenotyping, or agricultural technology

  • Willingness to spend a portion of time on working dairy farms for data capture, following LIC health and safety and animal handling requirements.

  • Interest in 3D data, spatial capture, photogrammetry, LiDAR, or model-based feature extraction would be an advantage but is not essential.

To be eligible for these internships students must be:

  • Legally permitted to work in New Zealand.

  • Studying, or have studied, an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification at NZQA level 6-10 If study has been completed, the final semester should have ended within the last 12 months.

  • Studying, or have studied, science, technology, engineering, design or business at a New Zealand tertiary education institute.

  • Be able to work on-site at our Head Office in Newstead Hamilton for the duration of the internship

Application information:

If you have worked for LIC before, you can still apply if:

  • your job was part-time or temporary

  • you only held one R&D Experience Grant internship with LIC.

Please attach an up-to-date CV and your academic transcript with your application.

The internship is a paid opportunity offering $29.90 per hour for a period of 10 weeks. You will be required to work a minimum of 30 hours per week, up to a maximum of 400 hours to be completed by 31 March 2027. Participation in the project will be based physically at LIC. At the conclusion of the internship, you will be required to deliver a presentation and submit a report.

Applications close: 13 September 2026 or earlier if the roles are filled

title: Reliability Improvement Leader
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

Our Western Port Manufacturing facility is looking for a Reliability Improvement Leader in our Metal Coating Maintenance team based in Western Port. As a part of the broader Australian Steel Products Portfolio, we have four major manufacturing sites at Western Port which operate 24 x 7 and deliver a variety of products, innovative solutions and services to export and domestic customers.

Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, this influential leadership role will see you lead a team of technical specialists focused on maximising asset reliability, process uptime, and operational performance across a complex 24/7 manufacturing environment.

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineer, or an accomplished maintenance professional with strong reliability expertise to drive long-term asset improvement strategies, lead continuous improvement initiatives, and make a meaningful impact on safety, quality, and production outcomes.

What Will You Do?

As a key member of the maintenance leadership team, you will:

  • lead, coach, and develop a team of reliability specialists across multiple technical disciplines
  • develop and execute reliability improvement strategies that enhance equipment performance and plant availability
  • analyse equipment performance data and lead investigations into recurring failures and production losses.
  • drive defect elimination and continuous improvement initiatives to improve asset reliability and reduce operating costs
  • manage maintenance strategies and ensure compliance with reliability and maintenance standards
  • act as a key interface for capital projects, ensuring successful integration with plant operations
  • support the safe delivery of maintenance and improvement activities while minimising business risk

More About You

You are a strategic thinker who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and leading teams to deliver exceptional results. You bring strong stakeholder engagement skills, sound engineering judgement, and a passion for continuous improvement.

You will also have:

  • a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or a Diploma of Engineering supported by significant maintenance leadership experience
  • demonstrated success in reliability, maintenance, or asset management within heavy industry, or similar environments
  • experience leading technical specialists and fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and continuous improvement
  • strong understanding of reliability methodologies, root cause analysis, defect elimination, and maintenance strategy development
  • the ability to influence stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive change across a complex operational environment
  • proven capability in plant maintenance practices including reliability analysis and continuous improvement

Why BlueScope

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope gives you opportunities to innovate, learn and grow with the business, supported by inclusive leadership and a positive, passionate team. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. With opportunities to build skills specific to your role and aspirations, our lifelong learning culture will support your future career pathways.​
  • Create innovative solutions. Seek better, smarter ways to solve problems, create sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do. ​

At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and welcome people of all backgrounds, skills, experiences and perspectives. We encourage Women and First Nations people to apply. We’re passionate about driving sustainability outcomes that matter to our communities, including action on climate and our 2050 net zero goal.​

Bring your energy and make your mark, as, together, we drive Our Purpose: “We create and inspire smart solutions in steel, to strengthen communities for the future.” ​

Come and discover us at ​

Join us, creating strength for the future.

Applications close Tuesday 8th September 2026.

title: IEA Employment Consultant - Inverell
description:
Make a real impact – create opportunities and change lives!!!

Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Location: Based in Inverell, NSW, this role includes regular outreach work in Tenterfield, NSW, where you will be based three days every fortnight to support clients and deliver services.

Who Are We: -

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

About the role: -

This is a dynamic role where you get to combine people support with sales, relationship building and administration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

You will:

  • Support participants (many facing barriers such as disability, injury, or long-term unemployment) to become job-ready
  • Actively market candidates to employers and generate job opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with local businesses to create sustainable employment pathways
  • Success in this role comes from your ability to balance people support with proactive employer engagement and outcome delivery.

Key Responsibilities: -

  • Build strong relationships with participants to understand their employment goals and position them for success.
  • Coach participants to be job-ready, competitive, and interview confident.
  • Assist participants with resumes, interview preparation, job search strategies and facilitate access to training and upskilling opportunities.
  • Drive employment outcomes by actively advocating on behalf of participants to employers and securing job placements.
  • Generate new employment opportunities through cold calls, employer visits, and face-to-face engagement with employers to generate job opportunities.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of employers to consistently convert opportunities into placements.
  • Identify and capitalise on hidden job opportunities through proactive business development.
  • Pitch candidates confidently, positioning their skills to meet employer needs.
  • Influence hiring decisions by promoting the commercial and social value of inclusive recruitment
  • Negotiate job trials, work experience placements, and wage subsidies to secure employment outcomes.
  • Maintain and grow employer relationships to drive repeat business and ongoing vacancies.
  • Achieve and exceed KPI targets across placements, engagement, and activity levels.
  • Conduct regular appointments and track participant progress toward employment outcomes.
  • Manage compliance, documentation, and data entry in line with program requirements.
  • Track performance against KPIs and achieve employment outcome targets.
  • Celebrate milestones and successful placements to build participant confidence and engagement.

What Success Looks Like: -

  • Strong employment outcomes for participants.
  • A growing network of engaged local employers.
  • Consistent achievement of KPIs and performance targets.
  • Positive, long-term placements that change lives.

About You: -

You are:

  • A natural communicator and relationship builder with confidence engaging employers.
  • Experienced in sales, business development, recruitment, or customer-facing roles.
  • Passionate about helping people overcome barriers and succeed.
  • Resilient, target-driven, and motivated by achieving outcomes.
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

Why You’ll Love It: -

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Base salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success.

title: Summer Internship –Leveraging calf defect data
description:
LIC’s Research and Development (R&D) group is driving innovation to keep New Zealand farmers and their businesses at the forefront of the global dairy industry. Our world-class team is actively engaged in cutting-edge work across genetics, genomics, reproduction, animal health, statistics, and machine learning.

In partnership with the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, we’re offering summer internships that provide hands-on experience across a diverse range of scientific and technical areas—from genetic analysis to data science and modelling—leveraging both in-house and cloud-based computing platform

Project Details:

Title:

Leveraging Calf Defect Data to Identify Emerging Genetic Conditions in Dairy Cattle

Project scope:

LIC has a number of methods for reducing and managing the negative impacts of genetic disease on the New Zealand dairy cattle population. One of these is defect management, which relies on information collected through the LIC Calf Defect Form and calving comments recorded in MINDA. The LIC Calf Defect Form allows farmers to report calves born with defects, including details of the defect and the likely sire. In addition, MINDA enables farmers to record calving comments by selecting defect categories for calves born to recorded dams. Together, these systems provide valuable information on calf defects occurring across herds. The LIC Defect Team reviews and manages these data, investigating cases where calves with similar defects are reported from multiple farms and are linked to the same bull. This project aims to refresh and improve the current process by ensuring the data are captured and utilised effectively, developing a more structured workflow, and refining defect records into meaningful phenotypes that can support future genetic variant discovery.

Your contribution:

The successful student will begin by organising and categorising calf data, helping to establish a structured and efficient data management workflow. Building on this foundation, they will analyse the data to identify emerging trends and patterns, with the opportunity to uncover potential new traits, or conditions that could support future genetic research and discovery.

Outputs:

This project provides a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving how calf defect data is analysed and interpreted. Through the development of a more robust and streamlined workflow, you'll help unlock valuable insights, enhance data quality, and support the identification of emerging genetic trends within the dairy industry.

Key Skills Required:

  • Knowledge on either animal/human disease OR data analysis in R/python

  • Willingness to learn

  • Strong excel expertise

  • Problem solving

  • Veterinary, genetics or data science students are particularly encouraged to apply

To be eligible for these internships students must be:

  • Legally permitted to work in New Zealand.

  • Studying, or have studied, an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification at NZQA level 6-10 If study has been completed, the final semester should have ended within the last 12 months.

  • Studying, or have studied, science, technology, engineering, design or business at a New Zealand tertiary education institute.

  • Be able to work on-site at our Head Office in Newstead Hamilton for the duration of the internship

Application information:

If you have worked for LIC before, you can still apply if:

  • your job was part-time or temporary

  • you only held one R&D Experience Grant internship with LIC.

Please attach an up-to-date CV and your academic transcript with your application.

The internship is a paid opportunity offering $29.90 per hour for a period of 10 weeks. You will be required to work a minimum of 30 hours per week, up to a maximum of 400 hours to be completed by 31 March 2027. Participation in the project will be based physically at LIC. At the conclusion of the internship, you will be required to deliver a presentation and submit a report.

Applications close: 13th September 2026 or earlier if the roles are filled.

description:
Company:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

LOCATIONS

We are hiring across our OW offices including but not limited to: Toronto and Montreal.

Practice Overview

At Oliver Wyman Quotient we partner with clients to deliver breakthrough outcomes for their toughest AI challenges.

We blend the power of AI technology with deep industry expertise to tackle disruption and create impact. By building strong capabilities and culture, we accelerate and embed AI transformation. Our people co-create and grow customer-focused solutions that win. We modernize technology and harness value from data and analytics. We build resilience so our clients are ready for tomorrow’s risks and optimize operations for the future. Above all, we work collaboratively with our clients’ leaders, employees, stakeholders, and customers to jointly define, design, and achieve lasting results.

____

The Role And Responsibilities

No two OW Quotient projects are the same. You’ll be working with varied and diverse teams to deliver unique and unprecedented products across industries. As a Senior Lead AI Developer, you are primarily responsible for managing technical projects and helping teams design and build AI/ML systems and pipelines that consistently drive solutions to be extensible and production quality. You are an expert in selected domains and can contrast methods and select appropriate approaches based on the data or modelling problem at hand. As an AI Developer, you will work alongside Oliver Wyman partners in Quotient and other practice groups, engage directly with clients to understand their business challenges, and craft appropriate solutions to be delivered through collaboration with other OW Quotient specialists and consultants.

Your responsibilities will include, for example:

  • Exploring data and crafting AI solutions to answer core business problems
  • Working with Partners and Principals to shape proposals that leverage our AI and engineering capabilities
  • Building and deploying LLM-based agent systems in production
  • Keeping up with your domain’s state of the art & developing familiarity with emerging modelling and data engineering methodologies
  • Advocating application of best practices in modelling, code hygiene and data engineering
  • Leading the development of proprietary AI/ML solutions, algorithms, or analytical tools and infrastructure on projects and asset development

____

Your Experience & Qualifications

You are a well-rounded technologist who brings a wealth of real-world experience and:

  • Technical background in computer science, data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistics or other quantitative and computational science
  • Compelling track record of designing and deploying large-scale technical solutions, which deliver tangible, ongoing value including:
    • Direct experience having built and deployed robust, complex production systems that implement modern artificial intelligence at scale
    • Comfort in environments where large projects are time-boxed, and therefore consequential design decisions may need to be made and acted upon rapidly
  • Demonstrated fluency in modern programming languages for artificial intelligence / agents, covering the end-to-end AI development lifecycle:
    • Knowledge of one or more agentic platforms , including but not limited to: Azure Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
    • Deep familiarity with the architecture, performance characteristics, and limitations of compound AI systems, including retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, agentic memory, and multi-agent orchestration
    • Experience designing and operating evaluation frameworks and observability tooling to measure AI system quality, detect failure modes, and maintain performance in production
    • Proficiency in LLM system design, including prompt engineering, context and token management, structured output, fine-tuning tradeoffs, and cost/latency optimization
    • A history of compelling side projects or contributions to the Open-Source community is valued but not required
  • Practical awareness of AI risk, bias, and governance, including how to identify and mitigate failure modes in high-stakes or regulated environments
  • Solid theoretical grounding in the mathematical core of the major ideas in AI/ML:
    • Applied understanding of a class of modelling or analytical techniques
    • Fluency in the mathematical principles and generalizations of data science – e.g., Statistics, Linear Algebra and Vector Calculus
    • Experience presenting at high-impact AI/ML developer conferences and solid connections to the AI/ML developer community (e.g., via meetups, open-source contributions, continuing relationships with academics, etc.) is highly valued
  • Interest/background in Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Consumer, Retail, Energy, or Transportation industries

Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in more than 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. title: Senior Data Analyst
description: **Senior Data Analyst** At WSP, we're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Digital team in Brisbane and help deliver advanced analytics, business intelligence, and data engineering solutions for complex client and engineering challenges. This role will suit someone who enjoys working with large, varied datasets, translating business problems into practical data-led solutions, and turning complex technical insight into clear recommendations for clients and project teams. You'll work across multidisciplinary projects, collaborating with engineering, digital, location intelligence, and subject matter experts to support infrastructure, asset, and operational decision-making. Many of our clients operate large-scale network-based systems, including road, rail, and water supply networks, so this is an opportunity to apply your analytical expertise to work that has real community impact. **What you'll do** As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll lead client and stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, define analytical questions, validate assumptions, and shape practical solutions. You'll break down complex problems into structured analytical steps, defining inputs, outputs, risks, data needs, assumptions, and repeatable workflows that others can follow. You'll gather, analyse, process, and model large structured and unstructured datasets, including complex or messy data sources, to create actionable plans and recommendations. You'll also apply statistical, analytical, and BI methods to interpret results, test hypotheses, identify trends, challenge assumptions, and uncover future-ready solutions to client challenges. A key part of the role will be developing, maintaining, and improving data pipelines, data models, dashboards, reports, and quality controls using appropriate digital tools, cloud services, and analytics platforms. You'll also prepare and review high-level technical information, including reports, memos, presentations, models, software, and data outputs. You'll provide technical guidance, mentoring, and feedback to junior team members, helping build capability across analytics, BI, data management, documentation, and quality practices. You'll also contribute to strong client relationships by communicating technical issues clearly, responding to feedback, and supporting proposals, pursuits, and future project opportunities. **What we'll love about you** You'll bring at least five years' experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, digital, or a related technical environment. You'll have demonstrated experience working across complex and multidisciplinary projects, ideally in client-facing environments where you've translated technical outputs into clear, useful recommendations. You'll be confident working with complex structured and unstructured data, including messy datasets from operational systems, smart devices, spatial sources, emails, or other varied sources. You'll understand how to design repeatable analytical workflows, document assumptions, manage data risks, and turn findings into practical insights. You'll have strong hands-on capability across data transformation, modelling, reporting, dashboarding, and BI platforms such as Power BI. Experience with Python, SQL, relational and structured data manipulation, data warehousing, cloud data services such as Azure and/or AWS, and analytics or modelling software will also be important. You'll bring a sound understanding of statistical concepts and methods, along with the ability to support others in applying statistics to decision-making. You'll also understand data quality, governance, compliance, privacy, ethical AI, transparency, and bias considerations in analytical solutions. Experience with FME, GIS, Ellipse, asset data, infrastructure, engineering domains, or Python-based software development would be highly regarded, but is not essential. Experience in engineering and infrastructure industries such as mining, transport, property and buildings, or environmental science would also be favourable. **About you** You'll be someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working with stakeholders, and creating analytical frameworks that are practical, repeatable, and easy for others to understand. You'll be comfortable balancing technical detail with commercial and client outcomes, and you'll have the communication skills to bring people along the journey. You'll also value collaboration, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement, and you'll be motivated by the opportunity to contribute to projects that support better infrastructure, asset, and operational outcomes. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects, and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. **With us, you can. Apply today.**

  • Account mapping: identify the firms, offices, producers, and client portfolios with the strongest concentration of AI-native and AI-deploying companies.
  • Market education: help brokers understand where traditional E&O and cyber coverage stops and where AI agent liability begins.
  • Feedback loop: bring structured feedback from brokers and insureds into our underwriting, coverage, pricing, and product development.
  • Channel operations: build the systems for broker onboarding, submissions, follow-up, attribution, and performance management.
  • Revenue: carry a broker-sourced premium and revenue target from day one.

What success looks like in 12 months

  • Klaimee has a focused network of brokers who understand the product and actively bring us opportunities.
  • Broker relationships are producing qualified submissions and bound business, not just introductory meetings.
  • We know which broker profiles, firms, and client segments generate the strongest results.
  • Brokers can clearly explain when a client needs Klaimee and how our coverage complements existing E&O and cyber policies.
  • We have a repeatable broker onboarding and enablement process.
  • A meaningful portion of Klaimee’s pipeline and premium is broker-sourced.
  • You have built the case to lead Klaimee’s future broker distribution team.

Who you are

  • You have 5 - 8 years of experience in commercial insurance distribution, brokerage, insurtech, or specialty insurance.
  • You understand how brokers evaluate new products and what it takes to move from initial interest to actual submissions.
  • You have existing relationships with brokers serving technology companies, AI companies, or other emerging risks.
  • You can explain complex coverage in plain language and make brokers feel confident introducing something new to their clients.
  • You are commercially driven and comfortable being measured on submissions, premium, and bound business.
  • You are willing to prospect and build relationships personally rather than relying on an established brand or inbound demand.
  • You enjoy creating structure where none exists, from broker segmentation to enablement materials and channel economics.
  • You are curious enough to understand the technology and technical enough to explain the risk without hiding behind insurance jargon.

Bonus points if you have worked at an early-stage MGA or insurtech, distributed cyber or technology E&O products, launched a new insurance program, or sold coverage for emerging risks.

What we offer

Competitive salary with a meaningful variable component tied to broker-sourced business, plus significant founding-team equity. You will work directly with the founders and help establish the broker distribution model for a completely new category of insurance.
