Senior Technical Architect, Zuora

Location: Remote within US (not limited to the states that the job is tagged to)

Role Overview

Genesys is seeking an experienced Senior Solution Architect, Zuora Billing to lead solution architecture, design governance, and technical direction across our billing platform and broader Lead-to-Cash ecosystem. This role will be responsible for designing scalable, reliable, and supportable Zuora Billing solutions that support subscription, usage-based, and hybrid monetization models.

This role requires deep hands-on expertise in Zuora Billing, with extensive experience in Zuora Workflows, mediation, usage processing, rating, bill runs, integrations, and operational supportability. The ideal candidate brings strong architectural judgment, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to drive clarity across complex cross-system processes spanning Salesforce, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Workday, ServiceNow, AWS, and related integration layers.

Success in this role requires more than platform knowledge. The Senior Solution Architect must understand the business context, challenge incomplete requirements, evaluate downstream impacts, and design solutions that protect billing accuracy, revenue integrity, operational stability, and long-term scalability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Zuora Billing, including subscription lifecycle, amendments, renewals, cancellations, usage billing, rating, invoicing, credit memos, bill runs, and billing operations.
  • Design and govern Zuora solutions that support subscription, consumption-based, and hybrid billing models, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment to Lead-to-Cash architecture.
  • Architect and optimize Zuora Workflows, including orchestration, error handling, retry logic, notifications, monitoring, exception management, and operational runbooks.
  • Lead architecture for mediation and usage processing, including usage ingestion, transformation, validation, aggregation, rating readiness, failure handling, and reconciliation.
  • Partner with Salesforce, Revenue Systems, Finance, Product Operations, Billing Operations, and Engineering teams to ensure end-to-end alignment across Quote-to-Cash processes.
  • Evaluate downstream impacts of billing changes across Zuora Revenue, Workday Finance, reporting, tax, customer portal, entitlements, and revenue accounting processes.
  • Design and document integration patterns between Salesforce, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Workday, ServiceNow, AWS, middleware platforms, and customer-facing systems.
  • Establish design standards and best practices for Zuora configuration, workflows, billing rules, charge models, usage processing, invoice behavior, and data integrity.
  • Drive solution design reviews with Product Owners, Technical Leads, developers, BSAs, QA, Billing Ops, and business stakeholders.
  • Identify architectural risks, technical debt, operational gaps, and process weaknesses; recommend pragmatic solutions and sequencing options.
  • Support complex incident and defect analysis by identifying root cause, assessing platform and process impact, and recommending durable corrective actions.
  • Partner with QA and business stakeholders to define end-to-end testing strategy, regression scope, usage/rating scenarios, billing validation, and release readiness criteria.
  • Guide teams on monitoring and observability requirements for workflows, mediation jobs, integrations, bill runs, and customer-impacting billing processes.
  • Ensure solutions comply with change management, access controls, audit expectations, SOX requirements, and financial data integrity standards.
  • Create and maintain architecture artifacts, including solution designs, workflow diagrams, integration maps, data flows, decision records, failure-mode analysis, and operational support models.
  • Mentor Product Owners, BSAs, Tech Leads, developers, and support teams on Zuora Billing capabilities, workflow patterns, mediation design, and billing architecture principles.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise applications, billing systems, or Quote-to-Cash platform delivery.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Zuora Billing in complex enterprise or SaaS environments.
  • Extensive experience designing and supporting Zuora Workflows, including orchestration, error handling, retry design, monitoring, notifications, and operational controls.
  • Strong experience with mediation, usage ingestion, usage transformation, usage validation, aggregation, rating, and exception handling.
  • Strong understanding of subscription billing concepts, including rate plans, charges, amendments, renewals, cancellations, bill runs, invoice generation, credit memos, payments, and adjustments.
  • Experience designing billing solutions for usage-based, consumption-based, subscription, and hybrid monetization models.
  • Experience integrating Zuora Billing with platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora Revenue, Workday, ServiceNow, AWS, middleware, tax engines, customer portals, or entitlement systems.
  • Strong understanding of Quote-to-Cash / Lead-to-Cash processes and downstream impacts across Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Accounting, Sales Operations, and Customer Support.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into scalable architecture and communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience leading design reviews, architecture governance, impact analysis, and technical decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex billing, workflow, integration, and data issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear architecture documentation, decision records, and executive-ready summaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Zuora Revenue, revenue recognition processes, RevPro integrations, or ASC 606-related downstream impacts.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, Workday Finance, ServiceNow, AWS, or enterprise middleware platforms.
  • Experience designing billing observability frameworks, including dashboards, alerting, workflow monitoring, exception queues, and operational metrics.

title: Integration Engineer
description:

title: Kerroshoitaja
description:
Haemme kerroshoitajia Hämeenlinnaan

Oletko kiinnostunut työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ja ihmisläheisessä ympäristössä, jossa tarjotaan mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja kasvaa? Haluamme sinut tiimiimme!

N-Clean on valittu HUMAN POWER 2024 -kilpailussa ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi. Tämä arvostettu tunnustus heijastaa arvojamme: luottamus, arvostus ja sitoutuminen yhteisiin tavoitteisiin. Etsimme nyt uutta tiiminjäsentä, joka jakaa arvomme ja haluaa olla osa vastuullista ja ihmisläheistä työyhteisöämme.

Työskentelypaikkasi tulee työsuhteen alussa olemaan hotellissa, jossa työtä tehdään maanantaista sunnuntaihin, pääsääntöisesti aamuvuoroissa. Työtä tehdään myös tarvittaessa toimitilakohteessa. Tehtävässä työskentelet asiakaskohteessamme ja vastaat hotellihuoneiden siisteydestä sekä muista puhtaanapitopalveluihin liittyvistä asiakaspalvelutehtävistä. Työskentelet vastuullisesti ja noudatat työssäsi turvallisuus- ja laatukäytäntöjä sekä huolehdit työympäristöstäsi. Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.

Tarjoamme sinulle määräaikaista ja osa-aikaista työsuhdetta, 20 tuntia viikossa. Työ alkaa yhdessä sovittuna ajankohtana ja päättyy 30.9.2026. Palkka määräytyy kiinteistöpalvelualan työntekijöitä koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja riippuu työtehtävistäsi. Harjoittelupalkka on 11,33€/h, jonka jälkeen tehtävästä riippuen 12,59€/h-13,22€/h. Lisäksi tarjoamme vastuullisen työnantajan, joka huolehtii reiluista työehdoista, turvallisesta työympäristöstä ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää positiivista asennetta, halua oppia uutta ja kykyä toimia luotettavana ja huolellisena tiimipelaajana sekä halua toimia osana yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä. Asiakasystävällinen työskentelytapa ja kyky luoda positiivinen ilmapiiri työyhteisöön ovat tärkeitä ominaisuuksia. Meillä pidetään huolta reiluista työehdoista, turvallisuudesta ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista.

Työt eivät edellytä suomen kielen hyvää taitoa, mikäli englannin kielitaitosi on sujuva, tällöin auttava suomen kielen taito riittää. Arvostamme monimuotoista työyhteisöä, jossa eri kieli- ja kulttuuritaustat ovat vahvuus. Mikäli et ole Suomen kansalainen, sinulla tulee olla jo tehtävää haettaessa voimassa oleva työlupa.

Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus

Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Kohtelemme kaikkia yhdenvertaisesti ja kunnioittavasti taustasta riippumatta, emmekä hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa. Toimimme vastuullisesti ja läpinäkyvästi sekä huolehdimme turvallisesta ja hyvinvoivasta työyhteisöstä.

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 7.9.2026.

Huomaathan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuajan aikana ja haku saattaa sulkeutua ilmoitettua aikaisemmin, mikäli löydämme oikean henkilön tehtävään ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Otamme hakemuksia vastaan ainoastaan nettisivujemme hakulomakkeen kautta.

We are looking for hotel housekeepers in Hämeenlinna


Are you interested in working in an international and people-oriented environment where opportunities to develop and grow are offered? We want you to join our team!
N-Clean was selected as the most people-oriented workplace in the HUMAN POWER 2024 competition. This respected recognition reflects our values: trust, appreciation and commitment to shared goals. We are now looking for a new team member who shares our values and wants to be part of our responsible and people-oriented working community.
At the beginning of your employment, your workplace will be a hotel, where work is carried out from Monday to Sunday, mainly in morning shifts. You may also work at commercial premises when necessary. In this role, you will work at our customer site and be responsible for the cleanliness of hotel rooms as well as other customer service tasks related to cleaning services. The Manufacturing Associate I applies direct labor for manufacturing high-quality diagnostic products using manual and semi-automated equipment. title: AI & Data Architect (m/f/d) - Tieto Tech Consulting
description:
Do you want to design the architectural foundations that turn Data & AI ambitions into scalable, enterprise-grade solutions? Then this role is for you.

Tieto Tech Consulting is the leading digital accelerator for innovation and sustainable value creation. We combine business design with software engineering to bring digital business to life.

With a team of around 300 highly qualified employees at our locations in Austria and Germany and a global team of 8,000 colleagues, we are constantly striving to develop and grow. Our customers trust in our solutions, which is why we are continuously looking for new talents.

As an AI & Data Architect, you will design the architectures that AI-enabled workflows run on - from the data foundation to the agentic systems built on top of it. Architecture is where successful implementation is decided long before the first line of code: target architecture, technology choices, and decisions that outlive the current project. You make those decisions hands-on and close to the teams that implement them.

Depending on the customer use case, you will work across cloud data platforms, integration architectures, agentic AI systems, governance and operating models. You help bring today's trends down to earth and turn them into real, lasting business value. As part of a dynamic and fast-growing practice, you will develop with the field itself - at our customers and inside our own organisation.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as an AI & Data Architect, you

  • Define target architectures and roadmaps across AI & Data platforms that are aligned with our customers' business, IT and security requirements
  • Translate between the worlds of engineering, business, IT and operations, making sure everyone ends up with the same picture
  • Guide customers in building AI-ready data foundations and governance, from data quality and access control to lineage
  • Own architecture decisions and make them traceable through ADRs, documented trade-offs, and the reasoning behind them
  • Put our partnerships with Microsoft and Databricks to work, weighing up for each customer which technology decision fits their case
  • Support pre-sales through technical discovery, solution design and effort estimation, and stay with the project from concept to implementation

Who we are looking for

  • Strong experience designing and implementing modern Data & AI architectures, from the data foundation to the AI services and workflows built on it
  • Confidence in customer-facing situations - from technical discovery to explaining a difficult architecture decision to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to build architectures that evolve, working hands-on and in close collaboration with engineering & operations teams
  • You have taken Data & AI solutions into production, not just into pilots - including governance, security, scalability, observability and lifecycle management
  • Up-to-date knowledge of platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry or Databricks, gained through hands-on experience
  • Professional working proficiency in German and English, enabling you to confidently communicate with customers and project teams

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes actions and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. You take ownership of architectural topics and feel comfortable guiding teams and customers through decision-making processes. You are communicative, collaborative, and able to translate between business and technology. Continuous learning and curiosity for new technologies are part of your mindset. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We offer

  • professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance
  • access to an extensive international network of industry experts
  • opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector
  • flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working
  • We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful.
  • Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your online application!
Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we will reach out to you. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com

Please note that while we are happy to answer questions via email, we can only consider applications submitted through our online application system and therefore cannot accept applications sent directly by email.

Hope to hear from you soon!

Locations: Vienna, Linz, Graz, Regensburg, Berlin, remote in Germany

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

location: 120 - San Juan Community Health Center (SJN) - Citrus Heights, CA 95621
description:
Health Educator I

Department/Care Stream: Health Education

LIA Reporting Structure

Timecard Approver: Campus Director

Primary: Health Education Program Manager

Secondary: Clinical Director of Medical Education

Status: Full-Time

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Location: San Juan Center

Pay Range: $27.40-$35.62/hr

EEO-1: Technician

Organization Information

WellSpace's mission is "achieving regional health through high quality comprehensive care." We believe that everyone deserves to be seen, no matter who you are, where you come from, where you work or what place you call home. At WellSpace, we see you!

We are driven to serve the whole person through comprehensive, integrated care, spanning medical, dental, behavioral health, and supportive services across the region. We do this by building a team of exceptional colleagues who are dedicated to our mission and becoming part of the communities we serve.

As the region's largest Community Health System, WellSpace utilizes a Confluence Model to integrate an internal network of healthcare modalities, including Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHC), Certified Community Behavioral Health Center (CCBHC), Drug Medi-Cal and Specialty Mental Health programs, California's second largest 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline Center, an independent Risk Bearing Organization (WellSpace Nexus), and more into a seamless confluence of care.

To ensure the highest quality of care, WellSpace is accredited by the Joint Commission for Ambulatory Care, Behavioral Health and as a CCBHC. Further, it is certified by the Joint Commission as a Primary Care Medical Home and a Behavioral Health Home. WellSpace's crisis programs are accredited by the American Association of Suicidology and the International Council for Helplines.

Position Summary

The Health Educator supports the Primary care team by providing health education to WellSpace Health patients. The ultimate goal of health education is to provide WellSpace Health patients with the necessary knowledge and skills to improve their well-being and live long healthy lives using a patient centered health approach. These services include health education to prevent and/or manage chronic and/or infectious diseases.

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent, Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Certified Health Education Specialist (CHES) preferred.
  • Health education/community health/public health degree or experience.
  • Fluency in additional languages preferred (E.g Spanish, Farsi, Punjabi or Hmong).
  • Able to conduct and facilitate one on one and group classes.
  • Must be able to work collaboratively with others in a team environment, respecting and valuing the
  • perspectives and experiences of others.
  • Able to maintain and understand appropriate roles, and boundaries among clients, peers, and WellSpace partners/stakeholders.
  • Able to function effectively in a fast paced environment.
  • Ability to write progress notes and maintain detailed data records.
  • Efficient time management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines and organizational needs.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the provision of services for the underserved and sensitivity working with a variety of people from low-income populations, with diverse educational, lifestyle, ethnic, and cultural origins; disabled, homeless, substance users, HIV (AIDS) infected, and/or physiologically impaired.
  • Must demonstrate a high level of verbal, writing and listening skills.
  • Commitment to HIPAA and ability to abide by standards of professional ethics and maintain confidentiality.
  • Current CPR and first aid certificate or willingness to be trained required within first (90) ninety days of employment.
  • Computer literacy including use of Outlook email, Microsoft Word, Excel, and EHR.
  • Adherence to infection control procedures, including but not limited to, standard precautions of temperature monitoring, hand washing, symptom self-monitoring, masking and social distancing.
  • Assist and support the Center/Department/Program to meet standards of High Reliability.
  • Must be willing to travel to the service locations and other health centers at least 10% of the time.
  • Must be willing to successfully complete the credentialing process.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Meet with each patient individually and/or in a group setting and provide health education.
  • Implement health education programs within Primary Care Department.
  • Implement a range of health education services, including establishing effective referral, scheduling and logistical support, and facilitating use of community services to promote the delivery of health education services.
  • Collaborate with the patient and care team in the development of an individual health action plan and support the patient in the execution of their health goals.
  • Refer patients to primary healthcare team, as appropriate.
  • Compose and document progress notes daily into an electronic patient care system and maintain detailed data records daily.
  • Provide support with the development of high quality, culturally appropriate health promotion materials.
  • Track patient progress and program data daily for reporting.
  • Attend regular monthly meetings with Health Centers and team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Benefits

Successful candidate will receive regionally competitive salary, above average health benefits at reduced costs, company paid life insurance & long-term disability insurance, additional voluntary retirement plan with company match and no vesting schedule requirement.

  • Paid bereavement and jury duty leave
  • 11 paid holidays per year
  • Paid time off
  • Paid sick leave
  • Flexible Spending Program
  • Company paid malpractice insurance for all providers
  • Professional development hours offered annually

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The work environment is characteristic of a medical clinic environment. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; use hands and arms to reach. The employee is also required to stand; walk; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must also possess hearing and speech to communicate in person and over the phone. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using substances and/or not attentive to personal health and safety for themselves or their homes. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the client’s use of alcohol and drugs, and the lack of personal care. The employee may also be exposed to bodily fluids (blood, urine) and hazardous chemicals.

title: Early Career Consult Program – Cybersecurity Infrastructure Associate
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

As a Cybersecurity Infrastructure Specialist, you will help maintain, secure, and optimize the infrastructure that supports cybersecurity operations. Working across networks, servers, operating systems, and security platforms, you will ensure that critical systems remain secure, available, and resilient. You will collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams to implement security architectures, support network management activities, and strengthen defenses against evolving cyber threats.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor, manage, and support secure network and infrastructure environments.

  • Implement, configure, and maintain cybersecurity technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS), endpoint security solutions, and SIEM platforms.

  • Assist with network management activities including routing, switching, VPN connectivity, load balancing, and network availability monitoring.

  • Troubleshoot network, infrastructure, and security configuration issues to maintain operational stability and performance.

  • Support the design and implementation of security architectures, network segmentation, and Zero Trust frameworks.

  • Monitor network performance, identify risks, and recommend improvements to security and infrastructure operations.

  • Assist with security compliance efforts by implementing controls aligned to organizational requirements and industry standards.

  • Gather diagnostic information, perform root-cause analysis, and escalate complex technical issues when appropriate.

  • Document infrastructure configurations, troubleshooting procedures, security controls, and operational best practices.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, and operations teams to deliver secure and resilient infrastructure solutions.

Who You Are

Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of network infrastructure, including routing, switching, VPNs, and network performance management.

  • Foundational experience with security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint security platforms, and SIEM solutions.

  • Understanding of operating systems such as Windows and Linux and their security mechanisms.

  • Knowledge of network addressing, protocols, traffic flow, and secure connectivity concepts.

  • Ability to monitor and troubleshoot network, infrastructure, and security-related issues.

  • Familiarity with security standards, compliance requirements, and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, or similar standards.

  • Understanding of network security risks, vulnerabilities, and security best practices.

  • Ability to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure and security solutions.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to document configurations, operational procedures, incidents, and technical recommendations.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing or supporting security architectures, network segmentation, or Zero Trust implementations.

  • Experience with enterprise network, server, cloud, or infrastructure security controls.

  • Familiarity with workload, server, and network architectures in complex enterprise environments.

  • Experience supporting highly available, large-scale, or managed infrastructure environments.

  • Knowledge of automation, infrastructure monitoring, or network management tools.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Relevant industry certifications in networking, infrastructure, or cybersecurity.

Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.


Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect


Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: HRIS Business Analyst
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior HRIS Business Analyst to play a pivotal role in a large-scale HRIS transformation program. Working alongside an experienced Project Manager, you will be instrumental in shaping the solution from planning and discovery through to implementation, testing and hypercare.
This is an opportunity for a seasoned Business Analyst who has worked across the full lifecycle of HRIS implementations and enjoys operating across business process analysis, requirements, data, integrations and stakeholder engagement.

About the Role:
As a key member of the project team, you will help define the scope of the program, analyse current business processes, assess data quality and integration requirements, and ensure the delivered solution meets business needs. You'll work closely with HR, Technology, Solution Architecture, Engineering, vendors and business stakeholders to deliver a successful enterprise-wide HRIS implementation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead discovery workshops and requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders.
  • Map end-to-end HR business processes using Level 4 and Level 5 BPMN standards.
  • Capture and document functional, technical, integration and data requirements.
  • Assess existing HR data, identify gaps and develop data remediation recommendations.
  • Analyse system interfaces and work with engineering teams to assess integration complexity.
  • Partner with Solution Architects and delivery teams to support planning, estimation and solution design.
  • Validate vendor solutions against business requirements and identify functional gaps.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability of requirements throughout delivery.
  • Support functional testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), cutover planning and go-live activities.
  • Assist with knowledge transfer and support during hypercare to ensure a smooth transition to business-as-usual.

About You:
You are a confident, hands-on Senior Business Analyst with extensive experience delivering enterprise HR technology projects. You are equally comfortable facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders, analysing complex business processes, and working alongside technical teams to solve integration and data challenges.
You'll bring:

  • 15+ years' experience in Business Analysis, ideally within large enterprise transformation programs.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering end-to-end HRIS implementations or major HR technology projects.
  • Strong experience mapping complex business processes using BPMN (Level 4 & Level 5).
  • Experience analysing system integrations and documenting interface specifications.
  • Proven ability to assess data quality, identify gaps and contribute to data migration and remediation planning.
  • Outstanding workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience working across Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
  • Excellent written documentation and communication skills.
  • Experience using tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, Miro and Excel.

Highly Regarded:

  • Experience delivering enterprise platform or digital transformation programs.
  • Exposure to large-scale system integrations and platform migrations.
  • Previous experience working with leading HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Dayforce or UKG.

What's on offer?

  • Circa $950 p/d
  • 6-month intial contract (extenisons highly likely)
  • Nearby Melbourne CBD location (3-4 days p/w in office)

title: Information Security Specialist Lead
description:
Job Description

Reporting to the Head of Information Security Policy and Standards, you will lead the identification, documentation, and implementation of the security risk and controls framework across the Enterprise to meet Experian's cybersecurity and risk requirements.

The Information Security Specialist Lead will contribute to the team's goals of ensuring a sound security posture by designing and implementing risk-based security controls.

You will contribute to the design and operation of best-practice cyber risk management, collaborating with partners across the business.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the security risk and control modularisation strategy, engaging with the Regional BU, centralised security and IT control owners across the Enterprise to populate the controls library.
  • Maintain and update the integrated risk and control framework following information security policies, standards, industry-accepted practice, and regulations.
  • Review and provide expert check and challenge on first-line business units defined control activities, ensuring agreement on the requirements outlined in control standards and goals.
  • Identify, document, and report control activity gaps, and provide remediation recommendations.
  • Compile management reports, summary analysis, and detailed presentations to describe the risk and controls program.
  • Develop and present content for controls implementation workshops with control owners across the Enterprise.
  • Ensure information security controls are aligned and mapped to applicable risks (risk types and risk register entries) in the Archer GRC platform.
  • Monitor and stay informed about internal and external risk indicators that could affect and disrupt Experian and our mission. Provide these risk indicators as inputs to control assurance and other EGSO activities.
  • Contribute to the efficiency of the risk and controls program by standardizing and automating processes, capturing stakeholder feedback to drive improvement, and enhancing the engagement model.
  • Support strategic projects representing the Information Security Governance team and provide subject matter expertise in the controls space.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, management information systems or relevant field or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on controls experience, with security control design, implementation, and evaluation.
  • Experience with GRC tools, such as Archer.
  • Understanding of industry best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO, COBIT, CMMI, OWASP, ITIL)
  • A detailed knowledge of governance, risk, and controls principles.
  • Knowledge of IT technologies and methods to secure them, with a knowledge of Cloud security. A working knowledge of the AWS cloud environment is beneficial.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity organisation practices, operations, risk management processes, principles, architectural requirements, engineering and threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Industry certifications such as CCSP, CRISC, CISSP, CISM or equivalent experience.
  • Understand and translate technical requirements for non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of the financial services industry and its regulations is preferred.
  • Experience using AI to automate processes is desirable.

Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. title: Cleaning Associate
description:
Marshalls

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Responsible for maintaining a clean and organized store environment with a focus on floor care. Responsibilities include the operation of the scrubber and buffer, dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, and spot cleaning glass and windows. Adheres to all operational, merchandise, and loss prevention standards. Cross-trained to work in multiple areas of the store in order to support the needs of the business.

  • Role models established customer experience practices with internal and external customers
  • Supports and embodies a positive store culture through honesty, integrity, and respect
  • Maintains all floor care cleanliness standards including the maintenance and operation of the scrubber and buffer
  • Maintains all organizational, cleanliness, and recovery standards for the entire store, e.g. Sales Floor, Single Queue, Associate Lounge, Backroom and Restrooms
  • Adheres to all company policies concerning Health and Safety (includes the refilling of all essential items in the Lounge, Restrooms and Front End)
  • Cross-trained in other areas of the store (Backroom, Front End, Sales Floor, etc.)
  • Supports and responds to all Front End coverage needs
  • Adheres and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
  • Initiates and participates in store recovery as needed throughout the day
  • Adheres to all operational and loss prevention controls in accordance with company guidelines and policies including shrink reduction
  • Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates
  • Adheres to all labor laws, policies, and procedures, including Associate meal and break period policies
  • Participates in safety awareness maintains a safe environment
  • Other duties as assigned

Who We're Looking For: You.

  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Able to work a flexible schedule to support business needs
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Physical stamina to perform cleaning tasks and run floor buffer and scrubber
  • Capable of multi-tasking
  • Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
  • Strong communication skills: verbal and written. Listens and responds appropriately
  • Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Standout colleague, working effectively with peers and supervisors
  • Retail customer experience preferred

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Winkelbeveiliger Oostpoort
description:
At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Beveiliger bij warenhuis TK Maxx

TK Maxx is een warenhuis met een continu wisselend aanbod van de mooiste kleding, beautyproducten, woonaccessoires, sieraden en unieke cadeaus van grote merken voor kleine prijzen. Bij ons vind je altijd meer dan gedacht voor minder dan verwacht. Deze unieke shopervaring noemen wij ook wel schatzoeken.

Wat ga je doen?

Terwijl onze klanten het ene na het andere pareltje ontdekken in onze schatkamer, zorg jij als beveiliger voor een veilige omgeving. Samen met het winkelmanagement probeer je risico’s op de winkelvloer te voorkomen en onveilige situaties effectief op te lossen. Met jouw sociale skills, oplettendheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel weet je de veiligheid van onze klanten en collega’s te waarborgen en ongewenst gedrag tot een minimum te beperken.

Heb jij een MBO beveiligingsdiploma op niveau 2, sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je flexibel inzetbaar? Lees dan snel verder!

Hoe ziet je werkdag eruit?

  • Je voert regelmatig controles en surveillances uit
  • Je grijpt in bij veiligheidsincidenten
  • Je bent het visitekaartje voor de winkel en dankzij jouw vriendelijke houding durven klanten jou makkelijk aan te spreken
  • Je communiceert over ongewenst gedrag (verwijderde beveiligingstags, lege verpakkingen etc.)
  • Je handhaaft winkelontzeggingen bij de deur
  • Je assisteert bij aanhoudingen

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een uitdagende beveiligingsfunctie in een dynamische retailomgeving waarin je elke dag omringd bent met de leukste collega’s, topmerken en een flinke dosis shopgeluk
  • Een uurloon excl. vakantiegeld en toeslagen
  • Een jaarcontract van 38 uur met mogelijkheid tot verlenging
  • 24 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband)
  • Reiskostenvergoeding (als je meer dan 10 km van de winkel woont), 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenregeling
  • Personeelskorting én we organiseren een aantal keer per jaar dubbel-discount-weekenden
  • Uitgebreide support voor jou en je familie, volop doorgroeimogelijkheden en allerlei ontwikkelingsprogramma’s
  • Collectieve zorgverzekering
  • Een uitgebreid inwerkprogramma zodat je goed voorbereid bent


Be your best self

Bij ons is diversiteit geen trend, maar iets wat al meer dan 40 jaar de basis vormt van onze organisatie. Vanzelfsprekend zijn sollicitaties van iedereen welkom. Onze bedrijfscultuur is net zo uniek als ons shopconcept en onze medewerkers maken het verschil. TK Maxx is betrokken, uniek, stijlvol en een tikkeltje eigenzinnig. Bij ons kun je volledig jezelf zijn!

Hebben we je MAXXimale interesse gewekt? Neem vandaag nog contact met ons op!

As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.
